Query_Text_en: Tomlinson also taught him a lesson in injustice that he talks about to this day .
Translation: 汤姆林森还给他上了一堂关于不公正的课，至今他仍时常提起。

Query_Text_en: Nearing the end of his senior year , after Bharara had been admitted to Harvard , he discovered that the headmaster had fired Tomlinson for objecting to Ranney 's plan to give the school 's teachers a raise while requiring them to work longer hours , suggesting that was n't a raise.
Translation: 巴拉拉在高三临近毕业、已被哈佛大学录取之际，发现校长解雇了汤姆林森，只因汤姆林森反对兰尼提出的方案——该方案要求教师延长工作时间才能获得所谓加薪，实则是变相减薪。

Query_Text_en: When Bharara heard of her firing , he went to her and vowed to take action .
Translation: 当巴拉拉听闻她被解职的消息后，立即前往与其会面，并誓言将采取行动。

Query_Text_en: This is terrible , '' Tomlinson says he told her .
Translation: "这太糟糕了，"汤普森说他当时这样告诉她。

Query_Text_en: You 're one of the best teachers in the school -- we have to do something  .
Translation: 您是本校最优秀的教师之一——我们必须采取行动。

Query_Text_en: We 'll organize
Translation: 我们将组织

Query_Text_en: We 'll protest or something .
Translation: 我们将举行抗议或其他行动。

Query_Text_en: She tried to talk him out of it .
Translation: 她试图劝他放弃这个念头。

Query_Text_en: He had just been accepted to Harvard , and Ranney , she cautioned , could easily write the school a letter labeling him a troublemaker .
Translation: 他刚被哈佛大学录取，而兰尼——她警告说——可以轻而易举地给校方写封信，给他扣上"麻烦制造者"的帽子。

Query_Text_en: She told him not to jeopardize his future for nothing -- that she had already lost her job .
Translation: 她告诫他不要无谓地断送前程——自己已然丢了饭碗。

Query_Text_en: SBut Bharara persisted , getting a group of students together to see Ranney in his office .
Translation: 但巴拉拉坚持己见，召集了一群学生到兰尼的办公室面谈。

Query_Text_en: This was like going to see God in his den , '' Tomlinson told Fortune .
Translation: "这简直就像去上帝的老巢朝圣。"汤普森对《财富》杂志如是说。

Query_Text_en: The meeting changed nothing -- Tomlinson got a new teaching job at a different school and Bharara went off to Harvard .
Translation: 会议未带来任何改变——汤姆林森转至另一所学校重执教鞭，巴拉拉则前往哈佛就职。

Query_Text_en: But the injustice of her firing stuck with him .
Translation: 但解雇她的不公正行为始终萦绕在他心头。

Query_Text_en: Years later , around August 2009 , Tomlinson got a call out of the blue from Bharara 's mother , who wanted to know if she was the same Barbara Tomlinson who had taught her son Preet at Ranney.
Translation: 多年后，大约在2009年8月，汤姆林森突然接到巴拉拉母亲的电话，对方想确认她是否就是当年在兰尼学校教导其子普利特的芭芭拉·汤姆林森。

Query_Text_en: Hi Mrs. T. , this is Preet , and I 've just been nominated to be U.S. attorney for the Southern District .
Translation: 尊敬的T女士，我是普里特，刚被提名为美国南区联邦检察官。

Query_Text_en: I hope you can come to my swearing-in ceremony. ''Tomlinson was completely stunned.
Translation: "希望您能出席我的就职典礼。"汤姆林森闻言彻底怔住了。

Query_Text_en: How many people in a high position like him can still remember their high school teachers and then tell her, 'I hope you can be there.
Translation: 像他这样身居高位的人，能有几个还记得自己的中学老师，并对她说"希望您能出席"呢？

Query_Text_en: `` How many people in a position like that would reach back to a high school teacher and say , ` I 'd like you to be there ? ' '' she says .
Translation: “像他那样身居高位的人，有多少会回头联系高中老师，说‘我希望你能出席’？”她说道。

Query_Text_en: Last year, Barala went to Lanny School to deliver a graduation speech to 56 graduates, including his two Cousins and Bruce Springsteen's daughter, Jesse Springsteen.
Translation: 去年，巴拉拉前往兰尼学校为56名毕业生发表毕业演讲，其中包括他的两位表亲和布鲁斯·斯普林斯汀的女儿杰西·斯普林斯汀。

Query_Text_en: He worked extra-hard on his speech , assuming the Boss would be in attendance .
Translation: 他格外用心准备演讲，料想上司会出席。

Query_Text_en: He quoted Oliver Wendell Holmes , the late Supreme Court justice .
Translation: 他引用了已故最高法院大法官奥利弗·温德尔·霍姆斯的话。

Query_Text_en: At Ranney , he told the graduating students , `` I received the lesson that the fullest life is not spent in merely acquiring material wealth or esoteric knowledge ; the fullest life involves a commitment to act also for the benefit of other people . '' -LRB- Springsteen was n't there ; his daughter was at an equestrian competition instead . -RRB-
Translation: 在兰尼学校，他对毕业生们说道："我领悟到，最充实的人生不仅在于追求物质财富或深奥知识，更在于致力于为他人谋福祉。"（斯普林斯汀本人并未到场，其女儿当时正参加马术比赛。）

Query_Text_en: Bharara 's outspokenness continued at Harvard
Translation: 巴拉拉在哈佛大学依然直言不讳

Query_Text_en: On the first day of classes , he met Viet Dinh .
Translation: 开学第一天，他遇见了阮定伟。

Query_Text_en: who would go on to become an assistant attorney general under George W. Bush and who many consider to be the father of the Patriot Act -LRB- he is also a director of News Corp. -LRB- NWSA -RRB- .
Translation: 此人后来在小布什政府中担任助理司法部长，被广泛视为《爱国者法案》之父（他同时还是新闻集团[NASDAQ: NWSA]的董事）。

Query_Text_en: After meeting in a government studies class , they spent the entire day and all night -- until 9 a.m. the next morning -- debating whether the founding fathers believed man to be inherently good or evil .
Translation: 在一堂政府研究课后，他们彻夜长谈直至次日清晨九点，就美国开国元勋们对人性的本质持"性善论"还是"性恶论"展开激烈辩论。

Query_Text_en: -LRB- Only at Harvard . -RRB- Dinh says now that he probably took the side of man being evil , while Bharara took the opposing view -- `` and we 've been best friends and we have n't stopped arguing ever since , '' Dinh told Fortune .
Translation: （不愧是哈佛啊。）丁回忆说，当时自己可能站在人性本恶的立场，巴拉拉则持相反观点——"但我们成了最好的朋友，而且从那以后争论就没停过，"丁对《财富》杂志表示。

Query_Text_en: He came away from the discussion impressed by his thoughtful new friend .
Translation: 会谈结束后，这位新朋友的深思熟虑给他留下了深刻印象。

Query_Text_en: `` He asked questions and tried to find the right answers rather than the converse , which is ask who he is and then therefore derive the answer from there , '' Dinh said .
Translation: 丁表示："他提出问题并努力寻找正确答案，而非相反——即先问他是谁，再据此推导答案。"

Query_Text_en: `` He knows who he is .
Translation: 他心里有数。

Query_Text_en: He knows what his job requires and he calls it the way he sees it .
Translation: 他深知职责所在，秉公直言不讳。

Query_Text_en: He is as straight as the Nevada Highway is long . ''
Translation: 他为人正直，如同内华达公路般坦荡无垠。

Query_Text_en: From Harvard , Bharara was off to Columbia Law School , from which he graduated in 1993 , before heading to work as a summer volunteer in the campaign of Mark Green , who was then running for New York City 's public advocate .
Translation: 巴拉拉从哈佛毕业后进入哥伦比亚法学院深造，1993年取得学位后，旋即以暑期志愿者身份加入马克·格林竞选团队，协助其角逐纽约市公益维护官一职。

Query_Text_en: Green won the race , and Bharara left for private practice , working as a litigation associate at the law firm Gibson Dunn & Crutcher .
Translation: 格林赢得了竞选，巴拉拉则转投私人执业领域，在吉布森律师事务所担任诉讼律师。

Query_Text_en: Three years later , he jumped to the New York office of another law firm , Swidler Berlin Shereff Friedman .
Translation: 三年后，他跳槽至另一家律所——斯维德勒·柏林·谢里夫·弗里德曼律师事务所的纽约办事处。

Query_Text_en: In 2000 , Bharara became a prosecutor in the Southern District , where for five years he prosecuted organized crime , narcotics , and securities fraud , among other crimes .
Translation: 2000年，巴拉拉出任南区联邦检察官，在随后的五年间，他负责起诉了包括有组织犯罪、毒品交易和证券欺诈在内的多类刑事案件。

Query_Text_en: A turn of fate soon came from his friend and fellow Southern District prosecutor Ben Lawsky , now chief of staff to New York 's governor , Andrew Cuomo .
Translation: 命运的转折很快来自他的朋友、同为南区检察官的本·劳斯基，此人现为纽约州州长安德鲁·科莫的幕僚长。

Query_Text_en: Lawsky had previously been chief counsel to New York Sen.
Translation: 劳斯基此前曾担任纽约州参议员的首席法律顾问。

Query_Text_en: Charles Schumer and at the time had been talking to Jeff Berman , the man who replaced him as Schumer 's chief counsel and who himself was leaving for the private sector .
Translation: 查克·舒默当时正与杰夫·伯曼交谈，后者接替他成为舒默的首席法律顾问，而伯曼本人也将离职投身私营领域。

Query_Text_en: The tradition was for Schumer 's chief counsel to find his own replacement before departing -LRB- and then to continue to field calls for months from Schumer , who was said to have trouble letting go -RRB- .
Translation: 按照惯例，舒默的首席法律顾问在离任前需自行物色继任者（此后数月仍需接听舒默的来电——据称这位参议员难以放手旧部）。

Query_Text_en: Berman wanted to know if Lawsky knew of any young prosecutor in the Southern District who might be interested in being Schumer 's chief counsel .
Translation: 伯尔曼想知道劳斯基是否认识南区任何一位年轻检察官，可能有意担任舒默的首席法律顾问。

Query_Text_en: `` There 's only one guy I can think of in the entire building , '' Lawsky told Berman .
Translation: "整栋楼里我只能想到一个人，"劳斯基对伯曼说道。

Query_Text_en: Bharara started working for Schumer in February 2005 .
Translation: 巴拉拉于2005年2月开始为舒默工作。

Query_Text_en: Friends say Bharara would make a great attorney general or Supreme Court Justice .
Translation: 友人评价巴拉拉完全胜任司法部长或最高法院大法官之职。

Query_Text_en: But they also suggest he might like to make some money .
Translation: 但他们也暗示他可能有意从中获利。

Query_Text_en: As chief counsel to Schumer , who was a leading member of the Senate Judiciary Committee , Bharara led the investigation into the firing of eight U.S. attorneys -- which ultimately led to the resignation of Attorney General Alberto Gonzales -- and generally won plaudits for his even-handed , nonpartisan , and unflappable approach to the highly controversial episode .
Translation: 作为参议院司法委员会核心成员舒默的首席法律顾问，巴拉拉牵头调查了八名联邦检察官遭解职事件——该事件最终导致司法部长阿尔韦托·冈萨雷斯辞职。面对这起极具争议的案件，他以不偏不倚、超然党派、沉着镇定的处理方式广受赞誉。

Query_Text_en: Lawsky says he believes Bharara 's humor and congenial manner made him successful in that tough assignment .
Translation: 劳斯基表示，他认为巴拉拉凭借幽默风趣与平易近人的作风，在这项艰巨任务中取得了成功。

Query_Text_en: `` He 's the whole package , '' Lawsky says .
Translation: "他是一位全能型人才，"劳斯基评价道。

Query_Text_en: `` He 's a very smart lawyer , good prosecutor , but on the Judiciary Committee you need to be able to see both sides of issues and work well , especially with people on both sides of the aisle .
Translation: 他是一位非常精明的律师，出色的检察官，但在司法委员会任职必须能够兼顾议题的双面性，善于协作——尤其是与持对立立场的同僚共事。

Query_Text_en: Preet is just one of these people who has the ability to get along with anyone . ''
Translation: 普利特就是这样一位能与任何人融洽相处的能人。

Query_Text_en: In the wake of Obama 's election , the U.S. attorney for the Southern District , Michael Garcia , who was appointed by George W. Bush , announced his resignation .
Translation: 奥巴马当选后，由乔治·W·布什任命的美国纽约南区联邦检察官迈克尔·加西亚宣布辞职。

Query_Text_en: It was Schumer who recommended Bharara -- one of his key advisers -- to President Obama for the top job in the Southern District in February 2009 .
Translation: 正是舒默在2009年2月向奥巴马总统推荐了巴拉拉——他的核心顾问之一——出任南区联邦检察官这一要职。

Query_Text_en: The New York Times headline simply said , SCHUMER AIDE IS CONFIRMED AS U.S. ATTORNEY .
Translation: 《纽约时报》标题直截了当写道：舒默助理获任美国联邦检察官。

Query_Text_en: `` I believe Preet Bharara will be one of the most outstanding U.S. attorneys that the Southern District , or any other , has ever had , '' Schumer said at the time .
Translation: 舒默当时表示："我相信普里特·巴拉拉将成为南区和全美历任联邦检察官中最杰出的代表之一。"

Query_Text_en: At each stop along the way , Bharara has managed to impress both his peers and his bosses and to win their confidence , and they have been eager to recommend him repeatedly for positions of increasing power and authority .
Translation: 巴哈拉在每一段职业历程中都令同僚与上司印象深刻，赢得了他们的信任。他们屡次热忱举荐他担任权责更重的职位。

Query_Text_en: `` He 's always impressed me as a very thoughtful guy , '' says Bharara 's friend Brian Benczkowski , former chief of staff to Attorney General Michael Mukasey and now an attorney at Kirkland & Ellis in Washington .
Translation: "他一直给我留下深思熟虑的印象，"巴拉拉的好友布莱恩·本茨科夫斯基表示。本茨科夫斯基曾任司法部长迈克尔·穆卡西的幕僚长，现为华盛顿柯克兰律师事务所执业律师。

Query_Text_en: He 's not unaware of politics , but I think his compass is more directed at doing the right thing . ''
Translation: 他并非不懂政治，但我认为他的行事准则更倾向于做正确的事。

Query_Text_en: Bharara also gets high marks for his management of the Southern District .
Translation: 巴拉拉对纽约南区联邦检察官办公室的管理也广受赞誉。

Query_Text_en: `` They have a real spring in their step in that office now , '' says Bill Burke , the former deputy White House counsel under George W. Bush who has known Bharara for nearly a decade and says Bharara has brought `` energy and a natural leadership quality '' to the office .
Translation: 乔治·W·布什执政时期的白宫前副法律顾问比尔·伯克表示："如今那个办公室确实焕发出蓬勃朝气。"与巴拉拉相识近十年的伯克指出，巴拉拉为办公室注入了"活力与与生俱来的领导才能"。

Query_Text_en: `` One of the most important things for the assistant U.S. attorneys , '' he says , `` is to feel like the boss has got their back .
Translation: "对于助理联邦检察官而言,"他表示,"最重要的事情之一,就是感受到上司是他们坚实的后盾。"

Query_Text_en: Preet trusts in them and believes in them .
Translation: 普里特对他们充满信任并寄予厚望。

Query_Text_en: It has given that office a real boost . ''
Translation: 这确实为该机构注入了强劲动力。

Query_Text_en: With the effective use of wiretaps in the Rajaratnam case -- a decision that was made prior to Bharara 's taking over the office and required a judge 's approval based on evidence of probable cause -- he is credited with instilling a new sense of fear among Wall Street traders of every stripe who can no longer be sure when , or if , law enforcement officials might be listening in
Translation: 拉贾拉特南案中窃听手段的有效运用——这一决策由巴拉拉上任前作出，并基于合理证据获得法官批准——为他赢得了声誉，令各类华尔街交易员心生前所未有的恐惧，他们再也无法确定执法人员何时（或是否）正在监听。

Query_Text_en: Bharara made that point emphatically when he announced Rajaratnam 's arrest .`` We believe this case represents the first time that court-authorized wiretaps have been used to target significant insider trading on Wall Street , '' he said in his prepared remarks .
Translation: 巴拉拉在宣布拉贾拉特南被捕时着重强调了这一点。他在事先准备的声明中表示："我们相信，此案标志着美国司法史上首次通过法庭授权的窃听手段，成功侦破华尔街重大内幕交易案件。"

Query_Text_en: `` All the defendants charged today were ultimately caught committing their alleged crimes over phones that we were listening to .
Translation: 今日被起诉的所有被告，最终均因在我们监听的通话中实施所指控罪行而落网。

Query_Text_en: This aggressive use of wiretaps is important : It shows that we are targeting white-collar insider-trading rings with the same powerful investigative tools that have worked so successfully against the mob and drug cartels . ''
Translation: 这种对窃听手段的强势运用意义重大：它表明我们正以打击黑帮和贩毒集团同样高效的有力侦查手段，直指白领内幕交易团伙。

Query_Text_en: Neil Barofksy , who worked with Bharara as a prosecutor in the Southern District and who just completed two years as the special inspector general of the TARP program , says he believes Bharara has changed the rules of the road on Wall Street .
Translation: 曾与巴拉拉共事于南区检察署、并刚结束两年不良资产救助计划特别监察长任期的尼尔·巴洛夫斯基表示，他认为巴拉拉已经改变了华尔街的行为准则。

Query_Text_en: `` It scared the hell out of people , '' he says .
Translation: "这简直把人们吓破了胆，"他说道。

Query_Text_en: `` It 's the thinking twice about doing the transaction because there 's so many different potential ways now of getting caught .
Translation: 正是这种对交易行为的反复权衡——因为如今有太多可能被发现的方式。

Query_Text_en: Your cellphone is not safe .
Translation: 您的手机并不安全。

Query_Text_en: Your instant message is n't safe . -LSB- He -RSB- sent a message : ` Not only are we going to get you , but you 're not going to be able to cover your tracks . '
Translation: 你的即时通讯并不安全。——他发来消息：“我们不仅要抓到你，还会让你无法掩盖行踪。”

Query_Text_en: Preet has really taken advantage of a unique opportunity to use these tools to make a significant difference on how people approach their jobs on Wall Street . ''
Translation: 普里特确实把握住了这一独特机遇，运用这些工具显著改变了华尔街从业者的工作方式。

Query_Text_en: Others are dubious that the Rajaratnam verdict will change behavior on Wall Street .
Translation: 其他人则对拉贾拉特南一案的判决能否改变华尔街的行为持怀疑态度。

Query_Text_en: While conceding the prosecution was a `` wake-up call '' and representative of a `` new era of enhanced enforcement , '' Richard Scheff , chairman of the Philadelphia law firm Montgomery McCracken and a former consultant to the assistant secretary of the Treasury for law enforcement in the Clinton administration , says he thought the verdict 's actual impact would be less than expected .
Translation: 费城蒙哥马利·麦凯伦律师事务所主席、克林顿政府时期财政部助理执法部长顾问理查德·谢夫承认，此次起诉堪称"警钟"，标志着"强化执法新时代"的到来，但他认为判决的实际影响将低于预期。

Query_Text_en: `` My experience is , people do n't think they 're going to get caught , '' he said .
Translation: "我的经验是，人们总以为自己不会被抓住，"他说道。

Query_Text_en: `` There is significant money to be made -- and greed drives behavior . ''
Translation: "其中蕴藏着巨大的财富——而贪婪驱动着人们的行为。"

Query_Text_en: The main lingering criticism of Bharara -- one that may need resolution before his elevation -- is that the new sheriff of Wall Street has brought no criminal or civil cases against the bankers whose actions helped cause and exacerbate the financial crisis .
Translation: 对巴拉拉的主要持续批评——这一批评可能需在其晋升前得到解决——在于，这位华尔街的新任"警长"尚未对那些行为助长并加剧金融危机的银行家提起任何刑事或民事诉讼。

Query_Text_en: `` The civil charges that should be brought -LSB- against Wall Street -RSB- are there screaming out to be brought , '' former New York governor and attorney general Eliot Spitzer said on CNN .
Translation: "针对华尔街的民事诉讼早该提起，这些案件已到了非诉不可的地步，"纽约州前州长兼总检察长艾略特·斯皮策在美国有线电视新闻网节目中表示。

Query_Text_en: `` And the fact that it has n't been done yet is really staggering . ''
Translation: "而此事至今仍未完成，着实令人震惊。"

Query_Text_en: Spitzer was the public voice for a chorus that still echoes privately in homes around the country and outside of Wall Street -LRB- and in Inside Job director Charles Ferguson 's plea in his Academy Awards acceptance speech -RRB- .
Translation: 斯皮策道出了全美各地家庭以及华尔街以外群体的心声——这种声音至今仍在私下回响（正如纪录片《监守自盗》导演查尔斯·弗格森在其奥斯卡获奖感言中所呼吁的那样）。

Query_Text_en: The Southern District flatly rejects this assessment .
Translation: 南区断然否定了这一评估结论。

Query_Text_en: The absence of charges , they say , does not mean the absence of hard work investigating the piles of evidence to see if criminal charges should be brought and if they can be proved beyond a reasonable doubt .
Translation: 他们表示，未提起公诉并不意味着调查人员未对大量证据进行艰苦审查，以判定是否应提起刑事指控，以及这些指控能否排除合理怀疑而成立。

Query_Text_en: Complicating matters is the fact that , by law , the existence of grand jury investigations is to be kept confidential , and prosecutors are not permitted to share evidence that would reveal why an indictment was not sought .
Translation: 更复杂的是，根据法律规定，大陪审团调查的存在必须保密，检察官不得分享可能揭示为何未寻求起诉的证据。

Query_Text_en: Barofsky , for one , is sympathetic to that argument .
Translation: 巴罗夫斯基对此观点表示认同。

Query_Text_en: `` I have that same intuitive disgust at the fact that we have n't seen higher-profile cases , '' he told Fortune .
Translation: "对于迄今未见更多高调案件曝光这一事实，我同样本能地感到愤慨，"他向《财富》杂志坦言。

Query_Text_en: `` But as a former prosecutor , without seeing the evidence that they saw , it almost could be unfair of me to make a judgment . ''
Translation: "但作为一名前检察官，在未看到他们所掌握的证据前，我若贸然作出判断，恐有失公允。"

Query_Text_en: The party line is that being U.S. attorney in the Southern District of New York is his dream job and that he wo n't use it as a stepping stone to higher office .
Translation: 官方表态称，担任纽约南区联邦检察官是他的理想职位，他不会将此作为谋求更高官职的跳板。

Query_Text_en: `` Preet loves his job and has no desire to run for public office now or ever , '' his senior press adviser , Ellen Davis , said on his behalf after the Rajaratnam verdict .
Translation: 拉贾拉特南案判决后，普里特的高级新闻顾问埃伦·戴维斯代表其发表声明称："普里特热爱现有工作，无论现在或将来都无意竞选公职。"

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , his friends seem to think he would make a great attorney general or federal judge , perhaps even a Supreme Court Justice .
Translation: 然而，他的朋友们似乎认为他将成为一位出色的司法部长或联邦法官，甚至可能成为最高法院大法官。

Query_Text_en: They marvel at his ability to connect with people , and think he would be able to win elective office , even if he has expressed little interest in wanting to mount a political campaign .
Translation: 他们惊叹于他与民众建立联系的能力，并认为他即便对参选兴趣寥寥，也完全有望赢得公职选举。

Query_Text_en: They also talk about his quite natural desire to one day earn more money .
Translation: 他们还提到，他有朝一日想赚更多钱，这种愿望再自然不过。

Query_Text_en: He does , after all , have three children whom he wants to educate the way he was educated .
Translation: 毕竟，他还有三个孩子要按自己接受的教育方式来培养。

Query_Text_en: Since he has earned around $ 150,000 a year in his various public-sector jobs for the past few years , they say he is not immune -- when the time comes -- to the lure of a partnership in a private law firm , where someone of Bharara 's stature could earn millions a year .
Translation: 鉴于巴拉拉过去几年在多个公职岗位上年收入约15万美元，分析人士指出，当私营律所抛出高薪合伙人的橄榄枝时（以巴拉拉的资历，年薪可达数百万美元），他恐怕也难以抗拒。

Query_Text_en: In the meantime , Bharara can be sustained by his knowledge that he is trying valiantly to right injustice -- while retaining his sense of humor .
Translation: 与此同时，巴拉拉仍能坚守信念，因为他深知自己正在勇敢地匡扶正义——同时亦未丧失幽默感。

Query_Text_en: Ben Lawsky remembers the day in 2004 when a case he and Bharara had been working on against the Mafia came to a head .
Translation: 本·劳斯基仍记得2004年的那一天，当时他与巴拉拉共同侦办的涉黑手党案件进入关键阶段。

Query_Text_en: Thirty members of the Mafia were arrested on a single morning ; Lawsky and Bharara had to negotiate 30 bail packages .
Translation: 30名黑手党成员在一个上午悉数落网；劳斯基和巴拉拉不得不就30份保释方案展开谈判。

Query_Text_en: As the arrests went down , Bharara , the lead prosecutor , placed calls to mob lawyers representing the criminals .
Translation: 随着逮捕行动展开，首席检察官巴拉拉致电了代表这些罪犯的黑帮律师。

Query_Text_en: When the secretary answered , he asked to speak to the lawyer involved .
Translation: 秘书接听电话时，他要求与案件代理律师通话。

Query_Text_en: `` This is Preet Bharara and Ben Lawsky calling , '' he said .
Translation: "我是普利特·巴拉拉和本·劳斯基，"他说道。

Query_Text_en: Lawsky says this went on and on .
Translation: 劳斯基称，这一情况持续了很长时间。

Query_Text_en: Finally , he says , `` on the fifth call , the woman picks up , and -LSB- Bharara -RSB- looks at me with sort of a wry smile and says , ` Is so-and-so there ? ' She says , ` Yes , who 's calling ? '
Translation: 最后，他说：“打到第五次时，那位女士接起了电话，（巴拉拉）带着一丝苦笑看着我问道：‘某某在吗？’她回答：‘在的，您是哪位？’”

Query_Text_en: Citigroup put another piece of its financial crisis clean up bill behind it .
Translation: 花旗集团又解决了一笔金融危机遗留的清理账单。

Query_Text_en: The bank will pay $ 590 million to investors who bought the company 's stock in the run-up to the financial crisis . The payment settles a class action lawsuit in which the bank 's shareholders claimed Citi 's management misled investors about the health of the bank in 2007 and 2008 .
Translation: 该银行将向金融危机前夕购入其股票的投资者支付5.9亿美元赔偿金。这笔款项用于和解一起集体诉讼，股东指控花旗管理层在2007至2008年间就银行财务状况向投资者作出误导性陈述。

Query_Text_en: Citi went on to receive more than $ 40 billion in taxpayer assistance in late 2008 as part of the TARP bailout fund .
Translation: 2008年末，花旗集团作为"问题资产救助计划"（TARP）纾困基金的受援方，获得了逾400亿美元的纳税人资金援助。

Query_Text_en: Citi denies it did anything wrong , but said it was in the best interests of the bank to settle .
Translation: 花旗银行否认存在任何不当行为，但表示达成和解最符合该行的利益。

Query_Text_en: The settlement is still subject to court approval , which has tripped up Citi in the past .
Translation: 该和解协议仍需获得法院批准，而此前花旗集团曾因此类审批受阻。

Query_Text_en: In a statement , the bank said it has improved its risk management . It also reiterated that the bank plans to return to `` the basics of banking , '' which has been a common refrain recently for Citi CEO Vikram Pandit .
Translation: 该银行在声明中表示已完善风险管理机制，并重申将回归"银行业务本源"——这也是花旗集团首席执行官潘伟迪近期频繁强调的经营理念。

Query_Text_en: The settlement appears to be part of Citi 's stepped up to resolve its remaining financial crisis legal bills .
Translation: 该和解协议似乎是花旗集团为加快解决其金融危机遗留法律费用而采取的措施之一。

Query_Text_en: In the past year , alone , Citi has agreed to $ 2.3 billion in payouts or penalties .
Translation: 仅过去一年，花旗集团就同意支付23亿美元的和解金或罚金。

Query_Text_en: The firm says it could face an additional $ 4 billion in legal bills , but not all of those cases are tied to the housing bust and its aftermath .
Translation: 该公司表示可能面临额外40亿美元的法律费用，但并非所有诉讼案件均与房地产泡沫破裂及其后续影响相关。

Query_Text_en: Citi recently said that it has received inquiries from US and foreign regulators relating to the key lending rate LIBOR , which many contend was manipulated by giant banks .
Translation: 花旗集团近日表示，已收到美国和外国监管机构关于伦敦银行同业拆借利率（LIBOR）的问询。外界普遍指控大型银行曾操纵这一关键贷款利率。

Query_Text_en: Earlier this year , Citi agreed to $ 1.4 billion in penalties to settle claims that it , along with other banks , had mistreated homeowners facing foreclosure .
Translation: 今年早些时候，花旗集团同意支付14亿美元罚金，以了结其与其他银行共同面临的止赎房主不当对待指控。

Query_Text_en: On Wednesday , the monitor overseeing the national mortgage settlement said Citi had completed $ 54 million in mortgage debt reductions as part of the deal .
Translation: 周三，负责监督全国抵押贷款和解协议的监管机构表示，花旗集团已根据协议完成了5400万美元的抵押贷款债务减免。

Query_Text_en: Citi also agreed to pay $ 158 million to federal authorities earlier this year to settle claims that it tricked a government mortgage program into insuring loans that were not eligible for the program .
Translation: 花旗集团今年早些时候还同意向联邦政府支付1.58亿美元，以了结其欺诈政府抵押贷款计划、为不符合条件的贷款提供保险的指控。

Query_Text_en: Citi also agreed to pay $ 285 million to settle Securities and Exchange Commission charges related to a mortgage bond that Citi sold to investors and bet against at the same time .
Translation: 花旗集团还同意支付2.85亿美元，就美国证券交易委员会对其提出的相关指控达成和解。该指控涉及花旗在向投资者出售抵押贷款债券的同时，又对其进行做空交易。

Query_Text_en: That settlement was initially rejected by a judge , and is still pending review .
Translation: 该和解协议最初被法官驳回，目前仍在审查中。

Query_Text_en: While big , the $ 590 million seems like a good deal for Citi .
Translation: 对花旗而言，5.9亿美元虽数额不菲，却堪称一笔划算交易。

Query_Text_en: The settlement covers investors who bought bank 's stock from February 2007 to April 2008 , a period in which Citi 's shares plunged 48 % , resulting in a collective $ 140 billion loss for investors .
Translation: 该和解协议涵盖2007年2月至2008年4月期间购入该行股票的投资者。在此期间，花旗集团股价暴跌48%，导致投资者累计损失达1400亿美元。

Query_Text_en: For banks , it 's getting harder and harder to earn a buck .
Translation: 银行业盈利正变得愈发艰难。

Query_Text_en: In the second quarter , U.S. bank profits fell $ 800 million from the first three months of the year , according a report released by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp. on Tuesday .
Translation: 美国联邦存款保险公司周二发布的报告显示，第二季度美国银行业利润较前三个月下降8亿美元。

Query_Text_en: The drop in profits came despite a significant increase in lending , which jumped $ 102 billion in the second three months of the year , the second largest jump in any quarter since the start of the financial crisis .
Translation: 尽管贷款规模大幅增长——今年第二季度激增1020亿美元，创下金融危机爆发以来单季第二高增幅——银行利润仍出现下滑。

Query_Text_en: But low-interest rates , driven by the Federal Reserve 's efforts to stimulate the economy , mean that new loans are increasingly less profitable , crimping bank profits .
Translation: 然而，美联储为刺激经济而推行的低利率政策，导致新增贷款的盈利能力持续下降，进而挤压了银行利润空间。

Query_Text_en: And that 's not likely to end any time soon .
Translation: 这一局面短期内不会改变。

Query_Text_en: The Fed says it expects to keep short-term interest rates `` exceptionally low '' through 2014 .
Translation: 美联储表示，预计将把短期利率维持在"极低水平"直至2014年。

Query_Text_en: But many economists predict the Fed will soon extend its low-interest-rate pledge through the end of 2015 .
Translation: 但许多经济学家预测，美联储很快会将低利率承诺延长至2015年底。

Query_Text_en: Already some banks are finding it tough to survive .
Translation: 一些银行已陷入生存困境。

Query_Text_en: In August , low-interest rates forced Hudson City Bancorp -LRB- HCBK -RRB- , one of the few banks able to turn a profit during the financial crisis , to sell out to rival M&T Bank -LRB- MTB -RRB- .
Translation: 8月，低利率迫使哈德逊城市银行（HCBK）——金融危机期间少数几家仍能盈利的银行之一——出售给竞争对手M&T银行（MTB）。

Query_Text_en: Still , the banking sector continued to heal from the financial crisis .
Translation: 然而，银行业仍在持续从金融危机中复苏。

Query_Text_en: The number of banks that the FDIC says are in jeopardy of failing dropped to 732 .
Translation: 美国联邦存款保险公司公布的数据显示，面临倒闭风险的银行数量已降至732家。

Query_Text_en: That list had once neared 1,000 .
Translation: 该名单一度接近1000家。

Query_Text_en: What 's more , the number of banks that failed in the quarter dropped to 15 . That was the lowest failure rate in three and a half years .
Translation: 此外，当季破产银行数量降至15家，创下三年半以来的最低纪录。

Query_Text_en: In all , 40 banks have failed since the beginning of 2012 , down from 68 at this time a year ago .
Translation: 2012年初至今，共有40家银行倒闭，较去年同期的68家有所下降。

Query_Text_en: Overall , bank earnings were still a hefty $ 34.5 billion in the second quarter . That was up from $ 28.5 billion in the same quarter a year ago .
Translation: 总体而言，银行业第二季度盈利仍高达345亿美元，较去年同期的285亿美元有所增长。

Query_Text_en: What 's more , the quarter included a huge drop in trading revenues , driven in large part by missteps by JPMorgan Chase 's -LRB- JPM -RRB- so-called London Whale , which resulted in the bank taking $ 4.4 billion loss on credit derivatives bets in the quarter .
Translation: 此外，该季度交易收入大幅下滑，主要归因于摩根大通(JPM)所谓"伦敦鲸"的交易失误，导致该行当季在信用衍生品押注上蒙受44亿美元损失。

Query_Text_en: Without that , bank profits would have been better overall , though it 's not clear how much .
Translation: 若非如此，银行业整体利润本会更高，尽管具体幅度尚不明确。

Query_Text_en: Still , FDIC officials said much of the profit boost from a year ago came from banks putting less money aside for future loan losses , and not from an improvement in their actual business .
Translation: 然而，联邦存款保险公司官员表示，与去年同期相比，利润增长主要源于银行减少了未来贷款损失的拨备金，而非实际业务状况的改善。

Query_Text_en: Revenue growth from lending and other bank activities continues to be stalled .
Translation: 银行借贷及其他业务收入增长持续停滞。

Query_Text_en: `` There 's only so far that can take you , '' says FDIC Acting Chairman Martin J. Gruenberg .
Translation: “你的能力只能带你走到这里，”美国联邦存款保险公司代理主席马丁·J·格伦伯格表示。

Query_Text_en: `` The rate environment is putting a constraint on the bank revenue growth . ''
Translation: 利率环境正制约着银行营收增长。

Query_Text_en: The question is how banks will respond .
Translation: 问题在于银行将如何应对。

Query_Text_en: Fed Chairman Ben Bernanke says one of his main reasons for his policy to push down interest rates is to boost lending .
Translation: 美联储主席本•伯南克表示，他实行压低利率政策的主要目的之一是增加贷款。

Query_Text_en: But it 's not clearBernanke 's latest plan will make banks want to lend more .
Translation: 但尚不清楚伯南克的最新计划能否促使银行增加放贷。

Query_Text_en: Instead , falling profits , driven by low-interest rates , could cause banks to lend less , particularly at a time when they are still trying to build back the capital they lost during the financial crisis .
Translation: 相反，低利率导致的利润下滑可能促使银行减少放贷，尤其是在它们仍试图重建金融危机期间损失的资本金之际。

Query_Text_en: On the other hand , some banks may decide they have to dramatically boost lending in order to keep up profit growth at a time when they are making less and less on each individual loan .
Translation: 另一方面，部分银行可能认为必须大幅增加放贷规模，才能在单笔贷款利润持续缩水的背景下维持盈利增长。

Query_Text_en: What 's clear is that Bernanke is trying to thread an incredible small needle head .
Translation: 显而易见，伯南克正试图在极其狭窄的空间中穿针引线。

Query_Text_en: L'affaire Standard Chartered Bank -LRB- i.e. , Iranian money laundering -RRB- takes center stage tomorrow with an expected meeting between senior bank executives and Benjamin Lawsky , superintendent of the New York Department of Financial Services .
Translation: 渣打银行(Standard Chartered Bank)（即伊朗洗钱案）的相关事宜明日将成为众人关注的焦点，届时该行高管预计将与纽约州金融服务管理局(New York Department of Financial Services)局长本杰明•劳斯基(Benjamin Lawsky)会面。

Query_Text_en: Recall that Lawsky just last week unilaterally castigated the UK-based bank for brazenly and wantonly eviscerating state and federal banking rules against dealing with Iranian entities .
Translation: 需知就在上周，劳斯基还单方面谴责这家英国银行公然肆意践踏美国州和联邦关于与伊朗实体交易的银行业监管规定。

Query_Text_en: Lawsky one-upped the Federal Reserve , the U.S. Treasury and other regulators in his aggressive move against Standard Chartered .
Translation: 劳斯基对渣打银行采取的强硬举措，令美联储、美国财政部及其他监管机构相形见绌。

Query_Text_en: Regulators across the pond have been quick to condemn Lawsky and have certainly expressed their disgust to their counterparts in Washington .
Translation: 大西洋彼岸的监管机构迅速对劳斯基提出谴责，并已向华盛顿的同僚明确表达了不满。

Query_Text_en: Standard Chartered clearly is very concerned about the possibility of having its New York banking license revoked .
Translation: 渣打银行显然对可能被吊销纽约银行执照一事深感忧虑。

Query_Text_en: As such , the likelihood of a negotiated fine coordinated on behalf of all regulatory agencies would seem to be increasing .
Translation: 因此，由各监管机构协商达成统一罚款方案的可能性似乎正在上升。

Query_Text_en: Stop the music and the drama .
Translation: 停止音乐和戏剧表演。

Query_Text_en: I think I would speak for an overwhelming majority of the public both here in America and in the UK and tell Standard Chartered : `` Keep your money .
Translation: 我认为我可以代表美国和英国绝大多数民众对渣打银行说："你们的钱自己留着吧。"

Query_Text_en: There will be no fine .
Translation: 不会处以罚款。

Query_Text_en: What there will be is a thorough independent investigation in pursuit of the truth . ''
Translation: 将开展彻底的独立调查以查明真相。

Query_Text_en: If it gets ugly , so be it .
Translation: 若事态恶化，也只能如此。

Query_Text_en: If we learn that Standard Chartered did not end run our banking rules , then good for them and they will be stronger for it .
Translation: 若我们确认渣打银行未曾规避我国银行业监管规定，那对其而言实属幸事，其经营根基也将因此更为稳固。

Query_Text_en: If we learn that our major regulatory agencies were slow to move against Standard Chartered for whatever reason -LRB- perhaps in return for similar treatment by UK regulators in dealings with US-based institutions -RRB- , let 's air that laundry .
Translation: 如果我们发现主要监管机构因任何原因（或许是为换取英国监管机构对在英美国金融机构的同等对待）迟迟未对渣打银行采取行动，那就应当公开这些内情。

Query_Text_en: The last thing I want to see is a fine .
Translation: 我最不愿看到的就是罚款。

Query_Text_en: Better that Standard Chartered pays not a penny than we suffer again from not truly knowing and learning the truth .
Translation: 与其让渣打银行分文不赔，倒不如让我们彻底认清真相、汲取教训，以免重蹈覆辙。

Query_Text_en: A fine only serves to suffocate the truth .
Translation: 罚款只会压制真相。

Query_Text_en: The public has been suffocated enough by fines against the likes of Wachovia , HSBC , Barclays Bank , UBS , Goldman Sachs and seemingly every other major financial institution .
Translation: 公众早已对针对富国银行、汇丰银行、巴克莱银行、瑞银集团、高盛等几乎所有大型金融机构的罚款感到窒息。

Query_Text_en: When a bank is merely fined for dealing with a rogue nation such as Iran , that payment is nothing more than blood money .
Translation: 当一家银行仅因与伊朗等流氓国家往来而被罚款时，这笔款项无异于沾满鲜血的赎罪金。

Query_Text_en: A fine does not rebuild confidence but erodes it dramatically because the public is aware that the truth remains under wraps .
Translation: 罚款非但不能重建公众信任，反而会严重削弱信任，因为民众深知真相仍被掩盖。

Query_Text_en: What rebuilds confidence ? The truth .
Translation: 什么能重建信心？真相。

Query_Text_en: If the truth exposes ugly practices within Standard Chartered and similarly lax oversight from regulators , then so be it .
Translation: 若真相揭露渣打银行内部的丑恶行径及监管机构的同样失职，那便顺其自然。

Query_Text_en: A healthy serving of embarrassment is far less important than a rebuilding of trust and confidence for our global economy .
Translation: 重建全球经济所需的信任与信心，远比对失误的过度苛责重要得多。

Query_Text_en: In delivering the truth , the public and our global economy will be reinvigorated by fresh air filling our collective lungs .
Translation: 真相的传递将为公众和全球经济注入新的活力，如同新鲜空气充盈我们的肺腑。

Query_Text_en: Tim Geithner , Ben Bernanke , Mervyn King and others should all stand down and at long last let the truth stand up .
Translation: 蒂莫西·盖特纳、本·伯南克、默文·金等人都应引咎辞职，真理终将水落石出。

Query_Text_en: Larry is a Wall Street veteran , having worked at such banks as First Boston , Bear Stearns and Union Bank .
Translation: 拉里是华尔街资深人士，曾先后任职于第一波士顿银行、贝尔斯登和联合银行等金融机构。

Query_Text_en: Goldman Sachs has come into a run of luck -- or so it seems .
Translation: 高盛近来可谓鸿运当头——至少表面看来如此。

Query_Text_en: The SEC has dropped its investigation into the bank 's disclosures related to the sale of subprime mortgages .
Translation: 美国证券交易委员会已终止对该银行次贷销售信息披露问题的调查。

Query_Text_en: And the DOJ has dropped its criminal probe into allegations stemming from a 635-page Congressional report that described how Goldman profited by betting against clients and appeared to have misled customers .
Translation: 美国司法部已终止对高盛集团涉嫌欺诈客户指控的刑事调查。该指控源自一份长达635页的国会报告，该报告详细披露了高盛通过做空客户头寸牟利，并存在误导投资者的行为。

Query_Text_en: And while Goldman -LRB- GS -RRB- itself appears to be off the hook , Manhattan prosecutors are going after one of its former employees , who allegedly copied Goldman programs before leaving the firm .
Translation: 尽管高盛集团(GS)本身似乎已免于追责，但曼哈顿检方正对其一名前雇员提起诉讼。该员工据称在离职前复制了高盛的程序代码。

Query_Text_en: The defense has raised concerns that this prosecution may be violating the fifth amendment of the constitution since the former employee had already served time for the matter before his federal conviction was overturned , the New York Times reported .
Translation: 据《纽约时报》报道，辩方提出质疑，认为此次起诉可能违反宪法第五修正案，因为该前雇员在联邦定罪被推翻前已为此事服刑。

Query_Text_en: David Wells , a Goldman spokesperson , declined to comment to news outlets on the SEC decision to drop its investigation , but regarding the DOJ decision to drop the criminal investigation , he reportedly told reporters , `` We are pleased that this matter is behind us . ''
Translation: 高盛发言人戴维·韦尔斯拒绝对美国证交会终止调查的决定向媒体发表评论，但对于司法部撤销刑事调查的决定，据悉他向记者表示："我们很高兴此事已尘埃落定。"

Query_Text_en: While the heat has been on banks like J.P. Morgan -LRB- JPM -RRB- , Barclays -LRB- BCS -RRB- , and Standard Chartered , Goldman has gotten a bit of a pass for the past few months .
Translation: 尽管摩根大通（JPM）、巴克莱（BCS）和渣打等银行一直备受压力，但高盛在过去几个月里却得以稍事喘息。

Query_Text_en: But here it is , front and center once more -- and despite its spokesman 's statement , it is not clear that Goldman will ever be able , in full measure , to put these matters behind it .
Translation: 然而，这一问题如今再度成为焦点核心——尽管高盛发言人已发表声明，但尚不清楚该公司能否彻底摆脱这些事件的阴影。

Query_Text_en: Goldman 's reputation continues to receive low marks .
Translation: 高盛集团的声誉评分持续低迷。

Query_Text_en: In an analyst report published by CLSA today , Mike Mayo and Matt Fischer -- who rate the bank an outperform -- write that although there was no criminal charge , `` we still believe that the CEO performed terribly during the Congressional hearings . ''
Translation: 在今天CLSA发布的一份分析师报告中，迈克·梅奥和马特·费舍尔写道：尽管没有刑事指控，"我们仍然认为首席执行官在国会听证会上的表现糟糕透顶"。这两位分析师给予该银行"跑赢大盘"评级。

Query_Text_en: Damning with faint praise , they say they `` trust this management team ... about as much as any large bank . ''
Translation: 他们语带保留地表示，"对这家银行管理团队的信任程度……与对任何大型银行差不多"，这种评价实则暗含贬义。

Query_Text_en: They may be right that in the very short term , this puts Goldman `` relatively less in the political cross-hairs . ''
Translation: 他们或许是对的：就极短期而言，这会让高盛"相对较少成为政治攻击的靶心"。

Query_Text_en: But that is a very short-term horizon because the convergence of dropped investigations has the potential to awaken more public demands .
Translation: 但这一局面仅是短期现象，因为调查中止事件的集中爆发可能引发更强烈的公众诉求。

Query_Text_en: The lack of accountability during the financial crisis , which was a tear in the faith in governmental and banking institutions , is turning into a giant rip that may never be repaired .
Translation: 金融危机期间问责机制的缺失，曾一度撕裂公众对政府及银行机构的信任；如今这一裂痕正演变为可能永远无法弥合的鸿沟。

Query_Text_en: This is causing particular concern now since this may be the last hope for financial crisis-related accountability before November 's elections .
Translation: 当前这一情况尤为令人担忧，因为这可能是11月大选前追究金融危机责任的最后机会。

Query_Text_en: While Goldman may not pay the full brunt of the price for the lost trust in the financial system , the outcomes are likely to continue to ripple across the system .
Translation: 尽管高盛可能不会为金融体系信任丧失承担全部代价，但其影响仍将持续在整个体系中蔓延。

Query_Text_en: In the short run , Goldman and other big banks may be emboldened -- which means we will continue to see more of the same .
Translation: 短期内，高盛等大型银行可能会更加肆无忌惮——这意味着我们将继续目睹类似事件不断上演。

Query_Text_en: In the event these firms enter a tailspin , as they did a few short years ago , it is clear there is potential for real consequences , not just to the firms themselves but for the system as a whole .
Translation: 一旦这些企业陷入困境——正如短短数年前所发生的那样——显然将产生实质性影响，不仅波及企业自身，更将危及整个金融体系。

Query_Text_en: A Reuters report late yesterday discussed requirements that banks submit not only resolution but also recovery plans .
Translation: 路透社昨日晚些时候报道称，监管机构要求银行不仅须提交处置计划，还需制定恢复计划。

Query_Text_en: The report included a link to a closed-door presentation that J.P. Morgan made at Harvard Law School in March .
Translation: 报告附有摩根大通3月份在哈佛法学院一场闭门演示的链接。

Query_Text_en: Raising the specter of Reg FD -LRB- Regulation Fair Disclosure -RRB- , which prohibits companies from disclosing material information to some groups instead of others , the details presented to the Harvard attendees were in some respect more extensive than those provided to the public in July on J.P. Morgan 's resolution plans .
Translation: 这让人联想到《公平披露条例》(Regulation Fair Disclosure)，该条例禁止企业向特定群体选择性披露重大信息。摩根大通向哈佛与会者展示的决议计划细节，在某些方面比7月向公众披露的内容更为详尽。

Query_Text_en: Public J.P. Morgan documents say that the firm provides transparent financial information for `` analysts to assess the Firm 's financial position . ''
Translation: 摩根大通公开文件显示，该机构向分析师提供透明的财务信息，以便"评估公司财务状况"。

Query_Text_en: But as Peter Eavis at the New York Times pointed out yesterday , the bank is n't disclosing a number everyone would like to know : the `` overall size of the derivatives bets that have led to large losses and much reputational damage for the bank . ''
Translation: 但正如《纽约时报》的彼得·埃维斯昨日所指出的那样，该银行并未披露一个所有人都想知道的数据："那些给他们带来巨额损失并严重损害银行声誉的衍生品交易总规模"。

Query_Text_en: The public documents also state that any wind-down would occur with `` minimum systemic disruption and without losses to taxpayers . '' But J.P. Morgan 's Harvard presentation outlines the potential for a $ 200 billion liquidity infusion from the FDIC in such a scenario .
Translation: 公开文件还指出，任何清算行动都将在"对金融体系造成最小干扰且不使纳税人蒙受损失"的前提下进行。但摩根大通在哈佛大学的演示文稿中概述了此类情形下联邦存款保险公司可能需注资2000亿美元以提供流动性支持。

Query_Text_en: And if J.P. Morgan could not pay the billions back , other banks would have to .
Translation: 若摩根大通无力偿还这数十亿美元，其他银行将不得不代为偿付。

Query_Text_en: `` If the FDIC is not repaid it will assess the industry to cover any losses , '' the presentation states .
Translation: 演示文件指出："若联邦存款保险公司未能收回资金，将通过向全行业征收费用来弥补损失。"

Query_Text_en: Jack Bogle recently told me that the battle for the soul of capitalism was not yet lost but that the system was in need of great repair .
Translation: 杰克·博格尔最近告诉我，资本主义灵魂之战尚未落败，但这一体系亟需重大修复。

Query_Text_en: It will take a larger groundswell of business people standing up to demand that their fellows be held accountable and that the proper relationship between government and big business be restored to set us on that path .
Translation: 唯有更多商界人士挺身而出，要求同行承担责任、重建政府与大企业间的良性关系，方能引领我们走上这条复兴之路。

Query_Text_en: Standard Chartered may be down , but it is certainly not out .
Translation: 渣打银行虽遭重创，但远未出局。

Query_Text_en: While it appears that the bank is in very hot water with state regulators over its business dealings with the Islamic Republic of Iran , its story is far from unique .
Translation: 尽管该银行因与伊朗伊斯兰共和国的商业往来而陷入监管机构的严厉审查，但此类事件绝非个案。

Query_Text_en: That may be why senior bankers and portfolio managers in the City of London do n't seem too worried about the beating Standard Chartered 's stock has taken in the past few days after New York State regulators threw the book at the bank on Monday .
Translation: 这或许可以解释，为何纽约州监管机构本周一重拳出击渣打银行、导致其股价连日重挫之际，伦敦金融城的高级银行家和投资组合经理们似乎并不太担忧。

Query_Text_en: Talk that the bank could lose its ability to work and trade in the state is being dismissed as simply `` loony . ''
Translation: 关于该银行可能丧失在该州经营与交易资格的传言，被斥为纯属"无稽之谈"。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , the company 's stock and bonds are expected to trade at a discount to its peers until the bank either resolves the issue or sets aside the cash to deal with it .
Translation: 然而，在该银行解决问题或拨备资金应对之前，预计其股票和债券的交易价格仍将低于同业水平。

Query_Text_en: It was n't too long ago that the big European banks actually flaunted their close relationship with entities connected to Iran .
Translation: 就在不久前，欧洲大型银行还曾公开炫耀与伊朗相关实体的密切关系。

Query_Text_en: Bankers would take regular trips to Dubai and Tehran to court the mullahs and their apparatchiks to secure a piece of the nation 's business .
Translation: 银行家们定期前往迪拜和德黑兰，向伊朗宗教领袖及其官僚示好，以争取在该国的业务份额。

Query_Text_en: As a major oil exporter , Iran engaged in a number of big dollar-denominated transactions and needed a way to recycle that cash through the international banking system .
Translation: 作为主要石油出口国，伊朗进行了大量美元计价交易，需要通过国际银行体系实现资金回流。

Query_Text_en: But it was n't all risk free for the banks .
Translation: 但银行并非完全没有风险。

Query_Text_en: In 2004 , UBS was singled out by U.S. government officials for engaging in transactions over a seven-year period with Iran and other `` rogue '' nations , including Cuba , Libya and Yugoslavia -- all in violation of U.S. sanctions .
Translation: 2004年，瑞银集团因在七年期间与伊朗及其他"流氓"国家（包括古巴、利比亚和南斯拉夫）进行交易而遭到美国政府官员点名批评——这些交易均违反了美国制裁令。

Query_Text_en: The bank settled quickly with U.S. regulators , paying $ 100 million to the US Treasury as penance .
Translation: 该银行迅速与美国监管机构达成和解，向美国财政部支付1亿美元作为罚金。

Query_Text_en: While it was never disclosed how much UBS gained from its dealing with the four nations , it was generally viewed to be a fraction of the fine handed down by the U.S. government .
Translation: 尽管瑞银与四国交易的具体获利从未公开，但普遍认为其数额仅为美国政府所处罚金的一小部分。

Query_Text_en: Even with the fine UBS continued to do business in Iran , not pulling out officially until late 2006 .
Translation: 即便遭到罚款，瑞银集团仍继续在伊朗开展业务，直至2006年底才正式退出。

Query_Text_en: For a while , that was no matter for Iran , which still had plenty of European banks willing to help it move its hoard of U.S. dollars through the banking system .
Translation: 有一段时间，这对伊朗来说无关紧要，因为仍有不少欧洲银行愿意通过金融体系帮助其转移囤积的美元资金。

Query_Text_en: All that changed when the Obama administration decided to step up pressure on Iran 's banking sector in a bid to get Tehran to give up its supposed nuclear weapons program .
Translation: 奥巴马政府决定加大对伊朗银行业的施压力度，以迫使德黑兰放弃其所谓的核武器计划，自此局势彻底改变。

Query_Text_en: `` Banks were essentially put on notice that the government was no longer looking the other way , '' a London-based banker who did business in Iran during that time tells Fortune .
Translation: "银行实际上已收到明确信号：政府不会再对此视而不见，"一位当时在伊朗开展业务的伦敦银行家向《财富》杂志透露。

Query_Text_en: From September of 2009 to last month , federal regulators levied fines on at least six international banks for their dealings with Iran in the previous decade . Among them were a number of British banks including Lloyd 's TSB , which paid a fine of $ 350 million ; Barclays -LRB- BCS -RRB- , which paid $ 176 million ; and HSBC , which has yet to have a fine levied against it .
Translation: 2009年9月至上月期间，美国联邦监管机构对至少六家国际银行过去十年与伊朗的业务往来处以罚款。其中包括多家英国银行：劳埃德银行(Lloyd's TSB)被罚3.5亿美元、巴克莱银行(Barclays)被罚1.76亿美元，而汇丰银行(HSBC)尚未被处以罚款。

Query_Text_en: Standard Chartered was simply the next in line to take a hit .
Translation: 渣打银行不过是下一个遭受冲击的对象。

Query_Text_en: But it was n't just UK-based banks that were served .
Translation: 但受影响的并非仅限于总部设在英国的银行。

Query_Text_en: The Feds also went after continental banks like Societe General of France , which paid a fine of $ 100,000 and Credit Suisse , which paid $ 536 million .
Translation: 美联储还对法国兴业银行（罚款1亿美元）和瑞士信贷（罚款5.36亿美元）等欧洲大陆银行采取了处罚措施。

Query_Text_en: Even U.S. banks were caught in the Iranian cookie jar , with JP Morgan -LRB- JPM -RRB- fined $ 88 million for its role in violating US sanctions law , including those connected with Iran .
Translation: 就连美国银行也牵涉伊朗相关违规行为——摩根大通(JPMorgan)因违反美国制裁法律（包括与伊朗有关的制裁）被处以8800万美元罚款。

Query_Text_en: What appears to be different this time with Standard Chartered -LRB- SCBFF -RRB- is that NY State filed its complaint against the bank alone .
Translation: 渣打银行（SCBFF）此次事件的不同之处在于，纽约州单独对该行提起了诉讼。

Query_Text_en: Regulators in Washington , which usually lead any investigation , typically handle things in a more discreet way , announcing the violation and the fine at the same time to avoid a situation where the bank would be in limbo .
Translation: 华盛顿的监管机构通常主导所有调查，其行事风格更为审慎——他们会同时公布违规行为与罚款金额，以避免银行陷入悬而未决的困境。

Query_Text_en: Where the Feds announced the violation before the fine was issued , the government may have hinted to what the fine could be to the banks .
Translation: 在罚款决定公布前，若联邦监管机构已先行通报违规行为，则政府可能已向相关银行暗示过处罚金额。

Query_Text_en: HSBC , for example , is currently in limbo like Standard Charter for similar violations , but has set aside $ 700 million to absorb any potential fine .
Translation: 例如，汇丰银行目前与渣打银行一样因类似违规行为处于监管悬而未决的状态，但已拨备7亿美元以应对可能的罚款。

Query_Text_en: The government alleges that HSBC engaged in unscrupulous transactions with rogue nations , including Iran , with a total notional amount of around $ 20 billion .
Translation: 政府指控汇丰银行与伊朗等流氓国家进行了不正当交易，名义总金额约达200亿美元。

Query_Text_en: Like the other major international banks , Standard Chartered was allegedly more than happy to help Iran with its banking needs .
Translation: 与其他大型国际银行一样，渣打银行据称也极为乐意为伊朗提供银行服务。

Query_Text_en: The bank , meanwhile , says it could only find $ 14 million worth of transactions that might have tripped the wire .
Translation: 与此同时，该银行表示仅能查找到价值1400万美元的可疑交易。

Query_Text_en: There is clearly some disconnect here .
Translation: 此处显然存在某种脱节。

Query_Text_en: In any case , given what HSBC has put aside , analysts believe that Standard Chartered will end up paying a fine of around $ 1.5 billion .
Translation: 无论如何，考虑到汇丰已计提的拨备金额，分析师预计渣打最终将支付约15亿美元的罚款。

Query_Text_en: That seems a bit arbitrary , but it is far less than the $ 17 billion that the market chopped off the bank 's market value in Tuesday 's trading .
Translation: 这一数字看似有些武断，但远低于周二交易日市场抹去的该银行170亿美元市值。

Query_Text_en: Investors are betting that the bank will be barred from doing business in New York , threatening its U.S. dollar clearing operations , which make up an estimated 15 % -20 % of the bank 's total revenues .
Translation: 投资者押注该银行将被禁止在纽约开展业务，这将危及其美元清算业务——该业务约占该行总收入的15%至20%。

Query_Text_en: Equity analysts that follow the bank believe that it will in no way lose its license , especially as it was Standard Chartered that reported the violations voluntarily to the government during the 2010 crackdown .
Translation: 跟踪研究该银行的分析师认为，其牌照绝不会被吊销，尤其考虑到渣打银行是在2010年监管整顿期间主动向政府报告了违规行为。

Query_Text_en: But even if it does lose its New York license , it does n't have to give up its clearing operations .
Translation: 但即便真被吊销纽约牌照，该行也无需放弃其清算业务。

Query_Text_en: It could set up shop in another banking center in a different city and state , like Chicago , Il. , Stamford , CT. , or even Charlotte , N.C. . It is not expected to get to that point , but there are still options on the table if need be .
Translation: 该行可选择在其他州或城市的金融中心设立分支机构，例如伊利诺伊州芝加哥、康涅狄格州斯坦福德，乃至北卡罗来纳州夏洛特。虽然事态预计不会发展到这一步，但必要时仍有多种备选方案可供考虑。

Query_Text_en: In any case , it looks like the market is ready to give Standard Chartered the benefit of the doubt as the bank 's stock moved up 6 % in early trading Wednesday in Europe .
Translation: 无论如何，市场似乎已准备给予渣打银行一定信任空间——周三欧洲早盘时段，该行股价上涨6%。

Query_Text_en: But the firm 's stock is still down 15 % for the week .
Translation: 但该公司股价本周仍累计下跌15%。

Query_Text_en: Analysts warn that the stock will probably continue trading at depressed levels until the bank either pays the fine or sets aside a good chunk of money as a provision .
Translation: 分析人士警告称，除非该银行缴纳罚款或拨备大笔资金，否则其股价可能持续在低位徘徊。

Query_Text_en: It is unclear when or if the bank will act .
Translation: 目前尚不清楚该银行何时或是否会采取行动。

Query_Text_en: For now , Peter Sands , Standard Chartered Chief Executive does n't seem too concerned .
Translation: 目前，渣打集团行政总裁庞德明似乎并未表现出过度忧虑。

Query_Text_en: Despite all the whirlwind , he packed his bags last night and set off for his summer vacation .
Translation: 尽管事务缠身，他昨晚仍收拾行装，动身前往避暑胜地。

Query_Text_en: CEO Thomas Joyce explained in a television interview that the company 's new software program sent thousands of erroneous trades into the market because of `` a large bug . ''
Translation: 首席执行官托马斯·乔伊斯在电视采访中解释称，由于"一个重大系统漏洞"，该公司的新软件程序向市场发送了数千笔错误交易。

Query_Text_en: This was software Knight introduced Wednesday in conjunction with the New York Stock Exchange 's new platform that allows market makers like Knight -LRB- KCG -RRB- to offer slightly discounted stock prices to retail investors .
Translation: 骑士公司(Knight)周三与纽约证券交易所(NYSE)联合推出的这款软件，使骑士(KCG)等做市商能够以略低的价格向散户投资者提供股票。

Query_Text_en: The problem is n't that Knight is a renegade operator -- its reputation has improved over the past 15 years .
Translation: 问题并不在于骑士公司是一家违规经营机构——过去15年间，该公司的声誉已有所改善。

Query_Text_en: The problem is that trading software can never be 100 % perfect , say computer programmers , especially when it 's new and introduced into a complex system like the stock market .
Translation: 计算机程序员指出，问题在于交易软件永远无法做到百分之百完美，尤其是当新软件被引入股票市场这类复杂系统时。

Query_Text_en: That aspect of electronic trading , which dominates today 's stock market , will certainly cause more crises in the near future .
Translation: 当今股市中占据主导地位的电子交易模式，势必在不久的将来引发更多危机。

Query_Text_en: `` Because it has so many lines of code and so many variables , the number of different states that software can be in can become -LSB- an -RSB- enormous number -- 10 to the 100th power , '' says Ed Schlesinger , head of Carnegie Mellon University 's electrical and computer engineering department .
Translation: "由于其庞大的代码量和变量数目，软件可能进入的不同状态数量可能达到一个天文数字——10的100次方。"卡内基梅隆大学电子与计算机工程系主任埃德·施莱辛格表示。

Query_Text_en: Carefully reviewing lines of software code is n't impossible , he says .
Translation: 他表示，仔细审查软件代码并非不可能。

Query_Text_en: Math theorems can do the testing .
Translation: 数学定理可完成验证。

Query_Text_en: What is impossible , though , is judging how one firm 's software -- Knight 's , for example -- will interact with the thousands of other algorithms rushing into and out of the market .
Translation: 然而，真正难以判断的是某家公司的软件（例如骑士资本的交易系统）将如何与市场上数千种高频进出的其他算法程序产生交互作用。

Query_Text_en: That can only occur when the software is in actual use .
Translation: 唯有在实际使用该软件时，此情况方会出现。

Query_Text_en: Schlesinger chuckles at the notion of perfect trading software .
Translation: 施莱辛格对所谓完美交易软件的说法付之一笑。

Query_Text_en: Pundits and politicians have called for more stringent standards of trading programs , essentially advocating for bug-proof code .
Translation: 专家与政界人士呼吁对交易程序实施更严格的标准，实质上是在主张推行无漏洞代码。

Query_Text_en: That , he responds , is impossible .
Translation: 他回应称，这绝无可能。

Query_Text_en: It would be akin to sidelining a wide receiver until he catches every football in every practice against every opposing defensive scheme .
Translation: 这无异于让一名外接手坐冷板凳，直到他在每次训练中面对各种防守战术都能接住所有传球。

Query_Text_en: Unfortunately for Knight , what made it so successful over the past 15 years -- its growing size -- worked against it this week .
Translation: 奈特的不幸在于，过去15年助其成功的规模扩张策略，本周却适得其反。

Query_Text_en: Unlike other high-frequency traders , who can flip the off-switch the instant they sense trouble , market makers like Knight , which use algorithms to match buyers and sellers from diverse clients such as Scottrade and Vanguard , are required to stay open for business unless there 's a major error .
Translation: 与其他高频交易商不同——后者一旦察觉风险便可立即停止交易——像骑士资本这样的做市商必须维持正常运营，除非出现重大故障。骑士资本采用算法为史考特证券、先锋集团等各类客户匹配买卖双方。

Query_Text_en: They can trade thousands of shares before waking up to the problem .
Translation: 他们可能在发现问题前就已交易了数千股。

Query_Text_en: `` Market makers are required to stay in the market , '' says Bernard Donefer , a professor of information systems in financial markets at Baruch College and New York University 's Stern School .
Translation: 伯纳德·多尼弗说道，"做市商必须驻守市场。"这位教授在巴鲁克学院及纽约大学斯特恩商学院负责金融市场信息系统课程的教研工作。

Query_Text_en: Volatility , therefore , affects market makers more than it does the high-frequency-traders whizzing in and out of stocks all day .
Translation: 因此，波动性对做市商的影响远大于那些全天频繁进出股票市场的高频交易者。

Query_Text_en: `` If I 'm someone else , I can just say , ` Hmm , let me stop trading for a while , ' '' says Donefer .
Translation: 多尼弗表示："如果我是其他人，我大可以说'嗯，让我暂停交易一段时间'。"

Query_Text_en: `` They do n't have nearly the amount of orders that a market maker does . ''
Translation: "他们的订单量远不及做市商。"

Query_Text_en: Instead of pursuing perfect programs , Donefer says , regulators should focus on minimizing the damage when the program 's algorithms go haywire ; say , cancel all trades within a 30-minute window .
Translation: 多恩弗指出，监管机构不应追求程序完美无缺，而应着力于当程序算法失控时将损害降至最低——例如取消30分钟窗口期内的所有交易。

Query_Text_en: In fact , that sentiment is behind the calls of some to reinstate human market makers on the New York Stock Exchange .
Translation: 事实上，正是出于这种考虑，才有人呼吁纽约证券交易所重新启用人工做市商制度。

Query_Text_en: Humans move much slower than computers , and are more likely to sniff out irregularities before they metastasize to unmanageable levels .
Translation: 人类行动速度远不及计算机，但更善于在异常情况恶化至不可控程度前及时察觉。

Query_Text_en: But to revert to the clubby , monopolistic days of human NYSE market makers would be to throw away two decades of improvement .
Translation: 但若回归到纽约证券交易所人工做市商那种小圈子垄断的时代，无异于抛弃二十年来取得的进步成果。

Query_Text_en: And it 's simply not going to happen .
Translation: 这根本不可能实现。

Query_Text_en: `` Right now , you got the lowest spreads , the most liquidity , the fastest trading -- it 's a pretty good market for most people , '' says Donefer .
Translation: "眼下点差最低、流动性最强、交易速度最快——对大多数人来说，这是个相当不错的市场，"多内弗表示。

Query_Text_en: Market makers like Knight may occasionally blow up , and trades may have to be cancelled .
Translation: 像骑士证券这样的做市商偶尔也可能崩盘，相关交易或不得不取消。

Query_Text_en: But that 's the cost of today 's high-speed electronic markets , and , for most people , it 's probably a fair trade off .
Translation: 但这就是当今高速电子化市场的代价，对大多数人而言，这或许是个公平的取舍。

Query_Text_en: In life there are few coincidences , and this one probably is n't either : The day Knight Capital Group 's computers nearly blew up the market and lost the firm $ 440 million in 45 minutes is the same day that the New York Stock Exchange -LRB- NYX -RRB- launched a new trading system that was , in part , meant to take business away from Knight -LRB- KCG -RRB- .
Translation: 人生少有巧合，这次恐怕也不例外：骑士资本集团的计算机系统几乎引爆市场、导致该公司在45分钟内巨亏4.4亿美元的当天，纽约证券交易所(NYX)恰好启用了新的交易系统——该系统部分旨在从骑士资本(KCG)手中争夺业务。

Query_Text_en: For the past half decade or so , there has been a tug of war over who completes the buy and sell orders for stocks that average investors like you and I make .
Translation: 过去五年左右，普通投资者如你我下达的股票买卖指令由谁执行，一直存在激烈争夺。

Query_Text_en: It used to happen in the pits of the NYSE . These days , almost none of the trades that folks like you and I make ever get to the exchange .
Translation: 过去，这类交易都发生在纽约证券交易所的交易大厅。如今，像你我这样的普通投资者所进行的交易，几乎都不会进入交易所。

Query_Text_en: Instead , they get cut off , diverted into the computer systems of Knight or its main competitors Citadel , Citigroup and UBS , which match those with the millions of other orders they collect .
Translation: 相反，这些订单会被拦截并转入骑士资本或其主要竞争对手——城堡证券、花旗集团和瑞银集团的计算机系统。这些系统将客户订单与其收集的数百万其他订单进行撮合交易。

Query_Text_en: And the pace at which these firms have been able to divert traffic from the NYSE has been accelerating .
Translation: 而这些公司从纽约证券交易所分流交易量的速度一直在加快。

Query_Text_en: In 2009 , about 15 % of all trades took place away from the NYSE .
Translation: 2009年，约15%的交易在纽约证券交易所场外进行。

Query_Text_en: Now about a third of all the trades in NYSE-listed shares happen elsewhere .
Translation: 如今纽约证券交易所上市股票约三分之一的交易量发生在其他交易平台。

Query_Text_en: It 's not clear why this battle over individual stock trades is so pitched .
Translation: 目前尚不清楚为何这场围绕个股交易的争论如此激烈。

Query_Text_en: Knight pays brokers for its so-called order flow . And it guarantees that individuals get a slightly better price than what they would get at the exchange .
Translation: 骑士公司为其所谓的订单流向经纪商支付费用，并保证个人投资者获得比交易所略优的价格。

Query_Text_en: Those stock trades get fed into Knight 's computers , which use lightning fast trading algorithms to figure out how to make money off the orders the firm has just paid up for .
Translation: 这些股票交易数据被输入骑士资本的计算机系统，其内置的闪电级快速交易算法会立即分析如何从公司刚高价购得的交易指令中获利。

Query_Text_en: This is , in part , the high frequency trading that you have heard about .
Translation: 这在一定程度上就是您所听闻的高频交易。

Query_Text_en: Some say that market makers provide a service .
Translation: 有人认为做市商发挥着重要的市场服务功能。

Query_Text_en: Others say Knight and others seek out the orders of individual investors because they view those orders as so-called dumb flow and easier to trade against .
Translation: 也有人认为，奈特等人之所以青睐散户投资者的订单，是因为他们将这类订单视为所谓的"愚钝资金流"，更容易进行反向交易。

Query_Text_en: What is clear is that Knight and others have figured out how to make money off the stock trades of you and me in ways that we ca n't detect but we probably pay for somehow .
Translation: 显而易见的是，奈特等机构已掌握从你我股票交易中获利的手段——这些操作既难以察觉，又很可能最终由我们买单。

Query_Text_en: Eric Scott Hunsader , who runs trading research firm Nanex , estimates market makers have been able to generate $ 5 billion in profits rapidly trading the orders of individual investors and others in the past seven years .
Translation: 运营交易研究公司Nanex的埃里克·斯科特·亨萨德估算，过去七年间做市商通过快速交易个人投资者及其他市场参与者的订单，已累计获利50亿美元。

Query_Text_en: On Wednesday , the same day that Knight lost $ 440 million , the NYSE launched its own computer driven trading system , called the Retail Liquidity Program , that the exchange hopes will reclaim some of the trading volume it has lost to market makers .
Translation: 就在骑士资本亏损4.4亿美元的当天（周三），纽约证交所推出了名为"零售流动性计划"的计算机驱动交易系统，该交易所希望借此从做市商手中夺回部分流失的交易量。

Query_Text_en: Like Knight , the NYSE 's RLP computers use algorithms to figure out when it makes sense to offer a slightly better price than what others are offering , and snatch up stock trades , this time away from Knight and others .
Translation: 与骑士资本类似，纽约证券交易所的RLP计算机系统通过算法判断何时应以略优于市场报价的价格执行交易，从而从骑士资本等竞争对手手中夺取股票交易订单。

Query_Text_en: Knight says the computer problems it ran into had to do with NYSE 's new trading system , but it did n't say what .
Translation: 骑士公司表示，其遇到的计算机故障与纽约证券交易所的新交易系统有关，但未具体说明问题细节。

Query_Text_en: Tellingly , all of the stocks that Knight 's computers did bogus trades in were listed on the NYSE .
Translation: 值得注意的是，骑士资本电脑系统进行错误交易的所有股票均在纽约证券交易所上市。

Query_Text_en: It 's likely that Knight tried to upgrade its own algorithm to allow its computers to do an end around the NYSE 's new system .
Translation: 骑士资本很可能试图升级自身算法，使其计算机系统能够绕过纽约证券交易所的新交易机制。

Query_Text_en: Instead , Knight 's computer system , launched at the same time as the NYSE 's , went on a trading frenzy , buying and selling millions of shares for no reason shortly after both systems were switched on , at when the market opened at 9:30 Wednesday morning .
Translation: 然而，与纽交所系统同步上线的骑士公司电脑系统却陷入交易狂潮——周三上午9:30市场开盘后，两套系统刚启动不久，该系统就毫无缘由地买卖了数百万股股票。

Query_Text_en: Normally that should n't have produced any real losses .
Translation: 通常情况下，这不会造成实质性损失。

Query_Text_en: These were n't actual orders , so Knight 's system should have just been buying and selling to itself .
Translation: 这些并非真实交易指令，因此奈特的系统本应仅进行自买自卖操作。

Query_Text_en: But that 's not how the world of high frequency trading works .
Translation: 但高频交易市场的运作方式并非如此。

Query_Text_en: When other traders , i.e. computer systems , saw the spike in activity , they jumped in too .
Translation: 当其他交易者（即计算机系统）察觉到交易活动激增时，也迅速跟进入场。

Query_Text_en: Knight disabled the faulty algorithm by 10:15 .
Translation: 骑士公司于10点15分停用了故障算法。

Query_Text_en: But by then the damage was done .
Translation: 但彼时大错已成。

Query_Text_en: Knight was out $ 440 million .
Translation: 骑士公司损失了4.4亿美元。

Query_Text_en: A number of stocks , including Warren Buffett 's Berkshire Hathaway -LRB- BRKB -RRB- , had gyrated up and down , and our faith in the market was shaken once again .
Translation: 包括沃伦·巴菲特的伯克希尔哈撒韦(BRKB)在内的多支股票剧烈震荡，使我们对市场的信心再次动摇。

Query_Text_en: In theory , we should all benefit from this competition , being able to trade at cheaper and cheaper prices .
Translation: 理论上，我们都应能从这种竞争中获益，以越来越低廉的价格进行交易。

Query_Text_en: But in practice the `` price improvements '' that Knight and now NYSE offer are fractions of a fraction of a penny .
Translation: 但实际上，无论是骑士公司还是如今纽交所提供的"价格优化"服务，其让利幅度微乎其微，仅相当于不足一美分的零头。

Query_Text_en: At best , what we are getting in return is a market that is less stable .
Translation: 我们得到的充其量只是一个更加不稳定的市场。

Query_Text_en: At worst , we are getting a system that is picking our pockets .
Translation: 最糟糕的是，我们正在被一个掏空我们钱包的制度所裹挟。

Query_Text_en: If this is n't a clear case where we need regulators to step in , I do n't know what is .
Translation: 若此情此景尚不足以彰显监管介入之必要，则更无他例可证。

Query_Text_en: More and more companies are making their offers hard to refuse .
Translation: 越来越多的企业正开出令人难以拒绝的优厚条件。

Query_Text_en: That was 72 % more than the $ 26.69 Shaw 's stock closed at on Friday .
Translation: 这一价格较肖氏公司股票上周五26.69美元的收盘价高出72%。

Query_Text_en: CB&I is n't the only company willing to pay considerably more than market prices .
Translation: CB&I并非唯一一家愿意支付远高于市场价格的公司。

Query_Text_en: Last week , Chinese company Cnooc -LRB- CEO -RRB- said it would pay $ 15.1 billion , or $ 27.50 , for all the outstanding shares of Canadian oil company Nexen -LRB- NXY -RRB- . That was 61 % more than where the latter 's stock had been valued at before the deal .
Translation: 上周，中国海洋石油有限公司（简称：中海油）宣布将以151亿美元现金收购加拿大尼克森公司（Nexen）全部流通股，合每股27.50美元，较该交易宣布前尼克森股价溢价61%。

Query_Text_en: And those deals only rank 7th and 9th , respectively , on the list of the highest paid premiums this year .
Translation: 而这两笔交易在今年最高溢价收购榜单上仅分别位列第七和第九位。

Query_Text_en: Back in January , Bristol-Myers Squibb -LRB- BMY -RRB- paid $ 26 a share to buy biotech company Inhibitex , which was an enormous 163 % more than where that stock had been trading , and still ranks as the richest deal of the year .
Translation: 今年1月，百时美施贵宝(Bristol-Myers Squibb)以每股26美元的价格收购生物科技公司Inhibitex，较该股当时交易价溢价高达163%，这笔交易目前仍是今年溢价率最高的并购案。

Query_Text_en: Buyers typically pay a premium to acquire all the shares of a company .
Translation: 收购方通常需支付溢价才能购得目标公司的全部股权。

Query_Text_en: But this year that premium has been larger .
Translation: 但今年这一溢价幅度有所扩大。

Query_Text_en: According to deal tracker Dealogic , on average , acquirers of publicly trading companies have paid 25 % more than where those companies ' shares had traded . That 's up from 23 % in the first seven months of 2011 , and it 's the highest average premium paid since 2001 .
Translation: 交易追踪机构Dealogic数据显示，上市公司收购方平均支付价格较目标公司股价溢价25%，高于2011年前七个月的23%水平，创下2001年以来最高平均溢价纪录。

Query_Text_en: It 's not clear why buyers are willing to pay more now .
Translation: 目前尚不清楚买家为何愿意支付更高价格。

Query_Text_en: Mergers and acquisitions are usually seen as a bellwether - a sign of how optimistic corporate leaders are on the economy .
Translation: 并购活动通常被视为经济风向标——它能反映企业领导者对经济前景的乐观程度。

Query_Text_en: The pace of deals is up in the past month , but it 's still down 16 % compared to a year ago .
Translation: 过去一个月并购交易步伐有所加快，但与去年同期相比仍下降16%。

Query_Text_en: But the fact that companies are willing to pay so much more than market suggests there is more optimism out there than the sluggish pace of deals would indicate .
Translation: 然而，企业愿意支付远高于市场价的溢价这一事实表明，实际存在的乐观情绪远超交易低迷态势所反映的程度。

Query_Text_en: But the high prices could also reinforce how hard it is to get deals done .
Translation: 但高昂的价格也可能凸显达成交易的难度之大。

Query_Text_en: M&A professionals say one of the reasons there are so few deals is because buyers and sellers ca n't agree on prices .
Translation: 并购专业人士表示，交易数量稀少的原因之一在于买卖双方难以就价格达成一致。

Query_Text_en: And with stock values on average still lower than they were five years ago , corporate executives and shareholders often think their companies are worth considerable more than where shares have been trading .
Translation: 由于股票平均价格仍低于五年前水平，企业高管和股东们往往认为其公司价值远高于当前股价所反映的水平。

Query_Text_en: That 's forcing acquirers to pay up .
Translation: 这使得收购方不得不提高报价。

Query_Text_en: M&A usually has a herd mentality .
Translation: 并购交易往往存在从众心理。

Query_Text_en: But today 's deals could inspire few copycats .
Translation: 但今日之协议恐难引发效仿风潮。

Query_Text_en: Shares of CB&I , for instance , dropped 14 % since the Shaw deal was announced and five of analysts downgraded CB&I citing the deal 's high price .
Translation: 例如，自肖氏交易公布以来，芝加哥桥梁钢铁公司股价已下跌14%，五名分析师以交易价格过高为由下调了该公司评级。

Query_Text_en: That might scare other CEOs away from inking similar deals .
Translation: 这可能会吓退其他首席执行官，使他们不敢签署类似协议。

Query_Text_en: Nonetheless , at least for now , the higher prices are mild good news for M&A bankers , many of which have been facing the biggest drought of their careers .
Translation: 不过，至少就目前而言，价格上涨对并购银行家们来说是个温和的好消息，他们中许多人正经历着职业生涯中最严重的业务荒。

Query_Text_en: Wall Street firms are paid based on the price of a deal . So higher prices mean individual deals may be more profitable , even if overall fees are down .
Translation: 华尔街投行的报酬与交易金额挂钩。因此，即便整体佣金收入下降，更高的交易价格仍可能使单笔交易利润更为丰厚。

Query_Text_en: The biggest winner appears to be Morgan Stanley -LRB- MS -RRB- , which has been on one of the sides of five of the 10 deals with the largest premiums .
Translation: 最大赢家似乎非摩根士丹利（MS）莫属——在溢价率最高的10宗交易中，该行参与了其中5宗的某一方交易。

Query_Text_en: But on three of those deals , Morgan advised the buyer , not the seller .
Translation: 但在其中三笔交易中，摩根担任的是买方顾问，而非卖方顾问。

Query_Text_en: Credit Suisse has worked four of the deals , each time representing the seller .
Translation: 瑞信参与了其中四笔交易，每次均代表卖方。

Query_Text_en: The most fascinating thing about the government 's charge that JPMorgan Chase employees committed fraud in connection with the bank 's $ 6 billion trading loss , and the one that will have the largest reverberations for Wall Street , is not who is being charged , but who is n't .
Translation: 关于摩根大通员工因该行60亿美元交易亏损涉嫌欺诈的政府指控，最引人注目之处——也是对华尔街影响最为深远的一点——不在于谁被起诉，而在于谁未被起诉。

Query_Text_en: -LRB- Why not charge her with failure to supervise ? -RRB-
Translation: “为什么不指控她监管不力呢？”

Query_Text_en: Nor is JPMorgan 's CEO Jamie Dimon , who told investors the issue of the London Whale was `` a tempest in a teapot '' even after he was alerted to the size of trade , if not an accurate picture of the losses .
Translation: 摩根大通首席执行官杰米·戴蒙同样如此。即便在获悉交易规模（虽未掌握损失的确切情况）后，他仍向投资者表示"伦敦鲸"事件不过是"茶杯里的风暴"。

Query_Text_en: Dimon also signed off on JPMorgan 's faulty books , which eventually had to be restated , something Sarbanes Oxley was supposed to hold executives accountable for .
Translation: 戴蒙还曾签字认可摩根大通存在纰漏的账目——这些账目最终不得不重新申报，而《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》本应要求高管对此类行为负责。

Query_Text_en: Nor are any of the bank 's multiple risk officers who signed off on the change in the risk model that allowed the London Whale 's ill-fated trade to get bigger , even as the bank 's books appeared to show that JPMorgan was reducing its trading risks .
Translation: 同样未被追责的还有该行多位风险管控官——他们批准了风险模型的调整，使得"伦敦鲸"的高风险交易规模得以扩大。而当时摩根大通的账目却显示，该行正在降低交易风险。

Query_Text_en: Also getting off mostly scot-free is JPMorgan -LRB- JPM -RRB- .
Translation: 摩根大通(JPM)也基本全身而退。

Query_Text_en: The SEC says its investigation is continuing .
Translation: 美国证券交易委员会表示相关调查仍在进行中。

Query_Text_en: And regulators have already ordered the bank to improve its risk controls .
Translation: 监管机构已责令该银行加强风险管控。

Query_Text_en: But it appears JPMorgan is looking at a minor slap on the wrist .
Translation: 但摩根大通似乎只会受到轻微处罚。

Query_Text_en: And remember the London Whale himself , Bruno Iksil , the actual architect of the ill-fated trades ? Yeah , he 's off the hook as well .
Translation: 还记得“伦敦鲸”本人——那些失败交易的实际策划者布鲁诺·伊克西尔吗？没错，他也全身而退了。

Query_Text_en: The Justice Department and the SEC 's cases against Javier Martin-Artajo and Julien Grout , the two who are being charged , give an amazing window into what it 's like to be a trader these days on Wall Street , especially the ones who are responsible for multi-billion dollar portfolios of the market 's riskiest stuff .
Translation: 美国司法部和证券交易委员会对涉案嫌疑人哈维尔·马丁-阿塔霍和朱利安·格鲁特的起诉，为外界提供了一个绝佳窗口，得以窥见当今华尔街交易员的真实工作状态——尤其是那些掌管着市场最高风险、规模达数十亿美元投资组合的交易员。

Query_Text_en: Grout worked under Iksil , and was responsible for valuing Iksil 's portfolio , computing the gains or losses .
Translation: 格鲁特在伊克西尔手下工作，负责评估伊克西尔投资组合的价值，计算盈亏情况。

Query_Text_en: The conversations detailed in the government 's complaints are not what you would expect from three guys in the heat of the market , facing the most difficult trade of their careers .
Translation: 政府投诉文件中详述的对话内容，与三名交易员在市场白热化阶段面临职业生涯最棘手交易时应有的表现大相径庭。

Query_Text_en: In early 2012 , when the losses appeared to be mounting , there was no discussion by any of the three about what bonds or derivatives they might sell or buy to minimize their losses -- also known as trading .
Translation: 2012年初，当亏损持续扩大时，三人中无人讨论应买卖何种债券或衍生品以降低损失——即所谓的交易操作。

Query_Text_en: In fact , Martin-Artajo seems to be driven by a desire to keep the synthetic portfolio , which had grown by this time to have a notional value of $ 157 billion , as is for as long as possible .
Translation: 事实上，马丁-阿塔霍似乎执意要尽可能久地维持这一合成投资组合的现状——此时该组合名义价值已膨胀至1570亿美元。

Query_Text_en: That is not a trade .
Translation: 这不是贸易。

Query_Text_en: Instead , according to the court filings , the three traders spend a lot of time -LRB- all of their time ? -RRB- talking about valuations and marks .
Translation: 相反,根据法庭文件显示,这三位交易员投入大量时间(可能是他们的全部时间?)讨论估值与标价问题。

Query_Text_en: What are the trades they have worth , and how can they make the losses they 've got look as small as possible .
Translation: 他们持有的交易价值几何，又该如何将已产生的亏损尽可能最小化呈现。

Query_Text_en: It starts off as minor tweaking .
Translation: 起初只是些微调整。

Query_Text_en: By the end , Grout is maintaining a spreadsheet showing the traders ' actual losses are as much as $ 800 million more than what they are reporting up the chain .
Translation: 最终，格劳特维护的一份电子表格显示，交易员们的实际亏损比他们向上级汇报的金额高出8亿美元之多。

Query_Text_en: In one telling moment , on the last day of the first quarter , Martin-Artajo tells Grout that he wants to show a daily loss of just $ 200 million , even though it 's likely the portfolio had sunk that day alone much more than that .
Translation: 在第一季度最后一天的关键时刻，马丁-阿塔霍告诉格劳特，他希望当日亏损仅显示为2亿美元——尽管当天投资组合的实际亏损很可能远超这个数字。

Query_Text_en: When Grout does this , Martin-Artajo goes back and asks whether they can get the loss number down to $ 150 million .
Translation: 当格劳特这样做时，马丁-阿塔霍又回头询问能否将亏损金额降至1.5亿美元。

Query_Text_en: The daily loss they end up reporting : $ 138 million .
Translation: 他们最终报告的日亏损额：1.38亿美元。

Query_Text_en: Late in the game a JPMorgan risk officer does catch up with Martin-Artajo and asks him to explain the way the portfolio is marked , to which Artajo responds basically , `` Hey , I ai n't no accountant . ''
Translation: 在事件后期，摩根大通一名风险官终于联系上马丁-阿塔霍，要求其对投资组合的估值方式作出解释。阿塔霍的回应直截了当："听着，我又不是会计。"

Query_Text_en: And that you know is a pretty funny excuse because all these guys seem to be doing is accounting , but not actually a legal one .
Translation: 各位都知道，这个借口相当滑稽——因为这些人所做的不过是账目处理，而且绝非合法合规的会计操作。

Query_Text_en: At some point along the way , Iksil jumps ship .
Translation: 在此过程中，伊克西尔最终选择离职。

Query_Text_en: According to the government 's case , Iksil breaks with Martin-Artajo and starts reporting larger losses than Martin-Artajo wants to acknowledge to others at the bank .
Translation: 根据政府指控，伊克西尔与马丁-阿塔霍分道扬镳，开始向银行其他人员上报比马丁-阿塔霍愿意承认的更大亏损。

Query_Text_en: And he tells the other two traders that it 's time to come clean .
Translation: 他告诉另外两名交易员，是时候坦白一切了。

Query_Text_en: That , along with the fact that Iksil is cooperating with the government , appears to be why Iksil is not being charged .
Translation: 加之伊克西尔正配合政府调查，这似乎正是其未被起诉的原因。

Query_Text_en: Ironically , Grout was the first of the three to warn that Iksil 's derivative trades could produce huge losses .
Translation: 颇具讽刺意味的是，三人中格劳特最先警告称伊克西尔的衍生品交易可能造成巨额亏损。

Query_Text_en: In early January , Grout drew up a plan for the bank to get out of the trades , but it would end up creating a $ 500 million loss .
Translation: 1月初，格劳特为银行制定了一项平仓计划，但最终将导致5亿美元的亏损。

Query_Text_en: Iksil and Martin-Artajo told him no thanks .
Translation: 伊克西尔和马丁-阿塔霍婉拒了他的提议。

Query_Text_en: At the heart of it , the government 's case is about traders hiding their losses .
Translation: 政府指控的核心在于交易员隐瞒亏损行为。

Query_Text_en: And back in late 2011 , that 's exactly what Iksil did .
Translation: 2011年末，伊克西尔正是这样操作的。

Query_Text_en: He had a portfolio of bets that would pay off if a bunch of companies defaulted .
Translation: 他持有一揽子对赌头寸，若多家企业违约便可获利。

Query_Text_en: But the U.S. economy was improving and that was n't happening .
Translation: 但美国经济当时正在好转，这种情况并未发生。

Query_Text_en: So Iksil 's trades were becoming costly for the bank .
Translation: 因此，伊克西尔的交易正使银行蒙受损失。

Query_Text_en: So Iksil came up with a way to keep the trade on , but make it magically look like it was all of a sudden profitable .
Translation: 于是，伊克西尔想出了一个既能维持交易又能让其奇迹般看似突然盈利的办法。

Query_Text_en: He figured out a way by taking on a massive amount of offsetting bets on a slightly different index to make his slowly losing trading into one that was cashflow positive , which was brilliant , but also opened the bank up to a lot more risk .
Translation: 他设计出一种策略：通过大量对冲押注于一个略有差异的指数，将缓慢亏损的交易转变为现金流为正的投资。这一操作堪称精妙，却也使银行暴露于更大的风险之中。

Query_Text_en: That should n't have been allowed .
Translation: 这原本就不该被允许。

Query_Text_en: But Iksil 's superiors -- including Drew , and in part Dimon -- signed off on new risk models that would make the vastly larger portfolio appear like it was actually smaller , at least risk-wise .
Translation: 但伊克西尔的上级——包括德鲁，某种程度上还有戴蒙——批准了新的风险模型，这些模型使得规模庞大得多的投资组合在风险层面看起来实际上更小。

Query_Text_en: The Senate 's investigation into the trading loss criticized JPMorgan for not telling investors that it changed its risk model , not actually for changing its model .
Translation: 参议院针对交易亏损事件的调查批评摩根大通未向投资者披露其风险模型变更的事实，而非针对其调整模型本身的行为。

Query_Text_en: JPMorgan and other banks change their models all the time .
Translation: 摩根大通等银行持续调整其业务模式。

Query_Text_en: It 's allowed .
Translation: 可以。

Query_Text_en: Martin-Artajo and Grout , on the other hand , did it in a lying kind of way .
Translation: 另一方面，马丁-阿塔霍和格劳特则以欺瞒手段行事。

Query_Text_en: The end result of both techniques were the same : Investors and regulators were misled as to the size of JPMorgan 's potential losses .
Translation: 两种手段的最终结果如出一辙：投资者与监管机构均被误导，未能察觉摩根大通潜在亏损的真实规模。

Query_Text_en: But that 's not the fault of the Justice Department or the SEC .
Translation: 但这并非司法部或证交会的过错。

Query_Text_en: Or really Iksil 's either .
Translation: 或者说，伊克西尔本人也是如此。

Query_Text_en: He knew when his colleagues had crossed over from bending the rules of the market to breaking the laws of the land , and he was n't willing to follow .
Translation: 他清楚同事们何时已从钻市场规则的空子，滑向了践踏国家法律的深渊，而他并不愿同流合污。

Query_Text_en: That 's not quite righteous , but it is n't wrong either .
Translation: 这虽不算完全正当，但也无可厚非。

Query_Text_en: What 's really at fault is our still overly complicated , loophole-ridden financial regulations that allow banks to hide the huge risks they take all the time that are subsidized by the government and that taxpayers would have to pay for if they go colossally bad .
Translation: 问题的根源在于我们依然过于复杂且漏洞百出的金融监管体系——这种制度纵容银行持续隐藏其巨额风险操作，而这些风险不仅享受着政府隐性补贴，一旦酿成灾难性后果，最终仍将由纳税人买单。

Query_Text_en: In the end , the message to Wall Street of Jamie and the Whale is , unfortunately , that you can still do that and stay out of jail , as long as you are clever about it .
Translation: 遗憾的是，杰米与鲸鱼事件最终向华尔街传递的信息是：只要手段足够高明，你依然可以逍遥法外。

Query_Text_en: We are officially uncrunched .
Translation: 我们正式摆脱了资金紧张的局面。

Query_Text_en: For the first time since the start of the financial crisis , banks have more lent out then they did in late 2008 .
Translation: 自金融危机爆发以来，银行业贷款规模首次超过2008年末水平。

Query_Text_en: In mid-July , according to the Federal Reserve , which reports the figures with a lag , banks had $ 7.33 trillion in loans outstanding .
Translation: 美联储数据显示，截至7月中旬，美国银行业未偿还贷款总额达7.33万亿美元。该数据存在滞后性。

Query_Text_en: That was slightly more than the $ 7.32 trillion banks had extended in October 2008 , the last time credit peaked .
Translation: 这一数字略高于2008年10月银行7.32万亿美元的信贷规模峰值。

Query_Text_en: But the growth in lending has remained slow and uneven .
Translation: 但贷款增长依然缓慢且不均衡。

Query_Text_en: Lending in the first three months of the year dropped , before rebounding in the second quarter .
Translation: 今年一季度贷款规模下降，二季度出现回升。

Query_Text_en: And much of the rebound in lending has been to corporate borrowers .
Translation: 贷款反弹的大部分资金流向了企业借款人。

Query_Text_en: The volume of commercial and industrial loans outstanding is up 27 % in the past two years , according to Bankregdata.com .
Translation: 据Bankregdata.com数据显示，过去两年工商业贷款未偿余额增长了27%。

Query_Text_en: Consumer mortgage credit , however , is up just 4 % in the same time , despite a recent refinance boom , which appears now to have peaked .
Translation: 然而，尽管近期再融资热潮看似已达顶峰，同期消费抵押贷款仅增长4%。

Query_Text_en: Very little mortgage lending was for new purchases .
Translation: 新增购房按揭贷款占比极低。

Query_Text_en: Credit card lending is up less than half a percent .
Translation: 信用卡贷款增幅不足0.5%。

Query_Text_en: Auto loans , though , are up 15 % .
Translation: 然而，汽车贷款却增长了15%。

Query_Text_en: Credit crunches are rare in American economic history , and do n't tend to last long .
Translation: 在美国经济史上，信贷紧缩现象较为罕见且往往持续时间短暂。

Query_Text_en: It took slightly more than a year for lending to recover after the early 2000s recession .
Translation: 2000年代初经济衰退后，信贷市场仅用一年多时间便实现复苏。

Query_Text_en: Credit grew slowly in the late-1980s and early 1990s , but never really dropped .
Translation: 20世纪80年代末至90年代初，信贷增长虽显缓慢，但始终未现实质性下滑。

Query_Text_en: The recent credit crunch , which clocks in at just under five years , appears to be the largest and longest in the Federal Reserve 's database , which only goes back to 1947 .
Translation: 当前这场已持续近五年的信贷紧缩，根据美联储仅可追溯至1947年的数据库记载，堪称其规模最大、历时最长的信用危机。
