Query_Text_en: Along the way , economists have debated whether the credit crunch was being driven by banks being unwilling to lend , or from a lack of demand for loans from borrowers .
Translation: 在此过程中，经济学家们一直争论不休：信贷紧缩究竟是源于银行惜贷，还是由于借款人贷款需求不足所致。

Query_Text_en: Many politicians blamed the banks .
Translation: 许多政界人士将矛头指向银行业。

Query_Text_en: It does appear that getting a home loan became much tougher after the financial crisis , though many would argue it was too loose before it .
Translation: 金融危机后，住房贷款审批确实明显收紧，尽管不少人认为此前放贷标准过于宽松。

Query_Text_en: And recently deposits at the banks have been rising faster than loans , meaning less of the money people are putting into banks is making its way back out into the economy .
Translation: 近期银行存款增速持续快于贷款增速，这意味着民众存入银行资金中回流至经济体的比例有所下降。

Query_Text_en: Bill Dunkelberg , NFIB 's chief economist , says his surveys of small business owners throughout the credit crunch show that there was little drop-off in the ability of small businesses to get loans .
Translation: 全美独立企业联盟(NFIB)首席经济学家比尔·邓克尔伯格表示，他在信贷紧缩期间对中小企业主开展的调查显示，中小企业获取贷款的能力几乎没有下降。

Query_Text_en: `` What we really saw was a near record high percentage of businesses who do n't want a loan , '' says Dunkelberg .
Translation: 邓克尔伯格表示："我们实际观察到的是，不愿申请贷款的企业比例接近历史峰值。"

Query_Text_en: Still , there are positives signs that lending growth will continue , albeit slowly .
Translation: 尽管如此，仍有积极迹象表明信贷增长将持续，尽管增速较为缓慢。

Query_Text_en: The Federal Reserve 's most recent survey of lenders found that banks are finally making it easier for individuals to get home , car and credit card loans .
Translation: 美联储最新贷款机构调查显示，银行终于放宽了个人住房贷款、汽车贷款和信用卡贷款的审批条件。

Query_Text_en: The survey also said that the trend toward easier loans for businesses is improving .
Translation: 调查还显示，企业贷款条件趋于宽松的态势正在持续改善。

Query_Text_en: And the ratio of loans to deposits rose for the first time in over a year , though at just over 70 % it is still near all-time lows .
Translation: 与此同时，贷存比一年多来首次出现上升，尽管仅略高于70%，仍接近历史最低水平。

Query_Text_en: Banks used to lend out 90 % of their deposits .
Translation: 银行以往会将90%的存款用于放贷。

Query_Text_en: In a recent analyst note , Sterne Agee bank analyst Todd Hagerman predicted that lending will pick up in 2014 and 2015 , though he still expects the growth will be about half what it was in the mid-2000s .
Translation: 斯特恩·阿吉银行分析师托德·哈格曼在近期一份分析报告中预测，尽管预计2014和2015年的贷款增速仅能达到2000年代中期约一半水平，但银行业放贷规模将出现回升。

Query_Text_en: That , of course , could be a good thing .
Translation: 这当然可能是件好事。

Query_Text_en: I have the answer .
Translation: 我有答案。

Query_Text_en: Really .
Translation: 确实。

Query_Text_en: Because , as you may know , predicting who will be the next Fed chair is easy .
Translation: 众所周知，预测下任美联储主席人选并非难事。

Query_Text_en: In November 2004 , the Associated Press said there were three economists who were likely to replace then-Fed head Alan Greenspan , none of which were Ben Bernanke .
Translation: 2004年11月，美联社曾指出三位有望接替时任美联储主席艾伦·格林斯潘的经济学家，本·伯南克并不在列。

Query_Text_en: The article called Bernanke a `` dark horse . ''
Translation: 文章将伯南克称为"黑马"。

Query_Text_en: In December , the New York Times said Glenn Hubbard , a Columbia University economist and former George W. Bush adviser , was the obvious front runner .
Translation: 去年12月，《纽约时报》称，哥伦比亚大学经济学家、前小布什政府顾问格伦•哈伯德是最热门的候选人。

Query_Text_en: By January , Paul Krugman in the New York Times had Bernanke as a possibility , but only because Harvard economist Martin Feldstein was being pilloried by Republicans for once criticizing Ronald Reagan .
Translation: 截至1月，《纽约时报》的保罗•克鲁格曼曾认为伯南克有可能当选，但这只是因为哈佛大学经济学家马丁•费尔德斯坦曾批评过罗纳德•里根而遭到共和党人的抨击。

Query_Text_en: But Feldstein was back in front by May , according to Businessweek.Fortune 's own Justin Fox wrote in October , shortly before Bernanke was finally picked , that it did n't really matter who replaced Greenspan .
Translation: 据《商业周刊》报道，费尔德斯坦在五月重新成为领跑者。《财富》杂志专栏作家贾斯汀·福克斯十月撰文指出（该文发表时伯南克尚未最终获提名），格林斯潘继任者人选其实无关宏旨。

Query_Text_en: The so-called great moderation -- there was an idea that deep recessions were a thing of the past -- and advances in economic theory had pretty much put Fed policy on autopilot .
Translation: 所谓"大缓和"时期——当时普遍认为深度衰退已成历史——加之经济理论的进步，已使美联储政策基本处于自动巡航状态。

Query_Text_en: Wrote Fox : `` Being Fed chairman is n't that hard anymore . ''
Translation: 福克斯写道："美联储主席的工作已不再那么艰难。"

Query_Text_en: I 'm not going to make the same mistake , which is why I have put so much effort into predetermining without a doubt who will get the top job at the Fed .
Translation: 正因不愿重蹈覆辙，我才不遗余力地预先明确美联储主席人选，确保万无一失。

Query_Text_en: According to a cursory scan of the work of other journalists , it appears Yellen did a good jobwarning about the housing bubble .
Translation: 据粗略查阅其他记者的报道，耶伦在预警房地产泡沫方面表现相当出色。

Query_Text_en: Summers did a good job of responding to it when it burst , although some people say his push to deregulate financial markets when he was Treasury Secretary in the 1990s caused the problems in the first place .
Translation: 萨默斯在危机爆发时应对得当，尽管有人指出，正是他在上世纪90年代担任财政部长期间推动金融市场监管松绑，才埋下了危机的祸根。

Query_Text_en: So edge to Yellen , I guess .
Translation: 那么，我想优势还是在耶伦这边。

Query_Text_en: Yellen is one of the authors of quantitative easing -- the Fed 's signature bond buying stimulus program -- which has lowered interest rates and boosted the stock market .
Translation: 耶伦是量化宽松政策的主要设计者之一。这一美联储标志性的债券购买刺激计划压低了利率并提振了股市。

Query_Text_en: The housing market and business lending are also up .
Translation: 住房市场和企业贷款业务也呈现增长态势。

Query_Text_en: It has not caused hyper-inflation as some feared it might .
Translation: 这并未如某些人所担忧的那样引发恶性通货膨胀。

Query_Text_en: Summers , on the other hand , has repeatedly bashed QE , alternating between saying it does nothing , to expounding on the disasters it could cause .
Translation: 另一方面，萨默斯则屡次抨击量化宽松政策，时而声称其毫无效果，时而又详述其可能引发的灾难性后果。

Query_Text_en: Still , Summers ' supporters say he would be all for continuing QE if he were to be named Fed chairman .
Translation: 然而，萨默斯的支持者表示，若他被提名为美联储主席，定会全力支持延续量化宽松政策。

Query_Text_en: So point to Summers for flexibility .
Translation: 因此，萨默斯的灵活性值得称道。

Query_Text_en: Yellen is a consensus builder .
Translation: 耶伦是一位善于凝聚共识的决策者。

Query_Text_en: Summers is willing to ruffle feathers and go against the grain .
Translation: 萨默斯敢于挑战权威，不随波逐流。

Query_Text_en: Point.Point .
Translation: 要点。

Query_Text_en: But , of course , none of that matters .
Translation: 然而，这一切显然都无关紧要。

Query_Text_en: What really matters is who has your back .
Translation: 关键在于谁是你的后盾。

Query_Text_en: So the thing you really need to know to be able to determine , as I have , who will be the next Fed head is the tally of economists , former administration officials , politicians , and just regular blabbermouths who have so far come out in favor of Summers or Yellen .
Translation: 因此，要像我一样判断下任美联储主席人选，关键在于统计迄今公开支持萨默斯或耶伦的经济学家、前政府官员、政界人士以及普通舆论人士的数量。

Query_Text_en: Economists are overwhelmingly in Yellen 's camp , especially female ones .
Translation: 经济学家们绝大多数支持耶伦，女性经济学家尤其如此。

Query_Text_en: But what we learned from the financial crisis , and what is dogma in Washington , is that economists often do n't know what they are talking about , especially when it comes to economics .
Translation: 然而，我们从金融危机中汲取的教训——这一教训如今已成为华盛顿的共识——就是经济学家们常常并不清楚自己在说什么，尤其是在涉及经济问题时。

Query_Text_en: What really , really matters is who has come out for Summers vs. Yellen , not how many .
Translation: 真正至关重要的，是哪些人表态支持萨默斯或耶伦，而非支持者数量的多寡。

Query_Text_en: Here 's where my scientific , quantitative , regression analysis comes into play : I took all the supporters of Summers and Yellen , and gave them an influence score .
Translation: 此时便需要运用我的科学量化回归分析方法：我将萨默斯和耶伦的所有支持者逐一列出，并为其赋予影响力分值。

Query_Text_en: The scores range from 1 to 0 .
Translation: 评分区间为0至1分。

Query_Text_en: I gave President Obama , for instance , the top influence score of 1 -- he makes the choice after all -- and at least for now he seems in Summers ' corner .
Translation: 例如，我给奥巴马总统打了最高影响力分1分——毕竟最终决定权在他手中——至少目前看来他似乎是站在萨默斯一边的。

Query_Text_en: Former Obama officials got relatively high scores .
Translation: 奥巴马政府前官员得分相对较高。

Query_Text_en: Economists got lower and lower influence scores the further they are geographically from Washington , because that makes sense .
Translation: 经济学家离华盛顿的地理距离越远，其影响力评分就越低——这完全合乎逻辑。

Query_Text_en: Journalists , as always , were near the bottom .
Translation: 与往常一样，记者群体的排名依然接近垫底。

Query_Text_en: Ron Paul , if he had called me back , would have got an influence score of 0 , because I assume his answer for whom Bernanke 's successor would be no one .
Translation: 若罗恩·保罗当时回电，其影响力得分将为零——因为我推测他对"伯南克继任者人选"的回应会是"无人当选"。

Query_Text_en: I then plugged all those numbers into Excel , which we know is infallible , and here 's what I got : The next head of the Fed will be Mr. Larry Summers , who got a score of 4.9 .
Translation: 随后，我将所有数据输入Excel表格——众所周知Excel从不出错——最终得出如下结论：美联储下任主席人选将是拉里·萨默斯先生，其综合评分为4.9分。

Query_Text_en: Yellen 's final tally was 4.7 .
Translation: 耶伦最终支持率为4.7票。

Query_Text_en: Call me .
Translation: 给我打电话。

Query_Text_en: So that 's one .
Translation: 这就是其中之一。

Query_Text_en: On Thursday , nearly five years after the financial crisis , the Securities and Exchange Commission proved that it was able to hold one mid-level , thirtysomething former trader-turned grad student accountable for crimes of the financial crisis .
Translation: 周四，距离金融危机爆发近五年之际，美国证交会(SEC)证明，它能够追究一名30多岁、已转行读研究生的前中层交易员在金融危机期间所犯罪行的责任。

Query_Text_en: But the fact that a jury found former Goldman Sachs -LRB- GS -RRB- trader Fabrice Tourre liable is n't enough to change this : The SEC 's track record on prosecuting financial crisis crimes is pathetic .
Translation: 但陪审团裁定高盛前交易员法布里斯·图雷负有责任这一事实，并不足以改变以下现状：美国证交会在追究金融危机罪行方面的记录令人失望。

Query_Text_en: In nearly five years , the Wall Street regulator has brought just four court cases related to the financial crisis against a total of six individuals , all of whom were relative bit players .
Translation: 近五年来，华尔街监管机构仅就金融危机提起了四起法庭诉讼，涉案人员共计六名，且均为次要参与者。

Query_Text_en: Of those , Tourre is the only one to be found liable .
Translation: 其中，图尔是唯一被认定负有责任的人。

Query_Text_en: `` Their track -LSB- record -RSB- of the cases that have gone to trial has not be very good , '' says Thomas Gorman , a partner at law firm Dorsey and Whitney and a former SEC enforcement official
Translation: "他们经庭审案件的过往记录并不理想，"多西·惠特尼律师事务所合伙人、前美国证券交易委员会执法官员托马斯·戈尔曼表示。

Query_Text_en: And the SEC 's actual record is more like 1-in-7 .
Translation: 而美国证交会的实际成功率更接近七分之一。

Query_Text_en: That 's because the SEC settled charges against former Bear Stearns hedge fund managers Ralph Cioffi and Matthew Tannin after the two were acquitted in a criminal trial brought by the Department of Justice .
Translation: 这是因为美国证券交易委员会（SEC）在对前贝尔斯登对冲基金经理拉尔夫·乔菲和马修·坦宁提起的指控中达成和解——此前美国司法部对二人提起的刑事诉讼已宣告无罪。

Query_Text_en: A judge signed off on the SEC 's settlement only after calling the fine the regulator imposed `` chump change . ''
Translation: 一名法官在签署批准美国证交会（SEC）的和解协议时，直言该监管机构开出的罚金不过是"九牛一毛"。

Query_Text_en: In another instance , the SEC had to do an about-face and ask a judge to drop a case it had brought against Edward Steffelin , who had advised JPMorgan Chase -LRB- JPM -RRB- on a mortgage bond that went bust .
Translation: 另一起案例中，美国证交会不得不转变立场，请求法官撤销其对爱德华·斯特费林提起的诉讼。斯特费林曾为摩根大通一笔违约的抵押贷款债券提供咨询服务。

Query_Text_en: In response , the New York Times wrote that '' if Mr. Steffelin is going to emerge as a ` poster child ' for anything , it will be as a victim of regulatory overreach . ''
Translation: 对此，《纽约时报》评论称："如果斯蒂费林先生真要成为某种典型人物，那也只会是监管越界的受害者。"

Query_Text_en: And we know there were far more than nine people who made deals during the financial crisis that were less than they seemed .
Translation: 我们深知，金融危机期间达成的不实交易远不止九人所为。

Query_Text_en: Private investors have brought cases that have uncovered e-mails and other evidence that prove bankers knew they were selling clients garbage , like the one against Morgan Stanley -LRB- MS -RRB- in which its bankers suggested a deal they were putting together be called `` shitbag . ''
Translation: 私人投资者提起的诉讼案件曝光了电子邮件等证据，证实银行家明知向客户兜售的是垃圾产品。例如针对摩根士丹利（MS）的诉讼中，其银行家曾提议将正在组装的交易产品命名为"垃圾袋"。

Query_Text_en: Yet , Morgan Stanley had never paid a fine to the SEC related to a mortgage deal .
Translation: 然而，摩根士丹利从未因抵押贷款交易向美国证券交易委员会支付过罚款。

Query_Text_en: The SEC has recently said it will take a look at some of these private cases to see if there is anything they missed .
Translation: 美国证券交易委员会近日表示，将重新审查部分私人诉讼案件，以核查是否存在监管疏漏。

Query_Text_en: Good thinking .
Translation: 高见。

Query_Text_en: The SEC has brought 55 other financial crisis related cases that were settled before they went to trial , in some instances for big fines .
Translation: 美国证券交易委员会还处理了另外55起与金融危机相关的案件，这些案件均在开庭前达成和解，部分案件处以高额罚款。

Query_Text_en: Goldman , for one , paid $ 550 million .
Translation: 以高盛为例，其支付了5.5亿美元。

Query_Text_en: But most of the settlements were with companies , not individuals .
Translation: 但多数和解协议是与企业而非个人达成的。

Query_Text_en: And the total amount comes nowhere near to what investors actually lost on Wall Street 's crappy mortgage bonds , or the pain suffered by the people who got a mortgage funded by these Wall Street deals that they believed was safe but ended in foreclosure .
Translation: 而这一总额与投资者在华尔街劣质抵押债券上的实际损失相去甚远，更无法弥补那些通过华尔街交易获得抵押贷款、原以为安全却最终遭遇止赎的民众所承受的痛苦。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , the SEC was quick to take a victory lap after the Tourre result .
Translation: 然而，在托雷案判决后，美国证交会迅速宣告胜利。

Query_Text_en: Andrew Ceresney , co-director of the SEC 's Division of Enforcement , said in a statement , `` We will continue to vigorously seek to hold accountable , and bring to trial when necessary , those who commit fraud on Wall Street . ''
Translation: 美国证券交易委员会执法部联合主任安德鲁·切雷斯尼在声明中表示："我们将继续坚决追究华尔街欺诈行为责任人的法律责任，必要时将对其提起诉讼。"

Query_Text_en: But it 's five years , and it 's one .
Translation: 但这是五年，也是唯一的一次。

Query_Text_en: So , you know , hold the champagne .
Translation: 所以，先别急着开香槟庆祝。

Query_Text_en: If Berkshire Hathaway is a guide , then the economy may be picking up speed .
Translation: 若以伯克希尔·哈撒韦为风向标，美国经济或正加速复苏。

Query_Text_en: Berkshire -LRB- BRKA -RRB- , which is run by billionaire Warren Buffett , handily beat expectations with its second-quarter earnings on Friday .
Translation: 由亿万富翁沃伦·巴菲特执掌的伯克希尔哈撒韦公司（BRKA）上周五公布第二季度财报，其盈利表现远超市场预期。

Query_Text_en: The company , which is both a conglomerate and an investment vehicle for Buffett , made more money from both its investments and in its operating businesses than it did a year ago .
Translation: 这家既是企业集团又是巴菲特投资工具的公司，其投资和运营业务收益均超过去年同期水平。

Query_Text_en: Berkshire reported earnings of $ 4.5 billion , or $ 2,763 per Class A share , easily exceeding expectations of $ 2,093.73 per share from analysts surveyed by Thomson Reuters .
Translation: 伯克希尔公司公布盈利45亿美元，合每股A类股票收益2763美元，大幅超出汤森路透调查分析师预期的每股2093.73美元。

Query_Text_en: While revenue rose 13 % in its insurance business line , higher costs in the division led to a slight dip in profits .
Translation: 尽管保险业务收入增长13%，但由于该部门成本上升，利润略有下滑。

Query_Text_en: Berkshire 's non-insurance businesses made $ 170 million more in the second quarter of 2013 than it did in the same period a year ago .
Translation: 2013年第二季度，伯克希尔公司非保险业务利润较上年同期增加1.7亿美元。

Query_Text_en: Overall , the company 's second quarter earnings were up 46 % from a year ago .
Translation: 总体而言，该公司第二季度盈利较上年同期增长46%。

Query_Text_en: Buffett also posted an impressive gain in his investment portfolio , which is dominated by a number of sizable stakes in well-known companies , including American Express -LRB- AXP -RRB- , Coca Cola -LRB- KO -RRB- and Wells Fargo -LRB- WFC -RRB- .
Translation: 巴菲特投资组合同样表现亮眼，其持仓以美国运通(AXP)、可口可乐(KO)和富国银行(WFC)等多家知名企业的大额股权为主。

Query_Text_en: Berkshire 's stock market holdings rose 18 % in the first six months of the year , outperforming the market in general , which was up 13 % in the same time , as measured by the S&P 500 -LRB- SPX -RRB- .
Translation: 伯克希尔公司上半年股票投资组合市值增长18%，跑赢同期标普500指数13%的整体市场涨幅。

Query_Text_en: But even Buffett 's company was n't able to dodge rising interest rates .
Translation: 但即便是巴菲特的伯克希尔公司也未能躲过利率上升的冲击。

Query_Text_en: The value of Berkshire 's bond market holdings , which are largely held in its insurance businesses , have fallen $ 750 million so far this year .
Translation: 伯克希尔公司债券投资组合（主要集中于保险业务板块）的市值今年以来已缩水7.5亿美元。

Query_Text_en: Berkshire is widely followed because of Buffett , but also because it is a relatively reliable bellwether for the rest of the economy .
Translation: 伯克希尔公司之所以备受关注，既源于巴菲特的光环，也因其堪称整体经济走势的可靠风向标。

Query_Text_en: It owns a wide variety of businesses including railroad giant Burlington Northern Santa Fe and companies that benefit from home construction .
Translation: 其业务范围广泛，旗下既拥有铁路巨头伯灵顿北方圣太菲公司，也涵盖受益于住宅建设的各类企业。

Query_Text_en: In the past few years , Berkshire has deployed more of its cash on large scale acquisitions instead of simply investing in the stock market .
Translation: 近年来，伯克希尔公司已将更多现金用于大规模收购，而非单纯投资股市。

Query_Text_en: In the second quarter , Berkshire completed its acquisition of Heinz with a Brazilian private equity firm 3G Capital .
Translation: 第二季度，伯克希尔与巴西私募股权公司3G资本完成了对亨氏集团的联合收购。

Query_Text_en: Berkshire 's positive results came on the same day the U.S. government announced that employers added a disappointing 162,000 jobs in the month of July .
Translation: 伯克希尔公司公布亮眼业绩当天，美国政府宣布7月新增就业岗位仅16.2万个，远低于市场预期。

Query_Text_en: Berkshire 's results , though , suggest that the economic recovery is continuing .
Translation: 然而，伯克希尔的业绩表明经济复苏仍在持续。

Query_Text_en: That was up from a 4 % jump at the same time a year ago .
Translation: 这一数字较上年同期4%的增幅有所上升。

Query_Text_en: Berkshire 's other manufacturing businesses , which include Benjamin Moore and other building products companies as well as apparel makers Fruit of the Loom and Russell , rose 8 % in the quarter .
Translation: 伯克希尔旗下其他制造业务（包括本杰明摩尔等建材公司以及服饰制造商鲜果布衣和罗素）本季度增长8%。

Query_Text_en: Berkshire 's acquisitions may make the company a better barometer for the economy , but these moves have also altered the company 's makeup and its prospects to investors .
Translation: 伯克希尔的收购行为或许能使其成为更精准的经济晴雨表，但这些举措也改变了公司结构及其对投资者的发展前景。

Query_Text_en: Berkshire now generates far more of its gains in book value , which Buffett says is his preferred metric for success , from its operating businesses rather than its investments .
Translation: 伯克希尔公司目前账面价值增长的绝大部分源自其经营业务，而非投资业务。巴菲特表示，账面价值才是他衡量企业成功与否的首选指标。

Query_Text_en: As a result , the company 's book value this year is up only 7 % , far less than the gains of Buffett 's investments .
Translation: 因此，该公司今年账面价值仅增长7%，远低于巴菲特投资组合的收益水平。

Query_Text_en: For now , the market seems to be saying safer .
Translation: 目前来看，市场似乎更倾向于避险策略。

Query_Text_en: Berkshires ' stock is up 32 % this year .
Translation: 伯克希尔公司股价今年已上涨32%。

Query_Text_en: We checked at thefreedictionary.com and found the first definition as `` an unprincipled , deceitful , and unreliable person . ''
Translation: 经查阅《自由词典》，其首条释义为"无原则、欺诈且不可信赖之人"。

Query_Text_en: Using this definition , we are not sure that Kweku Adoboli , the UBS employee alleged to have fumbled some $ 2.3 billion of the bank 's money , would be the only employee on his desk to merit the characterization .
Translation: 按照这一标准，我们无法确定，据称导致瑞银(UBS)损失约23亿美元资金的该行雇员奎库•阿多博利(Kweku Adoboli)，是唯一一个配得上这一评价的交易员。

Query_Text_en: Clearly , what makes Adoboli 's actions `` rogue '' activity is not the fact that he allegedly lost over $ 2 billion , but that he lost the bank 's own money .
Translation: 显然，阿多博利的行为之所以被定性为"流氓交易"，并非因其据称导致逾20亿美元亏损，而是因其令银行自有资金蒙受损失。

Query_Text_en: Last year the World Federation of Exchanges did a study of same-day affirmation -LRB- SDA -RRB- by country .
Translation: 去年，世界交易所联合会对各国当日确认（SDA）情况进行了专项研究。

Query_Text_en: Trade affirmation is a small furry rodent that inhabits the musty shadows of an un-sexy corner of Wall Street known as Operations and Back Office .
Translation: 交易确认是华尔街一个不起眼的角落——运营与后台部门——中栖居的一种小型毛茸啮齿动物，那里阴暗潮湿，毫无魅力可言。

Query_Text_en: This is the part that , as people are only now finding out , is held together by paper clips and rubber bands , while the high frequency traders run computer arrays that would make the chief weapons officer of Battlestar Galactica drool .
Translation: 人们如今才逐渐意识到，这个系统实则依靠回形针和橡皮筋勉强维系，而高频交易商们操控的计算机阵列之精密，足以令《太空堡垒卡拉狄加》的首席武器官垂涎不已。

Query_Text_en: The transaction processing piece , meanwhile , has almost always had to play catch-up .
Translation: 与此同时，交易处理环节几乎总是处于被动追赶状态。

Query_Text_en: The UBS scandal has brought the post-trade piece of the business to public attention .
Translation: 瑞银集团丑闻事件使得该业务的交易后环节引发公众关注。

Query_Text_en: According to the Financial Times , the accused UBS -LRB- UBS -RRB- trader had intimate knowledge `` of how confirmation that trades have been done ... can happen after settlement . ''
Translation: 据《金融时报》报道，被指控的瑞银交易员深谙"交易确认...可在结算后完成"的操作流程。

Query_Text_en: It is possible for a firm to receive payment for a trade before the seller has confirmed the transaction to the buyer .
Translation: 企业有可能在卖方尚未向买方确认交易前就收到货款。

Query_Text_en: And while it is not so simple to take the buyer 's cash out before seller 's the securities have been delivered , the seller can show the cash on their own books as having been received , and can even spend it in further transactions .
Translation: 尽管在卖方交割证券前提取买方资金并非易事，但卖方可在自身账目中将该笔资金记为已收款项，甚至能将其用于后续交易。

Query_Text_en: The FT explains that this risk is particularly prevalent in over the counter markets , where ETFs , foreign exchange options and a number of commodity derivatives trade .
Translation: 英国《金融时报》分析指出，这一风险在场外交易市场尤为突出，该市场交易品种包括交易所交易基金、外汇期权及多种大宗商品衍生品。

Query_Text_en: It is also where money market instruments trade , and we do not fancy the notion of a failure to deliver on a few hundred billion dollars ' worth of short term commercial paper in what our brokerage statement misleadingly calls our `` cash '' balance .
Translation: 这里也是货币市场工具交易的场所。我们并不乐见这样一种情形：价值数千亿美元的短期商业票据无法兑付——而这些票据在我们的经纪账户报表中被误导性地标注为"现金"余额。

Query_Text_en: Among leading global markets , the U.S. ranked dead last , with only 46.9 % of trades being same day affirmed .
Translation: 在全球主要市场中，美国排名垫底，仅有46.9%的交易实现当日确认。

Query_Text_en: There is an initiative afoot to harmonize settlement practices among some thirty different nations , each with different regulatory regimes , bank and market conventions , and different current back-office practices .
Translation: 目前正在推进一项倡议，旨在协调约三十个国家的结算操作规范。这些国家监管制度各异，银行与市场惯例不同，后台操作流程也各有特点。

Query_Text_en: We wish them luck .
Translation: 祝他们好运。

Query_Text_en: Shortly before the UBS scandal broke the FT reported on a phenomenon known in the industry as fails to deliver .
Translation: 就在瑞银丑闻爆发前不久，英国《金融时报》曾报道过业内称为"交割失败"的现象。

Query_Text_en: At least in the U.S. the number is known . There is no equivalent data available for Europe .
Translation: 至少在美国，这一数字是明确的。而欧洲尚无对应的数据可查。

Query_Text_en: Some observers are convinced that banks are deliberately failing `` as a way of dealing with financial stress . ''
Translation: 有观察人士认为，银行正以"故意倒闭"作为应对金融压力的手段。

Query_Text_en: Margin rules and trading system conventions generally allow the proceeds of a sale to be used for new purchases before the cash is actually delivered , so a fail on a cash payment may go unnoticed if it is resolved before too many downstream transactions settle .
Translation: 保证金规则与交易系统惯例通常允许在资金实际交割前，将卖出证券所得款项用于新交易。因此，若现金支付违约能在后续多笔交易结算前得到解决，该违约行为可能不会被察觉。

Query_Text_en: Or it can set off a cascade where successive trades have to be broken , with the firm eating both its own losses , and those of its counterparties on the trades in question .
Translation: 另一种可能是引发连锁反应，导致后续交易接连违约，迫使该公司不仅自行承担损失，还必须为相关交易的对手方买单。

Query_Text_en: This appears to be roughly the case facing UBS
Translation: 瑞银当前面临的局面大致如此。

Query_Text_en: In the U.S. , there is a further Never-Never-Land called `` ex clearing , '' where aged fails go into permanent limbo .
Translation: 在美国，还存在一个更为虚幻的"场外清算"地带，那些长期违约的交易将在此陷入永久悬置状态。

Query_Text_en: They become an off-book contract between the counterparty brokers , who agree not to pursue the matter .
Translation: 这成为经纪商之间的账外协议，双方约定不再追究此事。

Query_Text_en: There is no way of knowing the dollar value of fails that have been thus dispatched , and consequently it is impossible to know what amounts of money on bank balance sheets are actually phantom capital that will never be recovered .
Translation: 目前无法估算通过这种方式处置的违约交易具体金额，因而也无从得知银行资产负债表上究竟有多少实为永远无法收回的虚幻资本。

Query_Text_en: The FT reports that only in May 2009 , after the Lehman collapse , was a fail penalty introduced in the US Treasurys market .
Translation: 英国《金融时报》报道称，直到2009年5月雷曼兄弟破产后，美国国债市场才引入交易失败惩罚机制。

Query_Text_en: In that month alone daily Treasury fails reached $ 569 billion .
Translation: 仅当月，美国国债日违约规模就达到5690亿美元。

Query_Text_en: The U.S. now plans to introduce fails charges for mortgage backed securities , which traders say will force fails into other segments of the market .
Translation: 美国目前计划对抵押贷款支持证券引入违约罚金制度，交易员表示这将迫使违约风险向市场其他领域转移。

Query_Text_en: This brings us back to our rogue trader .
Translation: 这就让我们回到那位流氓交易员的问题上。

Query_Text_en: Adoboli worked in UBS 's equities division , where he was charged with running a rather `` sedate trading book , '' according to the Wall Street Journal .
Translation: 据《华尔街日报》报道，阿多博利曾在瑞银股票部门任职，负责管理一个"相对稳健的交易账户"。

Query_Text_en: The losses reportedly stemmed from one-way bets on the direction of the market , using unhedged index futures .
Translation: 据报道，这些亏损源于使用未对冲的指数期货对市场走势进行单向押注。

Query_Text_en: The losses were reportedly masked with falsified entries showing offsetting trades .
Translation: 据报道，这些亏损通过伪造对冲交易的虚假账目被掩盖。

Query_Text_en: Adoboli reportedly created fictitious trades using ETFs , which settle over a longer cycle than the instruments on which he was actually losing money , recording them with European counterparties who were not obligated by market rules to confirm ETF trades .
Translation: 据报道，阿多博利通过交易所交易基金（ETF）虚构交易——这类产品的结算周期长于其实际亏损的金融工具，并将交易记录提交给欧洲交易对手方。由于市场规则未强制要求确认ETF交易，这些对手方无需核实交易真实性。

Query_Text_en: `` The overhaul of its risk-control system did n't address the danger of a back-office employee finding a way to fake trades . ''
Translation: "其风险控制系统的全面改革并未解决后台员工可能伪造交易的风险。"

Query_Text_en: But the equities business is in general not closely monitored `` because it had typically been a client business that carried less risk . ''
Translation: 但股票业务通常不受严密监管，"因其本质上属于客户业务，风险较低"。

Query_Text_en: Losing a client $ 2 billion is called a streak of bad luck . Losing the bank $ 2 billion is called fraud .
Translation: 客户亏损20亿美元可归咎于时运不济，银行亏损20亿美元则构成欺诈。

Query_Text_en: UBS chief Oswald Grubel has resigned as head of UBS .
Translation: 瑞银集团首席执行官郭儒博宣布辞职。

Query_Text_en: Adobli sits in a British jail as he waits for his fate to be decided .
Translation: 阿多布里目前被关押在英国监狱，等待命运裁决。

Query_Text_en: Unlike SocGen 's Jerome Kerviel , he does not yet appear to have taken the position that his superiors knew of his activities .
Translation: 与法国兴业银行的杰洛米·科维尔不同，他尚未表明其上级知晓其交易行为的立场。

Query_Text_en: We doubt there is another major shoe to drop in this matter .
Translation: 我们怀疑此事还会有其他重大变故。

Query_Text_en: The bank did not have adequate controls .
Translation: 该银行缺乏有效的管控机制。

Query_Text_en: In retrospect everyone will clamor that it was idiotic not to anticipate employee fraud .
Translation: 事后看来，所有人都会叫嚷着未能预见员工舞弊行为是何等愚蠢。

Query_Text_en: On the UBS trading desk , a trading book was handed over to an idiot who got in well over his head , and who was apparently overseen by idiots whose risk management process consisted of initialing reams of printouts every day , rather than getting to know the trading style of their employees .
Translation: 在瑞银的交易部门，一本交易账簿被交给了一个力不能及的新手，而监管他的显然也是一群庸才——他们的风险管理流程仅限于每日在成堆的打印文件上签批，却从不深入了解员工的交易风格。

Query_Text_en: The best advice we can give to UBS : do n't hire any more idiots
Translation: 我们给瑞银的最佳建议是：别再雇佣无能之辈。

Query_Text_en: The Securities and Exchange Commission may take formal action against the credit rating agency Standard & Poor 's , the company said in a statement Monday
Translation: 标准普尔公司周一发布声明称，美国证券交易委员会可能对这家信用评级机构采取正式执法行动。

Query_Text_en: McGraw-Hill , the parent company of S&P , received a so-called Wells Notice from the SEC last Thursday , which said that the commission could fine the company for alleged securities violations related to a 2007 collateralized debt obligation deal that S&P rated .
Translation: 标准普尔母公司麦格劳-希尔集团上周四收到美国证交会发出的"韦尔斯通知"，称该机构可能因标普对2007年一项债务抵押债券交易的评级涉嫌违反证券法规而对该公司处以罚款。

Query_Text_en: `` S&P has been cooperating with the commission in this matter and intends to continue to do so , '' McGraw-Hill said in the statement .
Translation: 麦格劳-希尔集团在声明中表示："标普在此事项上一直与委员会保持合作，并将继续予以配合。"

Query_Text_en: The CDO deal in question , known as Delphinus CDO 2007-1 , was arranged by Mizuho International and Delaware Investments acted as the collateral manager .
Translation: 涉事的债务抵押债券（CDO）名为"海豚CDO 2007-1"，由瑞穗国际银行安排发行，特拉华投资公司担任抵押品管理人。

Query_Text_en: In 2007 , S&P had a AAA rating on the security , which was backed largely by subprime mortgages . The agency eventually lowered the rating on the CDO to junk by the end of 2008 .
Translation: 2007年，标准普尔曾给予该证券AAA评级，而该证券主要由次级抵押贷款支持。至2008年底，该机构最终将这一债务抵押债券的评级下调至垃圾级。

Query_Text_en: If the SEC decides to act , the agency can slap S&P with a civil fine , force disgorgement of fees and or seek other appropriate equitable relief
Translation: 若美国证交会决定采取行动，该机构可对标准普尔处以民事罚款、强制退还相关费用，或寻求其他适当的衡平救济措施。

Query_Text_en: This is the latest action in a string of SEC investigations into mortgage bond deals that went bust during the financial crisis .
Translation: 这是美国证交会对金融危机期间崩盘的抵押贷款债券交易展开一系列调查的最新举措。

Query_Text_en: Earlier this month , the Wall Street Journal reported that Citigroup -LRB- C -RRB- and Credit Suisse -LRB- CS -RRB- are in talks with the SEC to settle charges relating to its role in a $ 1 billion CDO it created in 2007 .
Translation: 《华尔街日报》本月稍早报道称，花旗集团(C)和瑞士信贷(CS)正与美国证交会(SEC)进行谈判，以求和解与其2007年创设的10亿美元债务抵押债券(CDO)相关的指控。

Query_Text_en: JP Morgan -LRB- JPM -RRB- paid $ 154 million earlier this year to settle civil charges related to a bad mortgage bond deal .
Translation: 摩根大通(JPM)今年早些时候支付1.54亿美元，就一项不良抵押贷款债券交易相关的民事指控达成和解。

Query_Text_en: A Wells Notice is not a formal allegation or finding of wrongdoing , and a recipient can try to convince the SEC not to act .
Translation: 威尔斯通知并非正式的违法指控或判定结果，收件人可尝试说服美国证券交易委员会不予采取行动。

Query_Text_en: And a notice does n't mean that the SEC will actually do anything .
Translation: 而发布公告并不意味着美国证券交易委员会(SEC)将采取实质性行动。

Query_Text_en: The commission sent a notice to fellow credit rating agency Moody 's -LRB- MCO -RRB- last May , saying that Moody 's registration statement was `` rendered false and misleading '' due to violations of company policy .
Translation: 去年5月，该委员会向同业信用评级机构穆迪公司（MCO）发出通知，指出由于违反公司政策，穆迪的注册声明"存在虚假和误导性陈述"。

Query_Text_en: That case was dropped .
Translation: 该案已被撤销。

Query_Text_en: The storied publisher plans to split into two publicly traded companies by the end of 2012 .
Translation: 这家知名出版商计划在2012年底前分拆为两家上市公司。

Query_Text_en: McGraw-Hill Markets will include S&P , the S&P index business , and J.D. Power and Associates . McGraw-Hill Education will include the education services business .
Translation: 麦格劳-希尔市场板块将包含标普公司、标普指数业务及君迪公司。麦格劳-希尔教育板块将涵盖教育服务业务。

Query_Text_en: S&P , along with Moody 's , are reportedly under investigation by the Department of Justice for their role in the recent credit crisis .
Translation: 据报道，标准普尔与穆迪公司正因在近期信贷危机中所扮演的角色而接受美国司法部调查。

Query_Text_en: And S&P has lately been in the news for its decision this August to lower the United States ' sovereign credit rating from AAA to AA + .
Translation: 而标准普尔最近成为新闻焦点，则是因为今年8月将美国主权信用评级从AAA下调至AA+的决定。

Query_Text_en: S&P 's president Deven Sharma stepped down soon after and was replaced by Citibank 's chief operating officer Douglas Peterson .
Translation: 标普总裁施德文不久后离职，由花旗银行首席运营官道格拉斯·彼得森接任。

Query_Text_en: UBS trader Kweku Adoboli was arrested on September 14 on charges of fraud and false accounting .
Translation: 瑞银交易员奎库·阿多博利因涉嫌欺诈和虚假会计罪名于9月14日被捕。

Query_Text_en: For a trader playing the market , the temptation to `` go rogue '' is huge .
Translation: 对于在市场中博弈的交易员而言，"违规操作"的诱惑实在难以抗拒。

Query_Text_en: Authorized trading is like a complicated , legal slot machine and requires the assumption of major risk on a regular basis .
Translation: 授权交易如同一台复杂的合法老虎机，需要定期承担重大风险。

Query_Text_en: The latest example of this dilemma comes from UBS trader Kweku Adoboli , who was arrested on September 15 and is now facing charges of fraud and false accounting .
Translation: 瑞银交易员奎库·阿多博利的最新案例就体现了这种困境。他于9月15日被捕，目前面临欺诈和做假账的指控。

Query_Text_en: UBS -LRB- UBS -RRB- says he covered up unauthorized trades over the past three months that lost the company $ 2.3 billion .
Translation: 瑞银（UBS）称，其交易员在过去三个月隐瞒了未经授权的交易，导致公司损失23亿美元。

Query_Text_en: This is particularly awkward for UBS as the bank recently overhauled its risk management system .
Translation: 这对瑞银集团尤为棘手，因其风险管理体系近期刚经历全面整改。

Query_Text_en: Granted , preventing rogue trading is no easy task , `` Nobody who 's in this game would be foolish enough to believe that it could n't happen to them , '' says David Johnson , managing director in consultancy firm Protiviti 's Houston office
Translation: 诚然，防范违规交易绝非易事。咨询公司甫瀚咨询休斯顿办事处董事总经理戴维·约翰逊表示："业内从业者若认为这种事绝不会发生在自己身上，那未免太过天真。"

Query_Text_en: Without knowing the details of UBS ' security measures , there are a couple of best practices banks should follow .
Translation: 在不了解瑞银具体安保措施细节的情况下，银行仍应遵循若干最佳实践准则。

Query_Text_en: Companies need to have security systems that flag suspicious trades , and on top of that , managers need to review trading activity .
Translation: 企业须建立能识别可疑交易的安全系统，此外，管理层还需对交易活动进行审查。

Query_Text_en: Every year or so , the company needs to do thorough internal audits to see which parts of their business may be vulnerable to unauthorized trading .
Translation: 该公司约需每年开展全面内部审计，以排查业务环节中可能存在的未授权交易风险点。

Query_Text_en: Companies can even record conversations that traders have from their desk phones .
Translation: 企业甚至可以记录交易员通过座机进行的通话内容。

Query_Text_en: But beyond operational security , preventing rogue trading is a question of hiring and corporate culture .
Translation: 但除了操作安全外，防范违规交易的关键在于人才选用与企业文化建设。

Query_Text_en: Managers must create an environment that counteracts the powerful psychological forces that encourage smart traders to make bad decisions that put the company at risk .
Translation: 管理者必须营造一种环境，以抵消那些促使精明交易员做出危及公司利益的错误决策的强大心理诱因。

Query_Text_en: First off , the job selects for employees who believe they can beat the market .
Translation: 首先，这份工作筛选的是那些相信自己能跑赢市场的员工。

Query_Text_en: To be a good trader , you almost have to create a kind of mythology around your ability , says Johnson , `` People who are in that business tend to be willing to place large bets , they 're very comfortable with that , '' he says .
Translation: 约翰逊表示："要成为一名优秀的交易员，你几乎必须为自己的能力创造某种神话色彩。从事这个行业的人往往愿意下大赌注，他们对此非常适应。"

Query_Text_en: Besides , it 's a fair bet that managers do not root out unauthorized trades unless they lose the company money .
Translation: 此外，几乎可以肯定的是，除非未经授权的交易给公司造成损失，否则管理层不会彻底清查这些交易。

Query_Text_en: `` You have n't heard of financial scandals where a rogue trader has earned $ 2 billion extra for the company , '' says Barry Staw , a professor of leadership and communication at the University of California , Berkeley .
Translation: 加州大学伯克利分校领导力与传播学教授巴里·斯托指出："你何曾听说过哪个违规交易员为公司多赚20亿美元的财务丑闻？"

Query_Text_en: Traders who have bet correctly on unauthorized trades are inadvertently rewarded , making the behavior tough to break .
Translation: 那些在未经授权交易中押对注的交易员会无意中获得奖励，使得此类行为难以杜绝。

Query_Text_en: But perhaps the biggest mental glitch at work is the temptation to make a series of irrational decisions after losing money .
Translation: 但或许最严重的心理误区在于，人们总倾向于在亏损后做出一连串非理性决策。

Query_Text_en: Almost everyone falls prey to this phenomenon , according to Staw 's research ; it 's called `` escalation of commitment . ''
Translation: 根据斯托的研究，几乎所有人都难逃这一现象的影响，这种现象被称为"承诺升级"。

Query_Text_en: In trading , this means that even though trades are discrete events , it is near impossible for people not to factor a previous loss into their current decisions .
Translation: 在交易中，这意味着尽管每笔交易都是独立事件，但人们几乎不可能不将之前的亏损纳入当前决策考量。

Query_Text_en: The result is that when we want to dig ourselves out of a hole , we make decisions that a third-party observer could clearly identify as bad ones .
Translation: 其结果是，当我们试图摆脱困境时，往往会做出第三方观察者一眼就能识别的错误决策。

Query_Text_en: At a certain point , people hit a threshold where irrational choices actually become rational .
Translation: 当达到某个临界点时，人们的不理性选择反而会变得合乎理性。

Query_Text_en: Say a trader is losing money , and he begins to make riskier and riskier bets .
Translation: 假设一名交易员正在亏损，他开始进行越来越冒险的押注。

Query_Text_en: He realizes that his career is in jeopardy and he might even be arrested .
Translation: 他意识到自己的职业生涯岌岌可危，甚至可能面临被捕。

Query_Text_en: The penalty may not change much , for the trader , whether he has lost $ 1 billion or $ 2 billion .
Translation: 无论交易员亏损10亿美元还是20亿美元，其面临的处罚可能并无二致。

Query_Text_en: If that 's the case , once he crosses that threshold , it is rational to go double or nothing in an attempt to get out of the hole .
Translation: 既然如此，一旦他跨过这一临界点，孤注一掷以求翻本便成为理性选择。

Query_Text_en: Although there 's still plenty of money at stake for the company , the trader likely has nothing more to lose at this stage .
Translation: 尽管公司仍有大量资金岌岌可危，但该交易员现阶段很可能已无更多损失可言。

Query_Text_en: And people operating in crisis mode tend to look out for their own skin rather than the common good .
Translation: 处于危机应对模式的人往往只顾自身安危，而非谋求共同利益。

Query_Text_en: It 's still unclear what happened with Adoboli , but in general , it is difficult to reverse this pattern of risky betting once a person feels trapped .
Translation: 目前尚不清楚阿多博利的案件详情，但通常而言，一旦陷入这种困境，人们很难扭转这种高风险押注的行为模式。

Query_Text_en: One of the best ways to prevent this behavior does n't rely on security software but rather the culture in an office .
Translation: 防范此类行为的最佳方式之一并非依赖安全软件，而是取决于办公室文化。

Query_Text_en: Even though traders operate in such a high-pressure environment , they need to feel like they can talk to their managers about problems , insecurities about trades they might have done wrong , and near misses .
Translation: 尽管交易员身处高压工作环境，他们仍需确信能与上级坦诚沟通——无论是业务难题、对潜在操作失误的担忧，还是那些侥幸避免的交易风险。

Query_Text_en: One of the risks of raising the penalty for mistakes is that traders may feel less inclined to come forward with small errors that could be learning opportunities , Staw says .
Translation: 斯托指出，提高对错误的惩罚力度存在一个风险：交易员可能更不愿意主动报告小失误，而这些小失误本可以成为学习机会。

Query_Text_en: Then the company only sees the huge ones that are too big to hide .
Translation: 于是公司只能发现那些规模过大而无法掩盖的重大问题。

Query_Text_en: Investing is so prone to this kind of behavior that employers need to put all systems of checks and balances in place : extremely thorough hiring practices , an open culture of communication , strong technology to catch suspicious trades , and hyper vigilant human oversight
Translation: 投资行业极易滋生此类行为，因此雇主必须建立全方位的制衡机制：包括严苛的招聘审查制度、开放的沟通文化、用于监测可疑交易的技术手段，以及高度警觉的人工监督体系。

Query_Text_en: As one of David Johnson 's clients once told him , `` You have to hope that your traders are the finest moral people around .
Translation: 正如戴维·约翰逊的一位客户所言："你必须指望自己的交易员是业内最具操守的人。"

Query_Text_en: Then , you set up your policies and your rules as if they 're all lying , cheating crooks . ''
Translation: "然后，你们制定的政策和规则，就好像所有人都是撒谎、欺诈的骗子似的。"

Query_Text_en: The European economic contagion that began 18 months ago as a sovereign debt crisis is dangerously mutating into a full-blown banking crisis .
Translation: 始于18个月前的主权债务危机，如今正危险地演变为一场全面爆发的银行业危机，欧洲经济困局持续蔓延。

Query_Text_en: With Greece in de-facto market default , weak banks within the eurozone have started to fall ill as their investors , trading partners and clients pull short-term funding .
Translation: 随着希腊陷入实际市场违约，欧元区实力薄弱的银行因投资者、贸易伙伴及客户抽离短期资金而开始陷入困境。

Query_Text_en: The move by central banks on Thursday to provide extended U.S. dollar loans to European banks is only a stopgap measure .
Translation: 周四各国央行向欧洲银行提供长期美元贷款的措施仅是权宜之计。

Query_Text_en: A Lehman Brothers-like collapse or a Northern Rock-like bank run still can not be ruled out at this point for several of the eurozone 's largest financial institutions .
Translation: 目前仍不能排除欧元区若干大型金融机构出现类似雷曼兄弟的倒闭或北岩银行般的挤兑风险。

Query_Text_en: The market has hammered French banks into the ground first , but banks in Italy , Spain , Germany and the United Kingdom face serious funding issues as well .
Translation: 市场首先重创了法国银行业，但意大利、西班牙、德国和英国的银行同样面临严重的融资困境。

Query_Text_en: Swift action is needed on the part of eurozone members to shore up confidence in its crippled banking sector
Translation: 欧元区成员国需迅速采取行动，以提振对其受创银行业的信心。

Query_Text_en: The expansion of the European Financial Stability Facility -LRB- EFSF -RRB- is a good start , but more money will be needed to ensure investors that it 's all clear to park their cash with European banks again .
Translation: 欧洲金融稳定机制(EFSF)的扩容是一个良好开端，但需要投入更多资金，才能让投资者确信可以再次放心地将资金存入欧洲银行。

Query_Text_en: But the violent drops in their share prices seem to go beyond the banks ' exposure to Greece and the credit downgrade .
Translation: 但银行股价的暴跌似乎不仅源于其对希腊的风险敞口和信用评级下调。

Query_Text_en: Some of the extra losses baked in to the market value haircut derive from the bank 's exposure to the private Greek credit market through the bank 's local subsidiary .
Translation: 希腊银行市值缩水中的部分额外亏损源于其通过当地子公司对希腊私营信贷市场的风险敞口。

Query_Text_en: Banks fund their activities in many ways and through a myriad of currencies .
Translation: 银行通过多种方式和货币为其业务活动提供资金支持。

Query_Text_en: The most reliable source of funding for a bank is common equity capital , followed by the money received from depositors through checking and savings accounts .
Translation: 银行最可靠的资金来源是普通股本，其次是通过支票和储蓄账户从储户处获得的资金。

Query_Text_en: But in Europe , especially in France , a large chunk of funding comes in the form of short-term loans from prime money funds , money market accounts and other banks .
Translation: 但在欧洲，尤其是法国，相当一部分资金来源于主要货币基金、货币市场账户及其他银行提供的短期贷款。

Query_Text_en: This short-term funding is rolled over nightly in some cases , making it an extremely unreliable and volatile source of funding .
Translation: 在某些情况下，这类短期资金需每日滚动续借，因而成为极不稳定且波动性极高的融资来源。

Query_Text_en: The Lehman collapse in 2008 showed the world how dangerous it was to depend on short-term funding .
Translation: 2008年雷曼兄弟的破产向世界揭示了依赖短期融资的巨大风险。

Query_Text_en: Rumors of the bank 's imminent collapse caused dealers to pull their short-term funding and within days the bank was insolvent .
Translation: 关于该银行即将倒闭的传言导致交易商撤回了短期资金，短短数日内该银行便陷入资不抵债的境地。

Query_Text_en: A similar situation seems to be taking place in Europe , but in slow motion .
Translation: 欧洲似乎也出现了类似情况，只是进程更为缓慢。

Query_Text_en: This has forced the French banks to take out U.S. dollar loans from the European Central Bank at a higher interest rate in order to have enough U.S. dollars to fund their capital markets and financing activities .
Translation: 这迫使法国各银行不得不以更高利率从欧洲央行获取美元贷款，以确保拥有充足美元资金来维持其资本市场运作和融资活动。

Query_Text_en: Banks are required to hold a certain percentage of their assets in cash and other liquid securities to protect themselves from funding shortfalls that could be caused by not having enough dollars on hand .
Translation: 银行须将一定比例的资产以现金及其他流动性证券形式持有，以防范因手头美元储备不足而引发的资金短缺风险。

Query_Text_en: This has helped to quell the violent downswing in French bank stocks , but it is only a temporary measure to give the banks enough time to sell assets and raise permanent capital .
Translation: 此举虽有助于平息法国银行股的暴跌，但仅是权宜之计，旨在为银行争取时间出售资产并筹集长期资本。

Query_Text_en: It was widely believed that a liquidity crisis had been taken off the table for all U.S. banks , but it failed to address the root causes of the liquidity crisis that took Bear down to begin with : solvency and confidence .
Translation: 市场普遍认为美国银行业已摆脱流动性危机，但这并未从根本上解决导致贝尔斯登破产的症结——偿付能力与市场信心问题。

Query_Text_en: Of course , the Fed discount window was not enough to save Lehman Brothers and this temporary measure by the ECB wo n't save European banks either if they fail to build a strong capital buffer .
Translation: 当然，美联储的贴现窗口未能挽救雷曼兄弟，而欧洲央行这一临时举措同样无法拯救欧洲银行——若它们未能建立坚实的资本缓冲。

Query_Text_en: Since 2008 , banks have beefed up this buffer , known as Tier 1 capital , but the French banks have been slow to do so , making them more vulnerable to a short-term funding blip .
Translation: 2008年以来，各银行纷纷强化了被称为"一级资本"的这一缓冲机制，但法国银行业行动迟缓，导致其更易受到短期融资波动的影响。

Query_Text_en: In contrast , Suisse banking giant UBS has increased its Tier 1 ratio from 10.8 % to a whopping 16.1 % over the same period .
Translation: 相比之下，瑞士银行业巨头瑞银集团同期将一级资本充足率从10.8%大幅提升至16.1%。

Query_Text_en: It just needs to be high enough in which investors feel confident that the bank can withstand future losses .
Translation: 只需达到令投资者确信该银行能够抵御未来亏损的充足水平即可。

Query_Text_en: The sovereign debt crisis has evolved into a crisis of confidence , with the French banks being served up as whipping boy , but they are certainly not going to be the last if left unchecked .
Translation: 主权债务危机已演变为一场信心危机，法国银行业首当其冲成为众矢之的。但若放任自流，它们绝不会是最后一批受害者。

Query_Text_en: In Europe , nearly all the major banks have large eurozone sovereign debt holdings . They also hold fewer deposits in relation to their outstanding loans compared with U.S. and Asian banks .
Translation: 在欧洲，几乎所有大型银行都持有大量欧元区主权债务。与美国和亚洲银行相比，这些银行的存款与未偿还贷款比率也较低。

Query_Text_en: Barclays found that nine of the largest 14 European banks have illiquid net loans held for investment that exceeded the amount of deposits on hand , making them dependent on volatile funding from the capital markets .
Translation: 巴克莱银行研究发现，欧洲14家大型银行中有9家的投资性净贷款流动性不足，且规模超过其现有存款总额，这使得它们不得不依赖资本市场上波动性较大的融资渠道。

Query_Text_en: Italian banks Intesa Sanpaolo , with 160 % , and Unicredit , with a 149 % , along with the UK 's Lloyds , also with 149 % , had worst ratios , equating to an absolute deficit of deposits to loans amounting to 139 billion euros , 185 billion euros and 214 billion euros , respectively .
Translation: 意大利的联合圣保罗银行（存贷比160%）和联合信贷银行（149%），以及英国的劳埃德银行（同为149%）存贷比状况最为严峻，其存款对贷款的绝对缺口分别达到1390亿欧元、1850亿欧元和2140亿欧元。

Query_Text_en: `` This is key to cutting the chains of contagion , '' she said .
Translation: "这是切断传播链的关键所在，"她表示。

Query_Text_en: It is unclear how much the funding shortfall is at this point .
Translation: 目前尚不清楚资金缺口的具体规模。

Query_Text_en: Money managers tell Fortune that their models suggest somewhere around $ 500 billion , which is derived by essentially adding up all the peripheral sovereign debt held by European banks .
Translation: 基金经理向《财富》透露，其测算模型显示规模约为5000亿美元，该数据主要通过累加欧洲银行持有的所有外围主权债务得出。

Query_Text_en: Whatever the number , it will need to be really big to bring confidence back .
Translation: 无论具体数额如何，要重振市场信心，这一数字必须足够庞大。

Query_Text_en: The Troubled Asset Relief Program -LRB- TARP -RRB- , set up in 2008 to recapitalize the US banking sector , was $ 700 billion . In Europe , the European Financial Stability Facility -LRB- EFSF -RRB- will be 440 billion euros or around $ 600 billion , once its enlargement is ratified by the parliaments of all 17 members of the eurozone .
Translation: 2008年为重振美国银行业资本而设立的"问题资产救助计划"(TARP)规模达7000亿美元。在欧洲，待欧元区17个成员国议会全部批准扩容方案后，"欧洲金融稳定安排"(EFSF)的规模将达到4400亿欧元（约合6000亿美元）。

Query_Text_en: Now , the EFSF is n't exactly TARP , as its mandate is to recapitalize profligate governments , not banks .
Translation: 目前，欧洲金融稳定基金（EFSF）与问题资产救助计划（TARP）存在本质区别，其职责是为财政挥霍的成员国政府而非银行注资。

Query_Text_en: But once the nation receives the cash , they can then turn around and inject it into their troubled banks .
Translation: 然而一旦该国获得这笔资金，便可立即将其注入问题银行。

Query_Text_en: The fear is that the market is already pricing in passage of the EFSF .
Translation: 市场担忧的是，欧洲金融稳定基金的扩容方案可能已被提前消化。

Query_Text_en: If so , then it is sending a clear signal to European finance ministers that $ 600 billion is not enough to restore confidence in the system .
Translation: 果真如此，那么这向欧洲各国财长发出了明确信号：6000亿美元不足以重振市场对金融体系的信心。

Query_Text_en: Treasury Secretary Timothy Geithner , one of the architects of the TARP program , is in Poland today attending an informal meeting of European finance ministers .
Translation: 美国财政部长蒂莫西·盖特纳今日赴波兰出席欧洲财长非正式会议，他曾是"问题资产救助计划"（TARP）的主要设计者之一。

Query_Text_en: He could be there to help the Europeans see the benefits of using the EFSF as a vehicle to restore confidence in the eurozone .
Translation: 他此行旨在帮助欧洲各方认识到，利用欧洲金融稳定基金作为工具来恢复市场对欧元区的信心将大有裨益。

Query_Text_en: If the fund is repackaged in that way , it may help to ease investor fears .
Translation: 若该基金以这种方式重新包装，或有助于缓解投资者的担忧。

Query_Text_en: The program will only serve to restore confidence in order to avoid a run on the banking sector and to give all parties some breathing room to get their houses in order .
Translation: 该计划旨在恢复市场信心，避免银行业发生挤兑，同时为各方争取喘息空间以完成内部整顿。

Query_Text_en: Eventually , real structural changes will need to take place to fix the troubles of the eurozone .
Translation: 最终，欧元区仍需通过实质性结构性改革来化解危机。

Query_Text_en: Europe has the opportunity to devise real structural changes to the eurozone that would prevent another sovereign debt crisis , namely the centralization of the zone 's fiscal and monetary policy .
Translation: 欧洲有机会对欧元区实施真正的结构性改革，通过集中财政与货币政策权限，从而避免主权债务危机重演。

Query_Text_en: It remains to be seen if there is strong enough will in the 17 capitals of the eurozone to take such a bold step .
Translation: 欧元区17国是否有足够强烈的意愿迈出如此大胆的一步，仍有待观察。

Query_Text_en: Failure to do so could put the continent right back where they started in just a couple years time .
Translation: 若不采取行动，非洲大陆可能不出数年就会重蹈覆辙。

Query_Text_en: The 99 % may soon have some new members - employees of Goldman Sachs .
Translation: 高盛员工可能即将加入"99%群体"行列。

Query_Text_en: The average compensation at Goldman -LRB- GS -RRB- is likely to fall by nearly $ 100,000 by the end of next year as new regulations , fewer deals and legal payouts hurt the firm 's profitability .
Translation: 受新规实施、交易减少及法律赔偿支出影响，高盛集团盈利能力受损，预计到明年年底其员工平均薪酬将下降近10万美元。

Query_Text_en: That 's the conclusion of a recent report from a European division of rival JPMorgan Chase -LRB- JPM -RRB- .
Translation: 这是摩根大通(JPM)欧洲部门近期一份报告得出的结论。

Query_Text_en: As recently as two years ago , Goldman 's annual pay , which includes everyone from the people who work in the firm 's IT department to CEO Lloyd Blankfein , had averaged $ 412,000 .
Translation: 就在两年前，高盛员工的平均年薪（涵盖从IT部门职员到首席执行官劳埃德·布兰克费恩在内的所有员工）仍高达41.2万美元。

Query_Text_en: That salary put employees of the elite investment bank solidly in the top 1 % of all earners in the United States .
Translation: 这一薪资水平使这家顶级投行的员工稳稳跻身美国收入最高的1%人群之列。

Query_Text_en: Last year , the cut off for the 1 % was $ 368,000 .
Translation: 去年，收入前1%人群的门槛为36.8万美元。

Query_Text_en: But by the end of next year , though , analysts at JPMorgan Cazenove expect compensation at Goldman to average just $ 314,000 .
Translation: 然而，摩根大通嘉诚分析师预计，到明年年底，高盛员工平均薪酬将降至31.4万美元。

Query_Text_en: That will bump the average Goldmanite all the way down to near the bottom of the top 2 % of all U.S. earners .
Translation: 这将使高盛员工的平均收入水平降至全美收入前2%群体的底部区间。

Query_Text_en: The cut off for the 98 % tops out at around $ 290,000 .
Translation: 98%分位数的收入上限约为29万美元。

Query_Text_en: Needless to say , this is not nearly the crushing blow to the Masters of the Universe that some hoped the financial crisis would be .
Translation: 毋庸置疑，这场金融危机对金融寡头们的打击，远未达到某些人所期望的致命程度。

Query_Text_en: And remember this is average compensation .
Translation: 请记住，这是平均薪酬水平。

Query_Text_en: There are still plenty of Goldman bankers who make millions .
Translation: 高盛仍有众多银行家坐拥百万年薪。

Query_Text_en: Blankfein was paid $ 12 million for 2011 .
Translation: 2011年，布兰克费恩获得1200万美元薪酬。

Query_Text_en: Back in 2008 and 2009 , though , there was talk that the near collapse of Wall Street , and the fact that the government had to come to the rescue , would force financial firms to rethink how , and how much , they pay their employees .
Translation: 然而在2008和2009年，坊间曾热议华尔街几近崩溃的危局以及政府被迫施救的事实，或将迫使金融机构重新审视其员工薪酬的支付方式与标准。

Query_Text_en: Washington appointed a pay czar .
Translation: 华盛顿任命了一位薪资沙皇。

Query_Text_en: The Federal Reserve instituted new rules .
Translation: 美联储颁布了新规。

Query_Text_en: Clawback provisions became the norm .
Translation: 追回条款已成为行业惯例。

Query_Text_en: But the dollar figures have n't changed all that much .
Translation: 但美元金额并未发生太大变化。

Query_Text_en: The only thing that does appear to have made a slight dent in Wall Streeters ' wallets is Dodd-Frank and some other new international capital requirements , which is why , perhaps , bankers have objected so loudly .
Translation: 唯一似乎对华尔街人士的钱包造成轻微影响的，只有《多德-弗兰克法案》和其他一些新的国际资本要求——这或许正是银行家们强烈反对的原因。

Query_Text_en: Goldman has been among the most impacted .
Translation: 高盛是受影响最严重的机构之一。

Query_Text_en: Dodd-Frank bars the firm , and others , from certain high-profit , and high-risk , businesses , including proprietary trading and hedge fund investing , where Goldman has historically made a good deal of its profits .
Translation: 《多德-弗兰克法案》禁止高盛及其他金融机构从事包括自营交易和对冲基金投资在内的高利润、高风险业务，而这些领域历来是高盛的重要盈利来源。

Query_Text_en: What 's more , the new requirements will cause Goldman and other firms to hang onto more of their cash , rather then lend it out or invest it .
Translation: 此外，新规将迫使高盛及其他金融机构留存更多现金，而非用于放贷或投资。

Query_Text_en: All told , the analysts at JPMorgan say , if Goldman were to do nothing , regulatory reforms will knock the firm 's return on equity , a key measure of profitability , down to 10 % from 17 % shortly before the financial reforms went into place , though in many years it was much higher than that .
Translation: 摩根大通分析师指出，若高盛不采取任何应对措施，监管改革将导致其股本回报率（衡量盈利能力的关键指标）从金融改革实施前的17%降至10%。需注意的是，该指标在改革前多年间曾长期远高于这一水平。

Query_Text_en: In response , the analysts believe Goldman will cut employees and salaries in order to lower costs and repair profits .
Translation: 对此，分析师认为高盛将通过裁员降薪来削减成本、修复利润。

Query_Text_en: Goldman is likely to send an additional 4,400 people from its investment banking division packing .
Translation: 高盛可能将再裁减投行部门4400名员工。

Query_Text_en: As of the first quarter , Goldman 's staff had already shrunk by about 2,000 in the past year .
Translation: 截至第一季度，高盛员工总数在过去一年已缩减约2000人。

Query_Text_en: Goldmanites are still expected to take home more than rivals .
Translation: 高盛员工的薪酬仍有望领先同业。

Query_Text_en: According to the JPMorgan 's projections , the average investment banker at all firms will make $ 233,000 , down from $ 303,000 , before the regulations .
Translation: 摩根大通预测，新规实施后，各投行从业人员的平均薪酬将从30.3万美元降至23.3万美元。

Query_Text_en: But that figure may actually be higher . The JPMorgan analysts did n't include their own firm in the analysis .
Translation: 但实际数字可能更高。摩根大通的分析师并未将自家公司纳入分析范围。

Query_Text_en: Consultants say the firm 's compensation now rivals Goldman 's pay , which would bring up the industry-wide average .
Translation: 咨询机构表示，该公司目前的薪酬水平已与高盛看齐，此举将推高行业整体平均薪资。

Query_Text_en: Credit Suisse , in the survey , was expected to be the second highest paying investment bank in the world after Goldman at an average pay of $ 280,000 .
Translation: 瑞信在调查中预期将成为全球薪酬第二高的投行，平均薪酬达28万美元，仅次于高盛。

Query_Text_en: The average comp at Morgan Stanley -LRB- MS -RRB- could drop to $ 244,000 , which would put that firm 's employees in the top 3 % of all U.S. earnings .
Translation: 摩根士丹利(MS)的平均薪酬可能降至24.4万美元，这将使该行员工收入跻身全美前3%之列。

Query_Text_en: One of the top candidates to run the online trading firm , which is known for its trading baby television ads , says he is n't interested in the job .
Translation: 这家以婴儿电视广告闻名的在线交易公司首席执行官的热门人选之一表示，他对该职位不感兴趣。

Query_Text_en: Greg Fleming , who heads Morgan Stanley 's brokerage division and is overseeing its integration with Smith Barney , says he has no plans to leave his current position , according to sources close to Fleming .
Translation: 据接近弗莱明的消息人士透露，摩根士丹利经纪业务主管格雷格·弗莱明表示，他无意离开现职。弗莱明目前正负责摩根士丹利与美邦的整合事务。

Query_Text_en: The Morgan Stanley -LRB- MS -RRB- executive 's decision eliminates one of E * Trade Financial 's -LRB- ETFC -RRB- reportedly top choices to take over the firm 's CEO slot , which was vacated in early Augustwhen Steven Frieberg was ousted by the firm 's board of directors .
Translation: 摩根士丹利（MS）高管的决定排除了亿创理财（ETFC）据称接任公司CEO职位的主要人选之一。此前在8月初，史蒂文·弗里伯格被公司董事会解职，CEO职位因此空缺。

Query_Text_en: In the meantime , E * Trade , which has struggled to keep up with competitors TD Ameritrade and Charles Schwab , has appointed the chairman of its board Frank Petrilli to be the firm 's interim CEO .
Translation: 与此同时，一直难以跟上竞争对手TD Ameritrade和嘉信理财步伐的亿创理财公司，已任命其董事会主席弗兰克·佩特里利担任公司临时首席执行官。

Query_Text_en: Petrilli is getting $ 500,000 a month to fill the temp job .
Translation: 每月50万美元，佩特里利就任这个临时职位。

Query_Text_en: Petrelli can earn 500,000 US dollars every month from this temporary job.
Translation: 佩特雷利每月可从这份临时工作中赚取50万美元。

Query_Text_en: close to Ken Griffin
Translation: 接近肯·格里芬

Query_Text_en: Before that he was the President and COO of Merrill Lynch , and was instrumental is inking the acquisition of Merrill by Bank of America at the height of the financial crisis , which is widely seen as having saved Merrill from collapse .
Translation: 此前他曾担任美林证券总裁兼首席运营官，并在金融危机最严峻时期主导促成美国银行收购美林的关键交易。这一举措被普遍认为挽救了美林免于破产。

Query_Text_en: Nonetheless , Fleming left the combined firm shortly after the deal was completed .
Translation: 然而，弗莱明在交易完成后不久便离开了合并后的公司。

Query_Text_en: Griffin reportedly approached Fleming about taking over the top slot at E * Trade back in 2009 , but Fleming decided to go to Morgan Stanley instead .
Translation: 据报道，格里芬曾在2009年接洽弗莱明，邀请其出任亿创理财首席执行官一职，但弗莱明最终选择加盟摩根士丹利。

Query_Text_en: David Carroll , who runs Wells Fargo 's asset management unit , is also reportedly under consideration for the E * Trade job .
Translation: 据报道，富国银行资产管理部门的负责人大卫·卡罗尔也在E*Trade职位的考虑人选之列。

Query_Text_en: An E * Trade spokesman said the firm has n't official named any candidates for its CEO job .
Translation: 一位E*Trade发言人表示，该公司尚未正式敲定CEO职位的任何候选人。

Query_Text_en: He said the firm is close to hiring an executive search firm and has named five board members to its search committee
Translation: 他表示，公司即将聘请一家高管猎头公司，并已任命五名董事会成员组成遴选委员会。

Query_Text_en: Independent advisory firms are often called boutiques .
Translation: 独立咨询机构通常被称为精品投行。

Query_Text_en: But lately there has been nothing small about them .
Translation: 但近来这些举措的规模已不可小觑。

Query_Text_en: So far this year , M&A shops have scooped up nearly a fifth of U.S. advisory revenues , or fees bankers take when they advise deals , up from 13 % in 2011 and 9 % in 2006 , according to Dealogic .
Translation: Dealogic数据显示，今年迄今并购机构已攫取美国咨询业务近两成收入（即投行提供交易咨询所获佣金），较2011年的13%和2006年的9%显著提升。

Query_Text_en: Even more impressive is the fact that these figures do n't include several large announced -LRB- but not yet closed -RRB- deals where independent advisors played a prominent role , including Paul Taubman and Alan Schwartz 's advisory roles for Verizon -LRB- VZ -RRB- in its bid to buy all of Verizon Wireless , and Byron Trott 's role on Koch Industries recent $ 7 billion bid for Molex -LRB- MOLX -RRB- .
Translation: 更令人瞩目的是，这些数据尚未包含数宗已公布但未完成的大型交易——独立顾问在其中发挥了关键作用。例如保罗·陶布曼和艾伦·施瓦茨为威瑞森（VZ）收购威瑞森无线全部股权提供咨询，拜伦·特罗特则为科氏工业近期70亿美元收购莫仕（MOLX）的交易担任顾问。

Query_Text_en: Omnicom -LRB- OMC -RRB- and Publicis each had sole independent advisors , Moelis and Rothschild , respectively , on their recent merger in what one bulge bracket banker calls a `` watershed moment '' for the industry .
Translation: 宏盟集团（OMC）与阳狮集团近期合并案中，双方各自聘请了独立财务顾问——分别为Moelis和罗斯柴尔德。一位顶级投行人士称此举标志着行业"分水岭时刻"的到来。

Query_Text_en: `` The aberration is n't the boutique .
Translation: 反常的并非精品店本身。

Query_Text_en: `` The world developed with advisory and investment banks and commercial banks separate for a reason .
Translation: 世界将投行、咨询银行与商业银行分业经营自有其道理。

Query_Text_en: It was only a short time ago that everything was put together . ''
Translation: 不久前才把所有事情都安排妥当。

Query_Text_en: Moelis is talking about the late 1990s , when many investment banks were rapidly rolled up into large banks -LRB- think Salomon Brothers , Dillon Read , Alex.
Translation: 美驰所指的是上世纪90年代末期，当时众多投行被迅速整合进入大型银行集团（如所罗门兄弟、狄龙瑞德、亚历克斯等机构）。

Query_Text_en: Brown & Sons , or S.G. Warburg , to name a few -RRB- .
Translation: 布朗兄弟公司（Brown & Sons）和S.G.华宝公司（S.G. Warburg）等机构。

Query_Text_en: Now , many of the independent shops have grown to resemble the legacy investment banks before they were gobbled up by bigger firms .
Translation: 如今，许多独立投行已发展得与那些被大型金融集团吞并前的传统投行如出一辙。

Query_Text_en: Perella Weinberg has over 415 bankers .
Translation: 佩雷拉·温伯格集团拥有超过415名银行专业人士。

Query_Text_en: Moelis , which opened its doors in 2007 , has grown to 600 employees .
Translation: 莫里斯公司自2007年成立以来，员工规模已扩展至600人。

Query_Text_en: They pay better , and bankers have less hassle .
Translation: 银行薪资更优渥，且从业者压力更小。

Query_Text_en: `` Some of that is regulatory but also numerous bureaucratic internal committee processes , '' Moelis says .
Translation: "部分原因在于监管要求，但更多是由于内部委员会冗繁的行政流程，"莫里斯表示。

Query_Text_en: `` If I hire that same person , 97.8 % of their time will be external .
Translation: 若我聘用同一人，其97.8%的工作时间将用于对外事务。

Query_Text_en: We do n't have derivatives or a complex regulatory framework . ''
Translation: 我们没有衍生品，也没有复杂的监管框架。

Query_Text_en: Some people also say deals are becoming more litigated and scrutinized .
Translation: 也有人指出，当前交易面临更多诉讼与审查。

Query_Text_en: Icahn 's agitation of the Dell -LRB- DELL -RRB- takeover shows how complicated transactions can be .
Translation: 伊坎对戴尔公司(DELL)收购案的干预表明，此类交易可能极为复杂。

Query_Text_en: Independent advisors may be nudging themselves onto deals where a second advisor is needed .
Translation: 独立顾问可能正试图介入那些需要第二位顾问的交易。

Query_Text_en: But another reason for boutiques ' success may be that larger , unwieldy banks are conflicted .
Translation: 但精品投行成功的另一原因，或许在于规模庞大、运转不灵的大型银行存在利益冲突问题。

Query_Text_en: Critics say secrets are traded around the bank , and sometimes to other clients , in order to be on several sides of a deal .
Translation: 批评人士指出，该银行内部存在交易机密流转现象，有时甚至向其他客户泄露内幕信息，以便在同一笔交易中多方牟利。

Query_Text_en: `` You get a call from a client in the morning that they want to sell themselves , and by the afternoon , 40 voicemails have shipped around the world , '' says an ex-bulge bracket banker who spoke on the condition of anonymity .
Translation: 一位要求匿名的前顶级投行银行家表示："早上接到客户电话说要出售公司，到了下午，40通语音留言已在全球传遍。"

Query_Text_en: A Delaware judge criticized Barclays -LRB- BCS -RRB- for its conflicted role on Del Monte 's 2011 buyout .
Translation: 特拉华州一名法官批评巴克莱银行(BCS)在德尔蒙食品2011年收购案中存在利益冲突。

Query_Text_en: Goldman Sachs 's -LRB- GS -RRB- role on advising El Paso on its merger with Kinder Morgan and El Paso played out in court last year .
Translation: 高盛(GS)去年就其担任埃尔帕索(El Paso)与金德摩根(Kinder Morgan)合并交易的顾问一事出庭作证。

Query_Text_en: Delaware chancellor Leo Strine said about the deal , `` Although Goldman 's conflict was known , inadequate efforts to cabin its role were made . ''
Translation: 特拉华州大法官利奥·斯特林对此交易评论称："尽管高盛的利益冲突众所周知，但对其角色加以约束的努力仍显不足。"

Query_Text_en: He continued : `` The record thus persuades me that the plaintiffs have a reasonable likelihood of success in proving that the Merger was tainted by disloyalty . ''
Translation: 他接着表示："现有证据使我有理由相信，原告方极有可能成功证明此次并购交易存在背信行为。"

Query_Text_en: Goldman was n't paid as an investment bank advisor for Kinder Morgan , but owned 19 % of the shares and had two board seats .
Translation: 高盛并非以投行顾问身份为金德摩根提供服务，而是持有该公司19%的股份并拥有两个董事会席位。

Query_Text_en: Both Goldman and Kinder Morgan made financial concessions to settle the case , but did not admit to wrongdoing .
Translation: 高盛和金德摩根均作出经济让步以达成和解，但未承认存在不当行为。

Query_Text_en: Yet Barclays has lost only a small amount of market share over the past year .
Translation: 然而过去一年间，巴克莱银行仅流失了少量市场份额。

Query_Text_en: Goldman continues to top the charts and has gained market share since that judgmen
Translation: 高盛持续领跑行业榜单，自判决以来市场份额持续攀升。

Query_Text_en: `` Sometimes big banks have relationships with several companies within an industry , '' says Joseph Perella , co-founder , chairman and CEO of Perella Weinberg Partners and former Morgan Stanley Vice Chairman .
Translation: 佩雷拉·温伯格合伙公司联合创始人、董事长兼首席执行官、摩根士丹利前副董事长约瑟夫·佩雷拉表示："大型银行有时会与同一行业内的多家企业建立业务往来。"

Query_Text_en: `` This is n't necessarily a bad thing .
Translation: 这未必是件坏事。

Query_Text_en: It 's often necessitated by their business model , which is costly .
Translation: 这通常是由其高成本的商业模式所决定的。

Query_Text_en: They ca n't rely on having one client in the industry . ''
Translation: 他们不能仅依赖行业内的单一客户。

Query_Text_en: He adds , `` There are a lot of good people who have very good insights .
Translation: 他补充道："许多优秀人士都具备深刻的洞察力。"

Query_Text_en: I think the clients ' problem is not with the individuals but the institution . ''
Translation: 我认为客户的问题不在于个人，而在于制度本身。

Query_Text_en: Though some other big banks have been losing share over the past year , bulge bracket bankers are quick to point out that they are n't the only ones conflicted .
Translation: 尽管过去一年其他一些大型银行市场份额有所下滑，但顶级投行人士迅速指出，并非只有他们面临利益冲突困境。

Query_Text_en: The idea that a boutique investment bank is independent is `` hogwash , '' says one bulge bracket M&A banker who spoke on the condition of anonymity .
Translation: 一位不愿具名的华尔街大型并购银行家表示："所谓精品投行具有独立性，纯属无稽之谈。"

Query_Text_en: `` The difference between getting or not getting a deal can make that banker 's year or quarter .
Translation: 能否达成交易，将直接决定这位银行家本年或本季度的业绩成败。

Query_Text_en: If I 'm giving advice to a $ 1.5 billion client , it 's going to be honest advice . ''
Translation: "如果我要给一家价值15亿美元的客户提供建议，那必定是坦诚相见的忠告。"

Query_Text_en: Moreover , as these independent shops grow beyond M&A alone , as many of them are doing , it is hard to see how other conflicts wo n't creep in .
Translation: 此外，随着这些独立店铺的业务范围超越并购领域（许多店铺已在这样做），其他利益冲突的滋生恐将难以避免。

Query_Text_en: What the bank 's CEO Jamie Dimon needs to realize is that the real problem does not lie in the actual sizeof the assets it manages , but in the varying risk profiles across its divisions .
Translation: 摩根大通首席执行官杰米·戴蒙必须认识到，真正的问题不在于其管理的资产规模，而在于各部门差异化的风险特征。

Query_Text_en: To address this , JPM should consider reorganizing its business into three broad divisions and spinning off each of the divisions into a separate company , shares of which would be held both by existing shareholders as well as new ones through IPOs .
Translation: 为解决这一问题，摩根大通应考虑将其业务重组为三大板块，并将每个板块分拆为独立公司。这些分拆公司的股份将通过首次公开募股，由现有股东及新股东共同持有。

Query_Text_en: The three divisions , which would comprise parts of the existing five divisions of the bank , should be :
Translation: 这三个新部门将由该行现有五个部门的部分业务重组而成，具体包括：

Query_Text_en: Traditional Banking -LRB- consisting of deposits and consumer , corporate , and mortgage lending -RRB-
Translation: 传统银行业务（包括存款、个人及企业贷款以及抵押贷款）

Query_Text_en: Each of these divisions then , if traded separately in the market , can be valued based on their appetite for risk and desire for returns , yielding more accurate valuations .
Translation: 若将这些业务部门分别置于市场交易，便可依据各自的风险偏好与收益预期进行独立估值，从而得出更为精确的价值评估结果。

Query_Text_en: More importantly , separating out traditional banking , investment banking , and proprietary trading into standalone companies with their own balance sheets will go a long way in assuaging government regulators and , in my assessment , promoting better risk management .
Translation: 更重要的是，将传统银行业务、投行业务与自营交易拆分为独立运营且各自拥有资产负债表的公司，将极大缓解政府监管机构的担忧。在我看来，此举还将推动更完善的风险管理体系构建。

Query_Text_en: This in turn is likely to lead to a higher valuation for the sum of the parts compared to the whole because of a lack of profit-bleed between the businesses and greater accountability within each publicly traded division .
Translation: 这很可能导致分拆后各部分估值总和高于集团整体估值，原因在于各业务板块间避免了利润流失，且每个上市部门的责任划分更为明晰。

Query_Text_en: More importantly, splitting traditional banks, investment banks and proprietary trading into three independent and self-financing companies is expected to greatly satisfy government regulatory authorities, and in my opinion, it can also promote better risk management.
Translation: 更重要的是，将传统银行业务、投行业务与自营交易拆分为三家独立且自负盈亏的公司，预计将极大满足政府监管机构的要求。在我看来，此举还能推动更完善的风险管理。

Query_Text_en: That is no doubt due to the many legal troubles that the bank is facing , not to mention the bad press that the bank has sustained , and even perhaps due to the antagonistic relationship that Dimon has had with US regulators , particularly over Dodd-Frank .
Translation: 这无疑源于该银行面临的多重法律纠纷，更遑论其持续遭受的负面舆论压力，甚至可能还与戴蒙与美国监管机构——尤其是围绕《多德-弗兰克法案》——长期存在的对立关系有关。

Query_Text_en: A sharp observer will recognize that such a spin-off into three divisions would be a voluntary re-creation of the Glass-Steagall Act of 1934 , which mandated the separation of investment and commercial banking with the aim of controlling risk within banks , but that is precisely what is needed in the post-2008 environment .
Translation: 敏锐的观察者会发现，将业务分拆为三个部门正是对1934年《格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法案》的主动重构。该法案要求投资银行与商业银行分业经营，旨在控制银行体系风险——而这恰恰是2008年后金融环境所亟需的制度安排。

Query_Text_en: JPM may be the nation 's largest bank and it may have weathered the financial crisis better than others , but that does not make it immune to the reality it is facing now , and action is imperative .
Translation: 摩根大通虽是美国最大银行，且在金融危机中表现优于同业，但这并不意味着其能对当前困境免疫，采取行动已刻不容缓。

Query_Text_en: An even bigger consideration for investors should be that even if all the charges against the bank do not actually stick , the distraction of fighting so many legal battles , the cost -LRB- $ 17.3 billion from 2010 through 2012 alone and several billions more to come -RRB- , the public relations nightmare that will accompany this , and the fact that JPM 's many alleged infractions have made it a prime candidate to be broken up by the government , will do plenty of damage in itself .
Translation: 投资者更应考量的是：即便针对该银行的所有指控最终均不成立，应对如此多诉讼的干扰（仅2010至2012年就支出173亿美元，后续还将有数十亿美元）、随之而来的公关危机，以及摩根大通因多项涉嫌违规行为成为政府分拆首要目标的事实，这些因素本身就会造成巨大损害。

Query_Text_en: In other words , if the bank does not reorganize its varied lines of business to silo risk of its own volition , then that job will either be done by the government or the bank will continue to be punished by the markets for not doing so .
Translation: 换言之，若银行不主动重组其多元化业务条线以隔离风险，那么这项工作要么将由政府代为完成，要么银行将因无所作为而持续遭受市场惩罚。

Query_Text_en: Conversely , a spin off will protect the interests of existing shareholders while helping to unlock further value in the bank 's assets through new investors .
Translation: 反之，分拆上市既能保护现有股东利益，又能通过引入新投资者进一步释放银行资产价值。

Query_Text_en: Anything less will be a disservice to all investors .
Translation: 任何低于此标准的做法都将损害所有投资者的利益。

Query_Text_en: It is possible , of course , that Dimon will refuse to take such steps out of a much-publicized aversion to regulation and his desire to maintain control of his banking empire , but then that would be an even bigger breach of his responsibility towards his bank .
Translation: 当然，戴蒙可能出于众所周知的厌恶监管和掌控银行帝国的执念而拒绝采取这些措施，但那样的话，他将以更严重的方式背弃对银行的责任。

Query_Text_en: It is better for JPMorgan Chase to embrace change on its own terms by breaking itself up into three parts , and reaping the benefits , than to resist the change and risk an ongoing regulatory nightmare that will eat into the bank 's profits , and hurt shareholders .
Translation: 摩根大通与其抗拒变革、深陷监管泥潭导致利润受损、股东利益受创，不如主动求变，将自身拆分为三大业务板块，从而收获转型红利。

Query_Text_en: He has worked at leading investment banks Lazard Freres and Dresdner Kleinwort Wasserstein , as well as at a multi-billion dollar hedge fund .
Translation: 他曾任职于知名投资银行拉扎德兄弟公司和德利佳华，并在一家管理资产规模达数十亿美元的对冲基金工作。

Query_Text_en: And Turkey 's lira is down 15 % .
Translation: 土耳其里拉贬值15%。

Query_Text_en: Stock markets in both countries have taken hits as well .
Translation: 两国股市也遭受重创。

Query_Text_en: Brazil 's stock market , too , long a darling of Wall Street , is down 20 % this year .
Translation: 巴西股市这一长期受华尔街青睐的宠儿，今年也已下跌20%。

Query_Text_en: Right now , bank investors do n't seem too concerned .
Translation: 目前，银行投资者似乎并不太担忧。

Query_Text_en: Shares of bank stocks have fallen 4 % in the past month as the situation in emerging markets has gotten worse .
Translation: 过去一个月，随着新兴市场局势恶化，银行股股价已下跌4%。

Query_Text_en: But investors often stay in denial long after they should .
Translation: 但投资者往往在应当醒悟后仍执迷不悟。

Query_Text_en: `` In general , bank investors have n't been overall concerned , '' says Credit Suisse analyst Moshe Orenbuch , who follows bank stocks .
Translation: 瑞士信贷分析师莫希·奥伦布奇表示："总体而言，银行投资者并未表现出普遍担忧。"这位专注于银行股研究的专家如是说。

Query_Text_en: `` If all of a sudden one of these markets explodes then everyone will be rushing to look at exposures . ''
Translation: "倘若其中任一市场突然崩盘，各方必将紧急核查风险敞口。"

Query_Text_en: In early June , bank analysts in JPMorgan Chase 's London office wrote a report titled `` Fed Tapering : Who is Afraid of EM -LSB- emerging market -RSB- Selloff ? We Are ! ''
Translation: 6月初，摩根大通伦敦分行的银行业分析师撰写了一份题为《美联储缩表：谁在担忧新兴市场抛售潮？我们！》的报告。

Query_Text_en: The report said that rising interest rates would dramatically slow bond sales in emerging markets and work for the big banks .
Translation: 报告指出，利率上升将显著减缓新兴市场的债券销售，但对大型银行有利。

Query_Text_en: The report was focused on the European banks and said that British banks Standard Charter and HSBC stand to lose the most business .
Translation: 报告聚焦于欧洲银行，指出英国银行渣打和汇丰将流失最多业务。

Query_Text_en: In the U.S. , that bank could be Citigroup -LRB- C -RRB- .
Translation: 在美国，这家银行可能是花旗集团（C）。

Query_Text_en: According to the bank 's most recent earningspresentations , Citi generated nearly half of all its earnings in the emerging markets .
Translation: 根据该银行最新财报显示，花旗集团近半数利润来自新兴市场。

Query_Text_en: Already a number of banks say they 're pulling back from Brazil , where a number of Wall Street firms , including Goldman Sachs -LRB- GS -RRB- , had ambitions plans to expand just a few months ago .
Translation: 多家银行表示正缩减在巴西的业务。就在数月前，高盛(GS)等华尔街机构还雄心勃勃地计划拓展该国市场。

Query_Text_en: But what really drives financial crises , or shocks in the market on fears of them , is not lower revenue , but how much banks could lose if those markets continue to tumble .
Translation: 然而，真正引发金融危机或市场恐慌性震荡的并非收入减少，而是若市场持续暴跌银行可能蒙受的损失规模。

Query_Text_en: Figuring out that number can be tough .
Translation: 确定这一数字可能颇具难度。

Query_Text_en: Banks do disclose in the notes to their financial statements how much money they could lose , either because of investment or loans , by country .
Translation: 银行会在财务报表附注中按国别披露其可能因投资或贷款而蒙受的损失金额。

Query_Text_en: They only disclose that figure for countries where they have significant holdings or lending operations .
Translation: 该机构仅对持有重大资产或开展重要贷款业务的国家披露这一数据。

Query_Text_en: And they generally do n't tally up all the exposures they have to emerging markets around the world .
Translation: 而且它们通常不会统计在全球新兴市场的全部风险敞口。

Query_Text_en: Morgan Stanley -LRB- MS -RRB- , for instance , says in its financial statements it could lose as much as $ 4.6 billion if all its bets and loans in Brazil went bad , and another $ 3 billion in China .
Translation: 例如，摩根士丹利（MS）在其财务报表中称，若其在巴西的所有投资和贷款均出现坏账，可能蒙受高达46亿美元的损失；在中国市场的潜在损失则另达30亿美元。

Query_Text_en: But those figures are after hedges and adjustment .
Translation: 但这些数据已计入对冲与调整因素。

Query_Text_en: Ignore those -- hedges do n't always work like they should , just ask JPMorgan 's London Whale -- and Morgan Stanley 's worst case Brazil scenario looks more like $ 17 billion in losses , according to figures from the Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council .
Translation: 但套期保值并非总能奏效——问问摩根大通的"伦敦鲸"便知。根据美国联邦金融机构检查委员会的数据，摩根士丹利对巴西的最坏情境预估更像是170亿美元的损失。

Query_Text_en: In South Korea , the bank could lose $ 10 billion , according to the same government stats .
Translation: 根据韩国政府统计数据，该国银行业可能面临100亿美元的损失。

Query_Text_en: South Korea is n't one of the nations that Morgan Stanley highlights in its own financial statements .
Translation: 韩国并非摩根士丹利在其财务报表中重点提及的国家之一。

Query_Text_en: Add all those potential losses up , and emerging markets sound like something Morgan Stanley investors should be watching .
Translation: 将这些潜在损失累加起来，新兴市场俨然成为摩根士丹利投资者必须密切关注的领域。

Query_Text_en: Losses in those three markets alone , again in the worst case scenario , could put a significant dent in the bank 's overall capital of $ 66 billion .
Translation: 仅在这三个市场的亏损，即便按最坏情况估算，也可能对这家银行660亿美元的总资本造成重大冲击。

Query_Text_en: In its financial statements , JPMorgan Chase -LRB- JPM -RRB- includes China , Brazil , India , and Malaysia among the countries where it says it has the biggest exposures .
Translation: 摩根大通（JPM）在财务报表中将中国、巴西、印度和马来西亚列为其风险敞口最大的国家。

Query_Text_en: The bank says it could lose slightly more than $ 50 billion in those four countries , or about a quarter of its total capital .
Translation: 该银行表示，在这四个国家可能蒙受略超500亿美元的损失，约占其总资本的四分之一。

Query_Text_en: As of the end of last year , Citi said its potential losses in the emerging markets were minimal even in a worst case scenario .
Translation: 花旗集团表示，截至去年末，即便在最坏情形下，其在新兴市场的潜在损失也微乎其微。

Query_Text_en: It put its total exposure to Brazil and India at $ 6.2 billion .
Translation: 该机构对巴西和印度的风险敞口总额达62亿美元。

Query_Text_en: But , again , that 's after hedges .
Translation: 但需注意，这是在扣除对冲因素后的数据。

Query_Text_en: Go back to the government 's figures , and total outstanding investment in those two countries is more like $ 54 billion , which if it all went bad would wipe out a third of Citi 's capital .
Translation: 再看政府数据，这两国的未偿投资总额约为540亿美元。若全部成为坏账，将抹去花旗集团三分之一的资本金。

Query_Text_en: And that 's not all the money banks could lose in emerging markets .
Translation: 这还不是银行在新兴市场可能损失的全部资金。

Query_Text_en: In its most recent quarter , Goldman Sachs said based on the bets it makes in in the currency markets and trades it executes for clients , the firm could lose as much as $ 26 million in foreign exchange markets a day .
Translation: 高盛集团在最新季度报告中表示，根据其在外汇市场的自营头寸及为客户执行的交易测算，该公司每日在外汇市场的潜在亏损可能高达2600万美元。

Query_Text_en: That 's less than $ 59 million it could lose a day buying and selling investments , like bonds , that fluctuate with interest rates .
Translation: 这还不到5900万美元——相当于该行每日买卖债券等随利率波动的投资品可能产生的亏损额。

Query_Text_en: But it 's not nothing .
Translation: 但这绝非无足轻重。

Query_Text_en: If Goldman were to hit its maximum losses on half of the days in the quarter , and break even on the rest of the days , that could cost the bank $ 780 million , or roughly 40 % of what it earned in the entire fourth quarter .
Translation: 若高盛在该季度半数交易日都触及最大亏损额，其余交易日盈亏持平，则该行可能蒙受7.8亿美元损失，约占其整个第四季度盈利的40%。

Query_Text_en: The good news is that few people see us headed for a major emerging market blowup .
Translation: 所幸的是，鲜有人认为我们将面临新兴市场的重大危机。

Query_Text_en: Most strategists believe the most likely scenario is a gradual slowdown in China and other markets , at a time when developed nations like the U.S. are starting to grow faster again .
Translation: 多数策略师认为，最可能出现的情形是中国及其他市场逐步放缓，而美国等发达国家则开始加速增长。

Query_Text_en: Brazil could be stuck in slow growth mode .
Translation: 巴西可能陷入低速增长模式。

Query_Text_en: The situation in India might be the toughest to resolve , but again , few are talking default .
Translation: 印度局势可能是最难化解的，但同样鲜有人提及债务违约。

Query_Text_en: And that 's what will likely happen .
Translation: 而这很可能就是即将发生的情况。

Query_Text_en: The bad news , though , is that there will also likely be days in the coming months and year , when investors are too nervous to remember that .
Translation: 然而，坏消息在于未来数月乃至数年内，市场仍可能出现投资者因过度恐慌而忘却这一共识的动荡时期。

Query_Text_en: The Congressional Budget Office recently put out new budget projections and commentators have had a series of feel-good moments about it .
Translation: 美国国会预算办公室近日发布最新预算预测报告，评论人士对此接连发表乐观看法。

Query_Text_en: Debt is under control , they say .
Translation: 他们表示，债务处于可控状态。

Query_Text_en: Projections of Medicare costs continue to fall , they point out .
Translation: 他们指出，医疗保险成本预测持续下降。

Query_Text_en: First , the overall debt level is already high relative to historical norms .
Translation: 首先，当前总体债务水平已高于历史常态。

Query_Text_en: At its current level of 74 % , the ratio of federal debt-to-GDP is at its highest ever , except for seven years around World War II .
Translation: 当前美国联邦债务占GDP比重已达74%，创下除二战前后七年外历史最高纪录。

Query_Text_en: Now , however , the debt-to-GDP ratio is not projected to fall .
Translation: 然而，目前债务占国内生产总值的比率预计不会下降。

Query_Text_en: It is projected to creep up slowly over the next decade and then more rapidly in the future .
Translation: 预计未来十年将缓慢攀升，之后增速将进一步加快。

Query_Text_en: Now , we have arrived there .
Translation: 如今，我们已抵达彼岸。
