Query_Text_en: What matters for social stability is that ordinary Chinese continue to improve their lives at the rate to which they are accustomed , and that the Chinese economy is restructured in a way that allows it to tackle its credit bubble .
Translation: 社会稳定的关键在于确保中国民众生活水平持续以习以为常的速度提升，同时推动经济结构调整以化解信贷泡沫风险。

Query_Text_en: What is more , if China can do this while the economy is weaned off its addiction to credit , it will be an extraordinary achievement , even if it implies , as it must , that GDP grows far more slowly that the growth rates to which we have become accustomed .
Translation: 更重要的是，如果中国能在摆脱经济对信贷依赖的同时实现这一目标，即便这意味着——也必然意味着——国内生产总值增速将远低于我们已习以为常的水平，这也将是一项非凡的成就。

Query_Text_en: It will not be easy .
Translation: 这绝非易事。

Query_Text_en: A reduction in investment and GDP growth will almost certainly put pressure on employment and household income growth unless it is counterbalanced by a significant transfer of resources from the state sector to the household sector .
Translation: 除非国家部门向家庭部门大规模转移资源以抵消影响，否则投资和GDP增速下滑几乎必然会对就业和居民收入增长造成压力。

Query_Text_en: This will be strongly opposed by members of the political elite who have benefited from the strong state sector , but it is not clear that China has many alternatives .
Translation: 这将遭到长期受益于强大国有部门的政治精英阶层的强烈反对，但中国显然已别无选择。

Query_Text_en: When the economy in question is China and you have begun to rely on it growing at 10 per cent .
Translation: 当所讨论的经济体是中国，而你已经开始依赖其10%的增长时。

Query_Text_en: That is the conundrum facing some economies and some areas of business across the world .
Translation: 这正是全球部分经济体和商业领域所面临的难题。

Query_Text_en: The list of potentially vulnerable sectors is long .
Translation: 潜在脆弱行业清单所列甚广。

Query_Text_en: From Australian mines to German manufacturers , many companies are learning that selling to China far from guarantees stellar top-line growth .
Translation: 从澳大利亚矿企到德国制造商，许多企业逐渐意识到，对华销售远不能确保实现亮眼的营收增长。

Query_Text_en: And in a globally integrated supply chain , disappointment for these exporters is rapidly transmitted to their suppliers .
Translation: 在全球一体化供应链中，这些出口商的困境会迅速传导至其上游供应商。

Query_Text_en: Concern has spread to the highest echelons of global economic management .
Translation: 忧虑情绪已蔓延至全球经济治理的最高层。

Query_Text_en: Stephen King , chief economist of HSBC , says many countries will be vulnerable .
Translation: 汇丰银行首席经济学家金恩表示，多国经济将面临风险。

Query_Text_en: But even though some countries and exporters to China are squealing , the change in fortunes should have come as little surprise .
Translation: 然而，尽管部分国家及对华出口商叫苦不迭，但这一形势逆转本应在意料之中。

Query_Text_en: For years , the Chinese political leadership has talked about rebalancing its economy away from investment , exports , building and production towards consumption .
Translation: 多年来，中国领导层始终强调要推动经济再平衡，从依赖投资、出口、基建和生产的增长模式转向消费主导型发展。

Query_Text_en: Now we are seeing the first signs of action .
Translation: 当前我们已观察到行动初现端倪。

Query_Text_en: But this time it does seem to be different .
Translation: 但这一次情况确实有所不同。

Query_Text_en: China has realised that allowing its investment share of national income to rise from a little over 40 per cent before the financial crisis to a touch under 50 per cent today has made the eventual rebalancing towards consumption even more difficult .
Translation: 中国已意识到，允许投资占国民收入的比重从金融危机前的略高于40%升至如今的近50%，使得最终向消费转型的再平衡变得更加困难。

Query_Text_en: Slowing and rebalancing in China might hurt some but the effects should not be exaggerated .
Translation: 中国经济的放缓和再平衡可能对部分领域造成冲击，但其影响不应被夸大。

Query_Text_en: When China started to grow at 10 per cent a year in the early 1980s , its expansion was as valuable for the world economy as the US growing at 1 per cent .
Translation: 上世纪80年代初，当中国开始以10%的年增速发展时，其对世界经济的贡献相当于美国增长1%的贡献。

Query_Text_en: It was nice to have but easy to ignore .
Translation: 可有可无，无关紧要。

Query_Text_en: Over a quarter century of phenomenal Chinese growth , if its economy expands by 8 per cent today , it is the equivalent of the US growing 4 per cent .
Translation: 在中国经济持续高速增长逾25年的背景下，如今其8%的经济增速所产生的增量规模，相当于美国经济实现4%的增长。

Query_Text_en: A Chinese economy growing at an annual rate of 7.5 per cent , as it did in the second quarter , is still contributing more to global demand growth than expansion in any other economy .
Translation: 中国经济以7.5%的年率增长（如第二季度表现），其对全球需求增长的贡献仍超过其他任何经济体的扩张。

Query_Text_en: The slowdown is therefore only a problem for those naively expecting 10 per cent growth to last forever .
Translation: 因此，只有那些天真地认为10%增速能永远持续的人，才会将当前放缓视为问题。

Query_Text_en: Rebalancing , on the other hand , will generate winners and losers .
Translation: 另一方面，经济再平衡将催生赢家与输家。

Query_Text_en: Those feeling nervous must include commodity exporters , such as Australia , which has fuelled Chinese construction with its iron ore .
Translation: 感到紧张的必然包括澳大利亚等大宗商品出口国——正是其铁矿石支撑着中国的建设热潮。

Query_Text_en: But there will be winners , too .
Translation: 但也会有赢家。

Query_Text_en: So long as China manages to encourage consumption and a gradual shift towards a larger service sector , producers of other goods and services consumed in China will benefit .
Translation: 只要中国能够有效促进消费并逐步向更大规模的服务业转型，在华消费的其他商品与服务生产商都将从中受益。

Query_Text_en: Andreas Rees of UniCredit notes that even though German car exports to China have fallen this year , such is the pent-up demand that it is likely to represent a pause in an upward trend rather than a reversal .
Translation: 意大利联合信贷银行的安德烈亚斯·里斯指出，尽管今年德国对华汽车出口有所下降，但由于中国市场积压需求强劲，这更可能是上升趋势中的短暂停顿而非趋势逆转。

Query_Text_en: There are risks along this road to rebalancing .
Translation: 这条再平衡之路充满风险。

Query_Text_en: Chinese investment might drop before consumption picks up the baton , turning a slowdown into a Chinese slump , which would create losers alone .
Translation: 在中国消费尚未接棒之际，投资可能先行回落，这将使经济放缓演变为全面衰退，最终无一幸免。

Query_Text_en: Such an outcome is possible and , as the IMF recommended in its annual surveillance mission to China , significant reform is needed to prevent such an outcome .
Translation: 这一结果可能出现。正如国际货币基金组织在对中国年度监督访问中所建议的，必须实施重大改革以避免此类结果。

Query_Text_en: The consensus is no .
Translation: 共识尚未达成。

Query_Text_en: Economic conventional wisdom has an unfortunate habit of being spectacularly wrong in recent years but almost everyone still agrees that there is little sign that the global economic crisis is about to have a Chinese third act to follow the US and eurozone , which starred in Acts One and Two .
Translation: 近年来，经济领域的传统智慧屡屡出现严重误判，但几乎所有人仍一致认为：继美国和欧元区先后上演第一、第二幕危机后，目前尚无迹象表明全球经济危机即将迎来以中国为主角的第三幕。

Query_Text_en: Indeed , it may be the country that has the most difficulty dealing with it .
Translation: 事实上，该国可能是应对此事最为力不从心的国家。

Query_Text_en: Foreign exchange purchases by financial institutions dropped by Rmb41bn in June , in spite of the high trade surplus of US$ 27bn and strong foreign direct investment inflows of $ 14bn , say analysts at Nomura .
Translation: 野村证券分析师指出，尽管6月贸易顺差高达270亿美元且外商直接投资强劲流入140亿美元，但金融机构外汇占款仍减少410亿元人民币。

Query_Text_en: They rose only by Rmb66bn in May , as growth concerns emerged and the government started to crack down on illegal capital flows .
Translation: 5月人民币贷款仅增加660亿元，反映出经济增速忧虑浮现，且政府开始打击非法资金流动。

Query_Text_en: Meanwhile , China will feel a more direct hit from the quantity side of QE tapering , says Bin Gao , an analyst at Bank of America Merrill Lynch .
Translation: 美银美林分析师高滨指出，与此同时，中国将更直接地受到量化宽松缩减规模的影响。

Query_Text_en: Of nearer term interest is what China can do to fight back against this liquidity withdrawal .
Translation: 近期更值得关注的是中国将采取何种措施应对流动性紧缩。

Query_Text_en: Some analysts think that , with the end of the recent market turmoil , the outflows will abate and market moves triggered by stale flow data will be reversed .
Translation: 部分分析人士认为，随着近期市场动荡的结束，资金外流将有所缓解，由滞后流动性数据引发的市场波动也将得到修正。

Query_Text_en: The Arctic has been warming at least twice as fast as the rest of the world for many years and the amount of sea ice , which melts and refreezes annually , has been falling by an area almost the size of the UK each year since 2001 .
Translation: 多年来，北极地区变暖速度至少是全球其他地区的两倍。自2001年以来，每年融化后重新冻结的海冰面积持续缩减，年均减少量几乎相当于英国国土面积。

Query_Text_en: Last year , the summer ice shrank to its lowest point since satellite observations started in 1979 .
Translation: 去年夏季，北极海冰面积缩减至1979年卫星观测开始以来的最低水平。

Query_Text_en: The European researchers have focused on the way warming Arctic waters are expected to hasten thawing of permafrost beneath the East Siberian Sea off northern Russia , believed to contain vast deposits of methane .
Translation: 欧洲研究人员重点关注的是，北极水域变暖预计将加速俄罗斯北部近海东西伯利亚海海底永久冻土层的融化。据信，该冻土层下蕴藏着大量甲烷沉积物。

Query_Text_en: This is a greenhouse gas some 20 times more potent than carbon dioxide , though it does not last as long in the atmosphere .
Translation: 这种温室气体的效力约为二氧化碳的20倍，但其在大气中的存留时间较短。

Query_Text_en: There is much debate about how long it might take to release these gas hydrate deposits , and what impact it would have .
Translation: 关于释放这些天然气水合物沉积物所需时间及其潜在影响，目前存在诸多争议。

Query_Text_en: But some scientists say there is already evidence of large plumes of methane escaping and others fear this could happen fast enough to accelerate global warming and speed up changes such as the melting of the Greenland ice sheet , which contains enough water to push up sea levels by 7m .
Translation: 但一些科学家指出，已有证据表明大量甲烷正在逸出，另一些科学家则担忧这种情况可能迅速加剧全球变暖，加速诸如格陵兰冰盖融化等变化——该冰盖所含水量足以使海平面上升7米。

Query_Text_en: That is why the group felt it was important to assess the economic impact , said Peter Wadhams , a professor of ocean physics at Cambridge who believes the Arctic sea ice could vanish in summer by 2015 .
Translation: 剑桥大学海洋物理学教授彼得·沃德汉姆表示，正因如此，研究小组认为评估经济影响至关重要。他预测北极海冰可能于2015年前夏季完全消融。

Query_Text_en: At one extreme , some observers are talking about a potential dynastic collapse .
Translation: 极端情况下，有观察人士甚至认为该国可能面临王朝倾覆之危。

Query_Text_en: The reason for this imbalance is often attributed to low interest rates or an undervalued exchange rate .
Translation: 这种失衡的原因通常被归咎于低利率或汇率低估。

Query_Text_en: This has been the easy explanatory option since financial markets are comfortable with prices driving outcomes .
Translation: 金融市场习惯于价格主导结果，这一直是最简单的解释选项。

Query_Text_en: But in his article in The New York Times last week , Paul Krugman is unique among prominent commentators in getting it right .
Translation: 但在上周《纽约时报》的专栏文章中，保罗·克鲁格曼却独树一帜，成为少数准确研判形势的知名评论家。

Query_Text_en: But why is successful growth so unbalanced ? The explanation lies in the structural shifts as an economy moves from being dependent on agriculture to urban-based industries and services .
Translation: 但为何成功增长如此不均衡？原因在于经济从依赖农业转向城市工业和服务业时所发生的结构性转变。

Query_Text_en: Contrary to popular perceptions , however , which Mr Krugman also falls victim to , labour is not suffering in the urbanisation process and there is nothing perverse about this declining consumption share since migrants are earning and consuming multiples more than they used to , businesses are able to expand through increased labour absorption and rising profits , and the country benefits from higher productivity and double-digit growth rates .
Translation: 然而，与克鲁格曼先生也未能免俗的普遍认知相反，劳动力在城市化进程中并未受损。消费占比下降并无反常之处，因为农民工的收入和消费水平已数倍于往昔，企业通过扩大用工和提升利润实现扩张，而国家则从生产力提升和两位数增长率中获益。

Query_Text_en: Growth in consumption and wages has been much higher in the economies cited following unbalanced rather than balanced growth paths at comparable stages in their development process .
Translation: 在可比发展阶段，那些遵循非均衡增长路径的经济体，其消费与工资增速远高于均衡增长模式下的经济体。

Query_Text_en: Thus the premise that more balanced growth means faster growth in wages or consumption is simply not true .
Translation: 因此，所谓更均衡的增长意味着工资或消费更快增长的前提根本不成立。

Query_Text_en: There is no such concept in economic theory as consumption-driven growth .
Translation: 经济学理论中并不存在消费驱动型增长这一概念。

Query_Text_en: The danger is that by artificially stimulating consumption and rebalancing prematurely , China risks losing the productivity gains that can come from a reform agenda driven by a more efficient urbanisation process and allowing the private sector to realise its full potential .
Translation: 危险在于，若通过人为刺激消费而过早实施经济再平衡，中国可能丧失本可通过改革获得的效率提升——这些改革应以更高效的城市化进程为驱动，并让私营部门充分发挥潜力。

Query_Text_en: South Korea , Japan and Taiwan began to rebalance at an income level between $ 12,000 and $ 15,000 -LRB- in adjusted purchasing power parity terms -RRB- .
Translation: 韩国、日本和台湾地区在调整后的购买力平价水平达到1.2万至1.5万美元时开始进行经济再平衡。

Query_Text_en: If Beijing implements the necessary reforms to realise these productivity gains then its economy will not hit the China Wall that Mr Krugman refers to until 2020 .
Translation: 若北京推行必要改革以实现这些生产率提升，中国经济将不会在2020年前遭遇克鲁格曼所言的"中国之墙"。

Query_Text_en: If China gets it right , then rebalancing will eventually occur as a byproduct of a sustainable growth path but not as the intrinsic objective .
Translation: 若中国施策得当，经济再平衡终将作为可持续增长路径的副产品自然实现，而非作为内在目标刻意追求。

Query_Text_en: The author is a senior associate at the Carnegie Endowment and a former World Bank country director for China
Translation: 本文作者系卡内基国际和平基金会高级研究员，曾任世界银行中国局局长。

Query_Text_en: Renowned American investor Jim Rogers has attracted global attention with his prediction that gold prices will fall to $ 900 an ounce .
Translation: 美国著名投资人吉姆·罗杰斯预言金价将跌至每盎司900美元，引发全球关注。

Query_Text_en: Gold , he repeatedly warns , is not a mystical commodity and its real bottom will not be reached until those investors who think it can not fall have all left the market .
Translation: 他多次警告称，黄金并非神秘商品，只有当那些认为金价不会下跌的投资者全部离场时，真正的底部才会出现。

Query_Text_en: Mr Rogers is on a mission to convince the investment world to look seriously at agriculture .
Translation: 罗杰斯先生正致力于说服投资界认真看待农业领域。

Query_Text_en: He explains to Elaine Moore why he thinks it will be a source of profit for years to come .
Translation: 他向伊莱恩·摩尔解释道，他认为这将成为未来多年持续盈利的来源。

Query_Text_en: Gold has gone up 12 years in a row , which is terribly unusual for any asset , so it would be an anomaly if there was not a correction .
Translation: 黄金价格已连续12年上涨，这对任何资产而言都极不寻常。若未出现回调，反倒会成为异常现象。

Query_Text_en: I am terrible at market timing but I expect gold to go down 50 per cent from its peak , which would take it to about $ 900 .
Translation: 我不擅长把握市场时机，但我预计金价将从峰值下跌50%，跌至每盎司900美元左右。

Query_Text_en: When I speak at investment events there is always someone asking about gold .
Translation: 我在投资论坛演讲时，总有人问起黄金走势。

Query_Text_en: I think there is more money to be made in agriculture .
Translation: 我认为农业领域蕴藏着更大的盈利空间。

Query_Text_en: I think that farming is going to become one of the most exciting professions in the next 20 years .
Translation: 我认为农业将成为未来20年最具吸引力的行业之一。

Query_Text_en: It is an old profession and the people in it are dying out or retiring .
Translation: 这一行当由来已久，但从业者正逐渐凋零或退休。

Query_Text_en: In the US , more people study public relations than agriculture .
Translation: 在美国，学习公共关系的人数超过了农业专业。

Query_Text_en: The world is facing a serious demographic and production problem .
Translation: 全球正面临严峻的人口结构与生产力问题。

Query_Text_en: Prices will have to go up a lot to attract labour and the Food and Agriculture Organisation has tried to get people to see this crisis .
Translation: 必须大幅提高价格才能吸引劳动力，联合国粮农组织已努力促使人们认识到这一危机。

Query_Text_en: They see what I see .
Translation: 他们所见即我所见。

Query_Text_en: In the past if we had problems with the weather , then we had huge inventories .
Translation: 过去若遇天气问题，我们便囤积大量库存。

Query_Text_en: When I was at college -LSB- Mr Rogers was born in 1942 -RSB- people used to talk about the City and Wall Street as backwaters .
Translation: 在我上大学时（罗杰斯先生出生于1942年），人们常把伦敦金融城和华尔街比作死水一潭。

Query_Text_en: Now the kids at Oxford all want to start hedge funds .
Translation: 如今牛津学子个个都想创办对冲基金。

Query_Text_en: But the fundamentals have changed so much .
Translation: 但基本面已发生重大变化。

Query_Text_en: There is so much competition in finance and banking in the rest of the world , we have gigantic leverage in the industry and now every government is coming down hard against financial types .
Translation: 全球金融银行业竞争异常激烈，我们在该行业拥有巨大影响力，而如今各国政府正对金融从业者采取严厉打压措施。

Query_Text_en: I think finance is going to be a terrible place to be for the next 10 , 20 , 30 years .
Translation: 我认为未来10年、20年乃至30年，金融业将陷入极其艰难的境地。

Query_Text_en: I buy publicly traded farms in Australia and Indonesia and Africa .
Translation: 我在澳大利亚、印度尼西亚和非洲收购公开上市的农场。

Query_Text_en: There are plenty of studies that show that index investing outperforms 80 per cent of active managers , so passive investing is the best way for most investors .
Translation: 大量研究表明，指数投资的收益表现优于80%的主动型基金管理，因此被动投资仍是多数投资者的最佳选择。

Query_Text_en: If you are a good stock picker then , sure , do that , but the evidence is so strong that basically most people should use passive investments .
Translation: 如果你擅长选股，那当然可以自行操作，但大量证据表明，绝大多数人实际上都应该选择被动投资。

Query_Text_en: This is the sensitive issue today for our country .
Translation: 这是当前我国面临的敏感议题。

Query_Text_en: Since then , EU and US sanctions against key regime supporters have scared away many potential investors .
Translation: 此后，欧盟和美国对关键政权支持者的制裁措施，吓退了许多潜在投资者。

Query_Text_en: After a brief period of stability last year , the economy is again showing signs of strain .
Translation: 去年经历短暂企稳后，当前经济再现承压迹象。

Query_Text_en: Exports are slowing as is consumer demand .
Translation: 出口增速放缓，消费需求同样趋弱。

Query_Text_en: Heavy state control of the economy means unemployment is kept artificially low but weakness in the rouble could , analysts warn , make it increasingly hard for Mr Lukashenko to fulfil his promise of lifting average wages to the equivalent of $ 500 a month .
Translation: 分析人士警告称，国家对经济的强力管控虽人为压低了失业率，但卢布疲软可能使卢卡申科兑现月均工资提升至500美元承诺的难度日益加大。

Query_Text_en: Trade between the two came to almost $ 3bn last year , but is weighted heavily towards China , which sold $ 2.4 bn of goods to Belarus , which has a gross domestic product of $ 58bn .
Translation: 去年两国双边贸易额接近30亿美元，但贸易格局严重向中国倾斜——中国对白俄罗斯的出口额达24亿美元，而白俄罗斯国内生产总值仅为580亿美元。

Query_Text_en: It is also not clear how happy Russia will be with increased Chinese investment in Belarus .
Translation: 俄罗斯对中国增加在白俄罗斯的投资会作何反应，目前尚不明朗。

Query_Text_en: The investment has generated handsome gains .
Translation: 这项投资已产生可观收益。

Query_Text_en: Under the terms of the 2008 deal , both Abu Dhabi and Qatar were given discounted access to new shares plus free warrants that could be converted into further shares .
Translation: 根据2008年协议条款，阿布扎比和卡塔尔均获得新股认购折扣权，以及可转换为额外股份的免费认股权证。

Query_Text_en: Even without the sweeteners , the Abu Dhabi investment generated a handsome profit , with the share price up more than 60 per cent over the period .
Translation: 即便不考虑额外优惠条件，阿布扎比这笔投资也已获得可观收益——持股期间渣打股价涨幅超过60%。

Query_Text_en: Since 2008 , it has been difficult to chart the stakes held by the top shareholders .
Translation: 2008年以来，主要股东的持股情况一直难以查证。

Query_Text_en: The stake was first reported to be in the name of Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed bin Sultan al-Nahyan , who owns Manchester City football club .
Translation: 该股权最初被报道登记在谢赫·曼苏尔·本·扎耶德·阿勒纳哈扬名下，其同时拥有曼城足球俱乐部所有权。

Query_Text_en: It later emerged the shareholding was in the name of a government-owned fund , International Petroleum Investment Company , chaired by the sheikh .
Translation: 后经披露，该股权实际登记在政府所有的基金——国际石油投资公司名下，该公司由谢赫担任主席。

Query_Text_en: Barclays and some senior current and former executives are under investigation in the UK and US over allegations of improper payments connected to the capital-raising .
Translation: 巴克莱银行及其部分现任和前任高管因涉嫌在融资过程中存在不当支付行为，正面临英国和美国的调查。

Query_Text_en: The International Monetary Fund has warned that time is running short for China to implement critical economic reforms as the government , banks and companies come under mounting strain from rapid and unbalanced growth .
Translation: 国际货币基金组织警告称，随着政府、银行和企业承受着快速且不平衡增长带来的日益沉重的压力，中国实施关键经济改革的时间已所剩不多。

Query_Text_en: In its annual report on the Chinese economy , the IMF sounded a more cautionary note than previously .
Translation: 国际货币基金组织在其中国经济年度报告中，释放出较以往更为谨慎的信号。

Query_Text_en: The IMF said it was particularly worrisome a substantial portion of this credit was being routed through the non-traditional , financial system .
Translation: 国际货币基金组织指出，尤为令人担忧的是，大量信贷正通过非传统金融体系进行流转。

Query_Text_en: A Chinese tycoon plans to buy a vast tract of Icelandic land for a $ 100m tourism project which critics fear could give Beijing a strategic foothold in the North Atlantic .
Translation: 一位中国富豪计划斥资1亿美元在冰岛购置大片土地开发旅游项目，批评人士担忧此举可能让中国在北大西洋获得战略立足点。

Query_Text_en: Huang Nubo , a real estate investor and former Chinese government official , has struck a provisional deal to acquire 300 square kilometres of wilderness in north-east Iceland where he plans to build an eco-tourism resort and golf course .
Translation: 中国房地产投资人、前政府官员黄怒波已达成初步协议，拟收购冰岛东北部300平方公里的荒原，计划在此开发一个生态旅游度假村及高尔夫球场。

Query_Text_en: While home to just 320,000 people , Iceland occupies a strategically important location between Europe and North America and has been touted as a potential hub for Asian cargo should climate change open Arctic waters to shipping .
Translation: 冰岛虽仅有32万人口，却地处欧洲与北美之间的战略要冲。随着气候变化可能使北极航道开通，该国正被视为亚洲货运的潜在枢纽。

Query_Text_en: People familiar with the deal said that Mr Huang had agreed to pay almost IKr1bn -LRB- $ 8.8 m -RRB- for the land and planned to invest IKr10bn-20bn in the tourism project .
Translation: 知情人士透露，黄先生已同意以近10亿冰岛克朗（约合880万美元）的价格购入该地块，并计划向该旅游项目投资100亿至200亿冰岛克朗。

Query_Text_en: His company , the Zhongkun Group , owns resorts and tourist facilities across China .
Translation: 他创办的中坤集团在中国各地拥有度假村和旅游设施。

Query_Text_en: He describes himself as a poet and adventurer , having climbed Mount Everest and reached the north and south poles .
Translation: 他自称诗人和探险家，曾登顶珠穆朗玛峰并抵达南北两极。

Query_Text_en: People close to him say his interest in Iceland is motivated by his love of nature rather than geopolitics .
Translation: 据知情人士透露，他对冰岛的兴趣源于对自然风光的热爱，而非地缘政治考量。

Query_Text_en: Bank of America has struck a deal to sell around half its stake in China Construction Bank to a group of investors for $ 8.3 bn , marking another step in efforts by the beleaguered financial group to raise additional capital .
Translation: 美国银行已达成协议，以83亿美元的价格向一组投资者出售其在中国建设银行约一半的股份。此举标志着这家陷入困境的金融集团在筹集额外资本方面又迈出了一步。

Query_Text_en: The North Carolina-based bank did not identify the buyers .
Translation: 这家总部位于北卡罗来纳州的银行未透露买家身份。

Query_Text_en: As part of the sale process , it had approached sovereign wealth funds and other investors in the Middle East and Asia , according to people familiar with the matter .
Translation: 据知情人士透露，作为出售程序的一部分，该机构已接洽中东和亚洲地区的主权财富基金及其他投资者。

Query_Text_en: BofA said on Monday that it would make a profit of $ 3.3 bn on the sale of 13.1 bn shares , after tax , and will retain a 5 per cent stake in the Chinese institution , with which it intends to retain a strategic relationship .
Translation: 美国银行周一表示，在出售131亿股股份后将实现33亿美元的税后利润，同时将保留这家中国金融机构5%的股权，并有意与其保持战略合作关系。

Query_Text_en: The move is the latest in a series of actions made to bring the bank into line with future capital adequacy rules set out under new Basel III standards .
Translation: 此举是该银行为符合《巴塞尔协议III》新规下未来资本充足率要求而采取的一系列最新措施。

Query_Text_en: The CCB sale is the 30th such asset sale that the bank has announced since January 2009 , according to Dick Bove , analyst for Rochdale Securities .
Translation: 罗奇代尔证券公司分析师迪克·博韦指出，此次建行股份出售是花旗集团自2009年1月以来宣布的第30笔资产处置交易。

Query_Text_en: Shares in the bank were up 5 per cent in midday trading in New York .
Translation: 该银行股价在纽约午盘交易时段上涨5%。

Query_Text_en: The transaction had been widely expected by analysts and investors , but in recent weeks fears that such deals would become difficult in turbulent markets had added to the pressure on the bank .
Translation: 分析人士和投资者普遍预期到这笔交易，但近几周市场动荡加剧，外界担忧此类交易将难以达成，这给该银行带来了更大压力。

Query_Text_en: When Joe Biden went for a quick bite to eat at a local Beijing noodle joint last week , it looked like textbook diplomatic PR .
Translation: 上周，乔·拜登在北京一家面馆匆匆用餐的场景，堪称教科书式的外交公关。

Query_Text_en: Joe and ambassador Gary Locke just wanted to show how ordinary government officials can be .
Translation: 乔和骆家辉大使只是想展示普通政府官员可以是什么样子。

Query_Text_en: Yet the tab came to a paltry Rmb79 .
Translation: 然而账单金额仅为区区79元人民币。

Query_Text_en: Even with a 20 per cent tip -LRB- as is US custom -RRB- , the whole lunch still came in return for a crisp red Rmb100 note .
Translation: 即便加上20%的小费（美国惯例），这顿午餐总共也只需一张崭新的百元人民币钞票。

Query_Text_en: Some hope Beijing is shaking off its rigid currency regime and allowing the renminbi to appreciate further , faster .
Translation: 有观点认为，北京正逐步摆脱僵化的汇率机制，以更快速度推进人民币升值。

Query_Text_en: One morning this month , Jessie Fang was thrilled to see on her way to work that China Mobile was advertising the iPhone 4 .
Translation: 本月某天早晨，杰西·方在上班途中惊喜地发现中国移动正在为iPhone 4打广告。

Query_Text_en: What the ad on the Beijing subway promotes is a series of new monthly packages under which subscribers are promised cash refunds if they commit to a certain amount of voice and data spending per month on a newly-bought smartphone .
Translation: 北京地铁广告所推广的是一系列新型月费套餐，用户承诺在新购智能手机上每月达到指定通话时长和流量消费额度，即可获得现金返还。

Query_Text_en: The carriers are therefore under pressure to get as many of their moderately affluent subscribers to start using smartphones as those devices encourage heavier data applications , which will in turn generate more revenue .
Translation: 因此，运营商面临压力，需促使大量中等收入用户转用智能手机——这类设备能促进高流量应用的使用，从而创造更多收益。

Query_Text_en: Such a move might entail their making heavy subsidies for the device , as seen at China Unicom , the only Chinese operator which currently distributes it .
Translation: 此举可能迫使运营商对设备提供高额补贴，目前中国唯一销售该设备的运营商中国联通就是如此。

Query_Text_en: IHS iSuppli forecasts that shipments will rise to more than 54m units this year , from 35m last year .
Translation: IHS iSuppli公司预测，今年出货量将从去年的3500万台增至逾5400万台。

Query_Text_en: By 2015 , the Chinese smartphone market will have ballooned to 112m units , representing a compound annual growth rate of 26 per cent , compared with 20 per cent worldwide , says the research firm .
Translation: 调研机构预测，到2015年中国智能手机市场规模将激增至1.12亿台，年复合增长率达26%，而全球市场同期增速仅为20%。

Query_Text_en: Chinese mobile operators have been subsidising handsets since 2005 , but greatly increased the practice since they rolled out third-generation mobile services in 2009 .
Translation: 中国移动运营商自2005年起便开始提供手机补贴，而在2009年推出第三代移动通信服务后，这一做法更是大幅增加。

Query_Text_en: This change is an attempt to bring the top segment of mobile subscribers , the ones who have picked up smartphone use over the past few years , to spend more .
Translation: 这一调整旨在促使高端移动用户群体——即过去几年间开始使用智能手机的消费人群——增加支出。

Query_Text_en: This segment is a minority of the vast Chinese market .
Translation: 这一板块仅占中国庞大市场的极小部分。

Query_Text_en: As in many other developing countries , the majority of consumers use pre-paid cards .
Translation: 与其他许多发展中国家一样，大多数消费者使用预付费卡。

Query_Text_en: The company has been in talks with Apple over a potential iPhone distribution deal for more than two years .
Translation: 该公司与苹果就潜在的iPhone分销协议已进行了两年多的谈判。

Query_Text_en: Apple would need to offer a customised version to work on that network .
Translation: 苹果公司需提供定制版本才能在该网络运行。

Query_Text_en: Things are easier for China Telecom , because it relies on a widely used 3G wireless technology called CDMA , which is suitable for the iPhone .
Translation: 中国电信的处境较为轻松，因其采用的CDMA 3G无线技术应用广泛，与iPhone兼容性良好。

Query_Text_en: If China Telecom closes a deal , expected next year , this could become the starting shot for a smartphone subsidies race in China .
Translation: 若中国电信如预期在明年达成协议，或将引发中国智能手机市场的补贴大战。

Query_Text_en: Analysts believe China Mobile might try to counter by distributing a subsidised older version of the iPhone for use on its 2G network as a stop gap measure , and China Unicom might be driven to increasing subsidies to keep its subscribers of more recent models .
Translation: 分析人士认为，中国移动可能会采取临时措施，通过补贴方式分销旧版iPhone以适配其2G网络；而中国联通为维系新版iPhone用户，或将被迫提高补贴力度。

Query_Text_en: While billions of dollars worth of gold is traded every day , only a tiny proportion of it moves from vaults in London , New York and Zurich .
Translation: 尽管每日黄金交易额高达数十亿美元，但实际从伦敦、纽约和苏黎世金库中流转的黄金数量微乎其微。

Query_Text_en: A large proportion of the gold is in London , according to figures in the proposal document , with the Bank of England holding 99.2 tonnes .
Translation: 根据提案文件中的数据，伦敦持有大量黄金储备，其中英格兰银行存有99.2吨。

Query_Text_en: The Venezuelan central bank also has gold deposit accounts with Barclays , HSBC and Standard Chartered that would be delivered to the Bank of England , traders said .
Translation: 交易员表示，委内瑞拉央行还在巴克莱银行、汇丰银行和渣打银行设有黄金托管账户，这些黄金将被交付至英国央行。

Query_Text_en: The country could still reverse its decision , analysts warned .
Translation: 分析人士警告称，该国仍有撤销决定的余地。

Query_Text_en: The move is part of a broader strategy to decrease dependence on countries that Venezuela considers hostile : the proposal document cited the possibility that the US Federal Reserve could freeze dollar assets .
Translation: 此举是委内瑞拉降低对敌对国家依赖的整体战略的一部分。提案文件指出，美联储存在冻结美元资产的可能性。

Query_Text_en: Countries such as Iran and Libya , which have been subject to international sanctions , have in the past repatriated gold reserves , traders said .
Translation: 交易商表示，伊朗和利比亚等曾受国际制裁的国家此前已陆续将黄金储备运回本国。

Query_Text_en: Venezuela would need to transport the gold in several trips since the high value of gold means it would be impossible to insure a single aircraft carrying 211 tonnes , traders said .
Translation: 交易商表示，由于黄金价值过高，单架飞机运输211吨黄金无法投保，因此委内瑞拉需分多批次运送该批黄金。

Query_Text_en: They added it could take about 40 shipments to move the gold back to Caracas .
Translation: 他们补充说，将黄金运回加拉加斯可能需要约40次运输。

Query_Text_en: We are experiencing financial panic .
Translation: 我们正经历一场金融恐慌。

Query_Text_en: A downgrade of US debt has triggered a flight to liquidity towards the very assets downgraded .
Translation: 美国债务评级下调引发资金涌向流动性资产，而这些资产恰恰是遭降级的对象。

Query_Text_en: Ultimately , the cure for market paranoia is strong economic growth .
Translation: 归根结底，根治市场恐慌的良方在于强劲的经济增长。

Query_Text_en: Several commentators propose a sharp , contained bout of inflation as a way to re-energise growth in the US and the industrial world .
Translation: 多位评论人士提出，美国及工业化国家可通过一场短暂可控的通胀来重振经济增长。

Query_Text_en: To understand the prescription , we must understand the diagnosis .
Translation: 要理解药方，必先读懂病症。

Query_Text_en: Recoveries from crises that result in over-leveraged balance sheets are slow , and are typically resistant to traditional macroeconomic stimulus .
Translation: 资产负债表因危机而过度承压后的复苏进程往往缓慢，且通常对传统宏观经济刺激政策反应乏力。

Query_Text_en: Over-leveraged , households can not spend , banks can not lend and governments can not stimulate .
Translation: 过度负债导致家庭无力消费、银行无法放贷、政府难以刺激经济。

Query_Text_en: Yet there are concerns .
Translation: 然而，各方仍存忧虑。

Query_Text_en: Banks were too willing to hold the reserves that the central bank put out as it bought back bonds .
Translation: 央行回购债券释放的流动性，银行却过度热衷于持有这些准备金。

Query_Text_en: Perhaps if a central bank announced a higher inflation target , and an asset purchase programme financed with unremunerated reserves , to continue until the target were met , it could have some effect .
Translation: 或许，如果某家央行宣布提高通胀目标，并实施一项由无息准备金提供资金的资产购买计划，且该计划将持续至通胀目标达成，此举可能会产生一定效果。

Query_Text_en: More likely though , any target would lose credibility once it became changeable .
Translation: 然而更可能的是，任何目标一旦变得可随意更改，就会丧失公信力。

Query_Text_en: Market participants might conjecture that the programme would be abandoned once it reached an alarming size , and well before the target is reached .
Translation: 市场参与者可能会推测，一旦该计划规模达到警戒水平——且远在实现目标之前——就会被叫停。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , the central bank needs a rapid , sizeable inflation to reduce real debt values quickly .
Translation: 此外，央行需要迅速、大幅度的通胀来快速降低实际债务价值。

Query_Text_en: A slow increase will have very limited effect because lenders will demand both higher nominal rates and an inflation risk premium to roll over claims .
Translation: 缓慢的利率上调效果将极为有限，因为贷款机构在展期债权时，不仅会要求更高的名义利率，还会索取通胀风险溢价。

Query_Text_en: Turn next to whether it will work .
Translation: 接下来探讨其可行性。

Query_Text_en: Inflation will do little for entities with floating rate liabilities -LRB- many households that borrowed near the peak of the boom -RRB- or relatively short-term liabilities -LRB- banks -RRB- .
Translation: 对于持有浮动利率负债的实体（许多在繁荣顶峰时期借贷的家庭）或相对短期负债的实体（如银行）而言，通胀带来的缓解作用微乎其微。

Query_Text_en: The US government , with debt duration of about four years , is unlikely to benefit much from a surprise inflation unless it is huge ; and the bulk of its promises are social security and healthcare that can not be inflated away .
Translation: 美国政府债务的平均久期约为四年，除非通胀飙升到极其严重的程度，否则难以从中显著获益；况且其债务主体是社会保障和医疗支出承诺，这类刚性支出无法通过通胀稀释。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , inflation will clearly make debt holders worse off .
Translation: 此外，通胀显然将使债务持有者处境恶化。

Query_Text_en: That includes pensioners who moved into bonds as the stock market scared them away , banks that will have to be recapitalised , state pension funds that are already deeply underwater , and some insurance companies that will have to default on their claims .
Translation: 这包括因股市动荡而转投债券的退休人士、亟待资本重组的银行、已深陷资不抵债困境的公共养老基金，以及部分将无力履行赔付义务的保险公司。

Query_Text_en: Will inflation just shift the problem , ensuring the malaise persists In the best of worlds , it would be foreigners with ample reserves who suffer the losses , but they may be needed to finance future deficits .
Translation: 通胀是否只会转移问题，让经济低迷持续下去？在理想情况下，本应是外汇储备充裕的外国投资者承担损失，但未来财政赤字可能仍需依靠他们提供融资支持。

Query_Text_en: Only in a world where central banks retain credibility despite subjecting investors to a punishing inflation , is there no problem .
Translation: 唯有在央行即使让投资者承受通胀重压仍能保持公信力的世界里，才不存在问题。

Query_Text_en: This does not mean nothing can be done .
Translation: 这并不意味着我们束手无策。

Query_Text_en: The US experienced periodic debt crises during the 19th century and Great Depression .
Translation: 19世纪和大萧条时期，美国曾多次爆发债务危机。

Query_Text_en: In this vein , a recent proposal * to facilitate mortgage debt renegotiation could help reduce the household debt overhang and avoid value-destroying foreclosures without government subsidies .
Translation: 近期一项旨在简化抵押贷款债务重组的提案，有望在不依赖政府补贴的情况下，帮助缓解家庭债务积压问题，并避免破坏性止赎带来的资产贬值。

Query_Text_en: It is less clear that shifting the burden of bank and government debt to others will help the economy .
Translation: 将银行和政府债务负担转嫁给他人是否有助于经济发展，目前尚不明朗。

Query_Text_en: Too many of our problems come from impatience with the pace of past recoveries and overconfidence in adventurous macro-policy responses .
Translation: 我们诸多问题的根源，在于对既往复苏进程缺乏耐心，对冒险性宏观政策应对过度自信。

Query_Text_en: Rather than grand macroeconomic plans , we need many microeconomic actions .
Translation: 我们需要的不是宏大的宏观经济计划，而是众多微观经济举措。

Query_Text_en: Benchmark US borrowing costs fell below 2 per cent for the first in at least 60 years as markets took fright at increasing signs of global economic weakness .
Translation: 随着市场对全球经济疲软迹象加剧感到恐慌，美国基准借贷成本至少60年来首次跌破2%。

Query_Text_en: US 10-year Treasury bonds , the linchpin of the global financial system used to price many assets around the world , yielded as little as 1.97 per cent on Thursday , their lowest since April 1950 , according to Global Financial Data .
Translation: 全球金融数据公司数据显示，作为全球金融体系基石、用于为全球众多资产定价的美国10年期国债，其收益率周四一度跌至1.97%，创下1950年4月以来最低水平。

Query_Text_en: There were also savage falls for German and British borrowing costs , which hit record lows .
Translation: 德国和英国的借贷成本也出现暴跌，创下历史新低。

Query_Text_en: That came on top of a slew of bad growth numbers from Europe as well as rising fears about the funding of European banks .
Translation: 此前欧洲已公布一系列疲弱的经济增长数据，且市场对欧洲银行融资状况的担忧不断加剧。

Query_Text_en: Bank share prices once again bore the brunt of the equity market sell-off .
Translation: 银行股再度成为股市抛售的重灾区。

Query_Text_en: The Dax-30 index in Germany ended 5.8 per cent down while the FTSE 100 in London was off 4.5 per cent .
Translation: 德国DAX-30指数收盘下跌5.8%，伦敦富时100指数跌幅达4.5%。

Query_Text_en: In lunchtime trading in New York , the S&P 500 had fallen 4 per cent .
Translation: 纽约午盘交易时段，标普500指数下跌4%。

Query_Text_en: Manufacturing in the mid-Atlantic region of the US contracted by far more than economists expected in August to the lowest level since March 2009 , according to data from the Philadelphia Federal Reserve .
Translation: 费城联邦储备银行数据显示，8月美国中大西洋地区制造业萎缩程度远超经济学家预期，跌至2009年3月以来最低水平。

Query_Text_en: Inflation and jobless claims data were also both higher than expected , adding to the gloom .
Translation: 通胀与失业救济申请数据双双高于预期，进一步加剧了市场悲观情绪。

Query_Text_en: But US inflation data yesterday showed prices had increased by 3.6 per cent in the year to the end of July , meaning that investors in Treasuries are accepting large negative returns .
Translation: 但昨日美国通胀数据显示，截至7月底的一年里物价上涨了3.6%，这意味着美国国债投资者正承受着大幅负收益。

Query_Text_en: Government bond yields came off their lows in late trading .
Translation: 政府债券收益率在尾盘交易中脱离低点。

Query_Text_en: US and German 10-year yields were both at 2.09 per cent while UK Gilts were at 2.32 per cent , their lowest since 1899 .
Translation: 美国和德国10年期国债收益率均为2.09%，英国国债收益率跌至2.32%，创下1899年以来最低水平。

Query_Text_en: ONLY LOCAL BUSINESS CAN END GLOBAL POVERTY
Translation: 唯有本土企业方能终结全球贫困

Query_Text_en: On the other hand , financial constraints may force the UN to rethink the portion of its aid aimed at economic development .
Translation: 另一方面，财政压力可能迫使联合国重新审视其用于经济发展的援助比例。

Query_Text_en: The UN continues to fund government and non-governmental organisations to run economic development projects .
Translation: 联合国持续资助政府及非政府组织实施经济发展项目。

Query_Text_en: But that is not how to end poverty : only the local business sector does that .
Translation: 但终结贫困之道不在此：唯有本土商业部门方能实现这一目标。

Query_Text_en: Instead of helping local business in poor countries , the UN continues to champion the current aid system , along with its celebrity allies such as the rock star Bono , the Columbia University economist Jeffrey Sachs and Bill Gates through his foundation .
Translation: 联合国非但没有帮扶贫困国家的本土企业，反而继续力挺现行援助体系——其拥趸包括摇滚明星波诺、哥伦比亚大学经济学家杰弗里·萨克斯，以及通过基金会参与其中的比尔·盖茨等名人。

Query_Text_en: They argue that rich countries have both the technology that poor countries need to prosper and the wealth to provide it to them .
Translation: 他们认为，富裕国家既拥有帮助穷国繁荣所需的技术，也具备提供这些技术的财力。

Query_Text_en: More recently , this idea has returned in celebrities ' moral argument for the west to save Africa .
Translation: 近来，这一理念再度出现在西方名人呼吁拯救非洲的道德论述中。

Query_Text_en: But as a matter of economics , how can these policies work They do not , according to Africa Unchained by George Ayittey , White Man 's Burden by William Easterly , and Dead Aid by Dambisa Moyo .
Translation: 但从经济学角度看，这些政策如何能奏效？乔治·阿伊提的《非洲自由》、威廉·伊斯特利的《白人的负担》以及丹比萨·莫约的《致命援助》均指出：它们根本行不通。

Query_Text_en: They document not only that aid has failed to make poor countries more prosperous , but also that the aid system continues to do the same things again and again despite evidence that they do not work .
Translation: 这些记录不仅表明援助未能使穷国走向繁荣，更揭示了援助体系在明知无效的情况下仍不断重复同样的做法。

Query_Text_en: But neither can abandoning aid be the answer .
Translation: 但放弃援助同样绝非解决之道。

Query_Text_en: Certainly Mr Ayittey , Mr Easterly , and Ms Moyo are right that the past 40 years of development aid have been a spectacular failure .
Translation: 诚然，阿耶提、伊斯特利和莫约三位学者的观点是正确的：过去40年的发展援助遭遇了惊人的失败。

Query_Text_en: But that failure was not inevitable , and it does not need to continue .
Translation: 但这一失败并非不可避免，也无需持续下去。

Query_Text_en: We can go back further in time to find an aid programme that did work : the Marshall plan of 1948 to 1951 .
Translation: 回溯更早的历史，我们可以找到一个卓有成效的援助计划：1948年至1951年间实施的马歇尔计划。

Query_Text_en: Post-war America was rich , Europe was poor , and the Marshall plan helped Europe catch up .
Translation: 战后美国富庶，欧洲贫弱，马歇尔计划助力欧洲迎头赶上。

Query_Text_en: Advocates of even more aid through the current system sometimes call for a Marshall plan today for poor countries .
Translation: 主张通过现行体系提供更多援助的人士，有时会呼吁为贫困国家制定一项当代版的"马歇尔计划"。

Query_Text_en: Are they right
Translation: 他们说得对吗

Query_Text_en: Yes they are , but for reasons that might surprise them .
Translation: 确实如此，但个中缘由恐怕会令他们始料未及。

Query_Text_en: The mistaken view is that the plan gave away food , medicine , and clothing , on one hand , and rebuilt government infrastructure such as ports , railroads and water systems , on the other .
Translation: 错误观点认为，该计划一方面提供食品、药品和衣物等物资援助，另一方面重建港口、铁路及供水系统等政府基础设施。

Query_Text_en: In fact , the Marshall plan was in the first instance a programme not of charity aid or of government infrastructure but of support to local business .
Translation: 事实上，马歇尔计划首先并非慈善援助或政府基建项目，而是一项旨在扶持当地企业的计划。

Query_Text_en: It made loans to European companies , which repaid them to their governments , which then spent the funds on infrastructure .
Translation: 该机构向欧洲企业提供贷款，企业向本国政府偿还贷款后，政府将资金用于基础设施建设。

Query_Text_en: To qualify for the plan , countries had to enact certain pro-business policies to make sure that their local businesses could use the loans well .
Translation: 要获得该计划资格，各国须推行特定亲商政策，确保本国企业能有效利用贷款。

Query_Text_en: Let us draw a parallel with philanthropist Bill Gates 's own line of business and divide aid into two parts : hardware and software .
Translation: 让我们借鉴慈善家比尔·盖茨本行业的分类方法，将援助划分为硬件与软件两部分。

Query_Text_en: The hardware is the ports , railroads , and water plants of the Marshall plan , or the medicines , fertilisers , and boreholes of the current aid system .
Translation: 硬件设施是马歇尔计划中的港口、铁路和自来水厂，也是现行援助体系中的药品、肥料和钻井。

Query_Text_en: The software is the loans and funding mechanism of the Marshall plan , or the government and NGO project mechanism of current aid .
Translation: 该软件相当于马歇尔计划的贷款与融资机制，或当今援助中政府与非政府组织的项目运作机制。

Query_Text_en: The clear difference is that the Marshall plan software works , but the current aid software does not .
Translation: 明显的区别在于，马歇尔计划的运作机制行之有效，而现行援助机制却收效甚微。

Query_Text_en: The UN is right , of course , to target the dire poverty in sub-Saharan Africa . But it needs to take a different course .
Translation: 联合国将撒哈拉以南非洲的极端贫困作为目标当然正确，但需要采取不同的行动路径。

Query_Text_en: The global financial crisis is clearly a software problem .
Translation: 全球金融危机显然属于制度性问题。

Query_Text_en: That is what everyone is trying to fix for the prosperous countries of the world .
Translation: 这正是世界各国为谋求繁荣所致力解决的课题。

Query_Text_en: Poverty is also a software problem , but the aid system has been trying to fix the hardware instead , and got the software wrong .
Translation: 贫困问题本质上也是制度性问题，但现行援助体系却始终着力于硬件设施建设，反而在制度设计层面南辕北辙。

Query_Text_en: The Marshall plan got it right for postwar Europe .
Translation: 马歇尔计划为战后欧洲提供了正确方案。

Query_Text_en: It is not too late to correct the error and get it right for the poorest countries .
Translation: 现在纠正错误，为最贫困国家采取正确措施还为时不晚。

Query_Text_en: The writer , a former chairman of the US Council of Economic Advisers , is dean of Columbia Business School .
Translation: 本文作者曾任美国总统经济顾问委员会主席，现任哥伦比亚商学院院长。

Query_Text_en: His new book , The Aid Trap , is out soon
Translation: 他的新书《援助陷阱》即将出版。

Query_Text_en: Three steps to resolving the eurozone crisis
Translation: 解决欧元区危机的三步走方案

Query_Text_en: The first step was taken by authorising the European financial stability facility to rescue banks .
Translation: 第一步是授权欧洲金融稳定机制对银行实施救助。

Query_Text_en: Second , Europe needs eurobonds .
Translation: 其次，欧洲需要发行欧元债券。

Query_Text_en: The introduction of the euro was supposed to reinforce convergence ; in fact it created divergences , with widely differing levels of indebtedness and competitiveness .
Translation: 欧元的引入本应促进经济趋同，实则却导致分化，各国债务水平和竞争力出现显著差异。

Query_Text_en: If heavily indebted countries have to pay heavy risk premiums , their debt becomes unsustainable .
Translation: 若高负债国家被迫支付高昂风险溢价，其债务将难以为继。

Query_Text_en: That is now happening .
Translation: 这一情况正在发生。

Query_Text_en: The solution is obvious : deficit countries must be allowed to refinance their debt on the same terms as surplus countries .
Translation: 解决之道显而易见：必须允许赤字国家以与盈余国家相同的条件对其债务进行再融资。

Query_Text_en: This is best accomplished through eurobonds , which would be jointly guaranteed by all the member states .
Translation: 实现这一目标的最佳途径是发行由全体成员国共同担保的欧元债券。

Query_Text_en: While the principle is clear , the details will require a lot of work .
Translation: 原则虽已明确，细则尚待完善。

Query_Text_en: The board would constitute the fiscal counterpart of the European Central Bank ; it would also be the European counterpart of the International Monetary Fund .
Translation: 该委员会将成为欧洲央行的财政对应机构，同时也是国际货币基金组织的欧洲对应机构。

Query_Text_en: Debate will therefore revolve around voting rights .
Translation: 因此，讨论将围绕投票权展开。

Query_Text_en: The ECB operates on the principle of one vote per country ; the IMF assigns rights according to capital contributions .
Translation: 欧洲央行实行一国一票的决策机制；而国际货币基金组织则根据成员国出资比例分配表决权。

Query_Text_en: Which should prevail The former could give carte blanche to debtors to run up deficits ; the latter might perpetuate a two-speed Europe .
Translation: 哪种方式应占上风？前者可能纵容债务国肆意扩大赤字；后者则可能导致欧洲长期维持双速发展格局。

Query_Text_en: Compromise will be necessary .
Translation: 妥协在所难免。

Query_Text_en: Sadly , Germany has unsound ideas about macroeconomic policy , and it wants Europe to follow its example .
Translation: 遗憾的是，德国在宏观经济政策方面存在不当理念，并试图让欧洲效仿其做法。

Query_Text_en: But what works for Germany can not work for the rest of Europe : no country can run a chronic trade surplus without others running deficits .
Translation: 然而德国的成功模式难以在欧洲其他国家复制：若无他国承受逆差，任何国家都无法长期维持贸易顺差。

Query_Text_en: Germany must agree to rules by which others can also abide .
Translation: 德国必须接受他国同样能够遵守的规则。

Query_Text_en: These rules must provide for a gradual reduction in indebtedness . They must also allow countries with high unemployment , such as Spain , to run budget deficits .
Translation: 这些规则必须确保债务水平逐步降低，同时允许西班牙等高失业率国家维持预算赤字。

Query_Text_en: Rules involving targets for cyclically adjusted deficits can accomplish both goals .
Translation: 设定周期性调整赤字目标的规则可同时实现这两个目标。

Query_Text_en: Importantly , they must remain open to review and improvement .
Translation: 重要的是，这些措施必须保持开放态度，接受审查并持续改进。

Query_Text_en: But given the high risk premiums prevailing in Europe , this percentage is too low for a level playing field .
Translation: 然而鉴于欧洲市场普遍存在的高风险溢价，这一比例难以确保公平竞争环境。

Query_Text_en: In my view , new issues should be entirely in eurobonds , up to a limit set by the board .
Translation: 我认为，新发行债券应全部采用欧元债券形式，发行上限由董事会确定。

Query_Text_en: The higher the volume of eurobonds a country seeks to issue , the more severe the conditions the board would impose .
Translation: 一国拟发行的欧元债券规模越大，欧洲稳定机制理事会附加的融资条件就越严苛。

Query_Text_en: The board should be able to impose its will , because denying the right to issue additional eurobonds ought to be a powerful deterrent .
Translation: 董事会应有权贯彻其意志，因为否决欧元债券增发权理应成为强有力的威慑手段。

Query_Text_en: This leads directly to the third unsolved problem : what happens if a country is unwilling or unable to keep within agreed conditions Inability to issue eurobonds could then result in a disorderly default or devaluation .
Translation: 这直接引出了第三个未解难题：若某国不愿或无力遵守既定条件，将会引发何种后果？届时无法发行欧元债券可能导致无序违约或货币贬值。

Query_Text_en: In the absence of an exit mechanism , this could be catastrophic .
Translation: 若无退出机制，后果将不堪设想。

Query_Text_en: A deterrent that is too dangerous to invoke lacks credibility .
Translation: 威慑手段若因风险过高而无法实施，其可信度便荡然无存。

Query_Text_en: Greece constitutes a cautionary example , and much depends on how its crisis plays out .
Translation: 希腊提供了一个警示案例，其危机走向将产生重大影响。

Query_Text_en: It might be possible to devise an orderly exit for a small country like Greece that would not be applicable to a large one like Italy .
Translation: 对于希腊这样的小国，或许可以设计一套有序退出机制，但这套方案未必适用于意大利等体量较大的国家。

Query_Text_en: That could emerge only from a profound rethinking of the euro that is so badly needed -LRB- particularly in Germany -RRB- .
Translation: 唯有对欧元进行迫切所需的深刻反思（尤其是在德国），才能实现这一目标。

Query_Text_en: Financial markets might not offer the respite necessary to put the new arrangements in place .
Translation: 金融市场可能无法提供实施新安排所需的喘息空间。

Query_Text_en: Under continued market pressure , the European Council might have to find a stopgap arrangement to avoid a calamity .
Translation: 在市场持续施压下，欧盟理事会可能不得不寻求临时性安排以避免灾难性后果。

Query_Text_en: It could authorise the ECB to lend to governments that can not borrow until a eurobond regime is introduced .
Translation: 该方案可授权欧洲央行向无法融资的成员国政府提供贷款，直至欧元债券机制正式实施。

Query_Text_en: But only one thing is certain : these three problems must be resolved if the euro is to be a viable currency .
Translation: 但有一点毋庸置疑：若要使欧元成为稳定货币，这三个问题必须得到解决。

Query_Text_en: The writer is chairman of Soros Fund Management and of the Open Society Institute
Translation: 本文作者系索罗斯基金管理公司及开放社会研究所主席

Query_Text_en: THE UNDERCOVER ECONOMIST - Dubious Data Cut Down To Size
Translation: 《卧底经济学家》——可疑数据现原形

Query_Text_en: The writer is chairman of Soros Fund Management and of the Open Society Institute
Translation: 本文作者系索罗斯基金管理公司及开放社会研究所主席

Query_Text_en: Westling discovers that national income is correlated with the average length of the erect penis in a country .
Translation: 韦斯特林研究发现，国民收入与一国男性勃起状态下的平均阴茎长度存在相关性。

Query_Text_en: Specifically , medium-sized erections are correlated with the highest national income -LRB- in 1985 , as it happens -RRB- and small erections are associated with economic growth between 1960 and 1985 .
Translation: 具体而言，中等规模建筑（恰巧以1985年数据为例）与国民收入峰值呈正相关，而小型建筑则与1960至1985年间的经济增长存在关联。

Query_Text_en: Beloved of -LRB- some -RRB- development economists over the past couple of decades , it has been made possible partly by computers .
Translation: 过去二十年间，这一理论受到（部分）发展经济学家的青睐，其实现部分得益于计算机技术的发展。

Query_Text_en: But its deployment depends mostly on the careful cultivation of data sets describing GDP , political system , educational attainment and other variables , for large numbers of countries over many years . You throw the numbers into the computer and see which features of a country 's economy are correlated with economic growth .
Translation: 但其应用主要依赖于精心构建的数据集，这些数据集涵盖多年间众多国家的国内生产总值、政治体制、教育水平及其他变量。将数据输入计算机后，即可分析出各国经济特征中与经济增长相关的要素。

Query_Text_en: Westling simply added some rather unconventional data .
Translation: 韦斯特林只是补充了一些相当非传统的数据。

Query_Text_en: This strategy has produced many answers - rather too many , in fact .
Translation: 这一战略催生了诸多解决方案——事实上，方案数量已远超预期。

Query_Text_en: Westling claims that he uses standard statistical methods and that his results are robust ; that the correlation is both highly statistically and economically significant - in other words , the result is big enough to matter -LRB- please - no giggling -RRB- and is unlikely to be a coincidence .
Translation: 韦斯特林坚称，他采用了标准统计方法且研究结果稳健可靠；该相关性不仅具有高度统计学意义，更具备显著经济价值——换言之，其影响程度已足以产生实质性作用（请勿发笑）——且极不可能是偶然现象。

Query_Text_en: Now, we can also add an erect penis length of 13.5 centimeters to the list — which, according to Westling, is the 'size that maximizes GDP.'
Translation: 如今，我们还可以在清单上增加一项数据——13.5厘米的勃起阴茎长度。韦斯特林指出，这一长度"能实现国内生产总值最大化"。

Query_Text_en: Cross-country growth regressions have been used to demonstrate a vast number of statistical relationships , some mutually contradictory .
Translation: 跨国增长回归分析已被用于验证大量统计关系，其中部分结论相互矛盾。

Query_Text_en: Particularly notorious is the vast and unfulfilling literature showing that foreign aid increases growth , or does not increase growth , or leads to growth under certain conditions .
Translation: 尤为突出的是大量徒劳无功的研究文献，这些文献要么声称外援促进增长，要么断言外援无助于增长，抑或论证外援仅在特定条件下才能推动增长。

Query_Text_en: Such regressions are not compelling , because the number of different statistical relationships that might be tested is truly vast , and the data themselves are sometimes sketchy .
Translation: 这类回归分析缺乏说服力，因为可能检验的统计关系数量极为庞大，且数据本身有时并不完整。

Query_Text_en: Although few data sets are as of dubious a provenance as Westling 's data on penile length , a fact he cheerfully acknowledges .
Translation: 尽管鲜有数据集的来源像韦斯特林关于阴茎长度的数据那样可疑——这一点他也欣然承认。

Query_Text_en: Cross-country growth regressions have their uses , given a sense of perspective about how fragile their results can be , and how difficult it can be to turn a statistical correlation into a workable policy .
Translation: 跨国增长回归分析确有其用武之地，但需清醒认识到其结论可能极为脆弱，且将统计相关性转化为可行政策的过程往往困难重重。

Query_Text_en: But if you are wondering how much weight to place on a statistical technique that can produce a robust connection between the size of a penis and the size of an economy , you are right to do so .
Translation: 但若您质疑这种统计方法能在阴茎尺寸与经济规模间建立强关联的可信度，这种审慎态度完全合理。

Query_Text_en: I doubt it .
Translation: 我对此表示怀疑。

Query_Text_en: Google in $ 12.5 bn Motorola phone deal
Translation: 谷歌125亿美元收购摩托罗拉手机业务

Query_Text_en: Google and Apple will now go head-to-head in the battle for dominance in the fast-growing smartphone market , as both will control the hardware and software of their products .
Translation: 谷歌与苹果将在快速增长智能手机市场展开正面交锋，双方都将掌控各自产品的硬件与软件系统。

Query_Text_en: The operating system , licensed free to handset makers , has surged in popularity since the first Android phone in 2008 and claimed 48 per cent of the global market in the latest quarter , according to Canalys , a market research firm .
Translation: 市场研究机构Canalys数据显示，这款向手机制造商免费授权的操作系统自2008年首款安卓手机问世以来迅速风靡，最新季度已占据全球48%的市场份额。

Query_Text_en: As economic gloom sets in , that question is increasingly dominating the minds of metals investors .
Translation: 随着经济阴云笼罩，这个问题正日益成为金属投资者心中的首要关切。

Query_Text_en: Industrial metals such as copper , aluminium and nickel are sensitive to changes in the global economic cycle , because of their uses in construction and manufacturing .
Translation: 铜、铝和镍等工业金属对全球经济周期变化高度敏感，因其广泛应用于建筑和制造业领域。

Query_Text_en: So , as expectations for economic growth in Europe , China and the US have been scaled down , prices have fallen to the lowest in years .
Translation: 因此，随着对欧洲、中国和美国经济增长预期的下调，价格已跌至多年来的最低水平。

Query_Text_en: Aluminium , used to build aircraft , cars and to make fizzy drinks cans , has tumbled 20 per cent since March and at $ 1,899 a tonne on Monday was close to its lowest since late 2009 .
Translation: 用于制造飞机、汽车和碳酸饮料罐的铝价自3月以来已下跌20%，周一跌至每吨1899美元，接近2009年末以来的最低水平。

Query_Text_en: Nickel , used to make stainless steel , has fallen 30 per cent since February to touch a three-year low of $ 15,450 a tonne .
Translation: 用于制造不锈钢的镍价自2月以来已下跌30%，触及每吨15450美元的三年低点。

Query_Text_en: Even iron ore , a favourite of commodity bulls , has fallen 22 per cent since April .
Translation: 就连大宗商品多头最青睐的铁矿石，自4月以来也已下跌22%。

Query_Text_en: For some time , traders and investors have been trying to pick the bottom of some of the markets .
Translation: 一段时间以来，交易员和投资者一直在试图探明部分市场的底部。

Query_Text_en: According to traditional theory among metals analysts , if prices stay for long enough at this marginal cost , the high-cost producers will curtail their output , supporting prices .
Translation: 根据金属分析师的经典理论，若价格长期维持在边际成本线，高成本生产商将被迫减产，从而对价格形成支撑。

Query_Text_en: There is no doubt that producers of metals such as aluminium , nickel and platinum are feeling the pain .
Translation: 毫无疑问，铝、镍和铂等金属生产商正承受着压力。

Query_Text_en: But those trades have gone badly wrong .
Translation: 但这些交易已严重偏离正轨。

Query_Text_en: Nickel , for example , has underperformed every other metal so far this year .
Translation: 以镍为例，其年内表现逊于其他所有金属。

Query_Text_en: While Chinese demand generally steals the headlines , China is also the most important swing supplier in most metals markets .
Translation: 尽管中国需求通常占据头条，但中国同时也是多数金属市场上最重要的机动供应国。

Query_Text_en: First and foremost among these is the Chinese government , which stepped in last month to support aluminium producers by cutting electricity tariffs in a number of provinces .
Translation: 中国政府率先采取行动，上月通过下调多省电价来扶持铝生产商。

Query_Text_en: That alone cut marginal aluminium costs by 7 per cent , according to Mr Luke of CICC .
Translation: 据中金公司卢克称，仅此一项就使铝的边际成本降低了7%。

Query_Text_en: Raw materials costs have also been falling .
Translation: 原材料成本也在持续下降。

Query_Text_en: Chinese coal and diesel prices have dropped 22 per cent and 5 per cent respectively from recent peaks , lowering power costs .
Translation: 中国煤炭和柴油价格较近期峰值分别下跌22%和5%，降低了电力成本。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , general mining industry cost inflation is fading in China , as prices fall and investments are scaled down .
Translation: 此外，随着价格回落和投资规模缩减，中国采矿业整体成本通胀正在消退。

Query_Text_en: Joy Yang is not quite a haigui yet .
Translation: 杨乐怡尚不能完全算作"海归"。

Query_Text_en: The far-ranging sea turtles lend their name in Chinese slang to people who return to the mainland after studying abroad .
Translation: 在中文俚语中，远渡重洋的海龟被用来代指那些留学后归国的人士。

Query_Text_en: That is a blow to Shanghai .
Translation: 这对上海是一个打击。

Query_Text_en: If it is to cut it in the big league of cities specialising in financial services , it needs people with international experience .
Translation: 若要在金融服务业发达的国际大都市中脱颖而出，就必须拥有具备国际经验的人才。

Query_Text_en: Schooling and hospitals also leave much to be desired .
Translation: 学校教育与医疗服务同样亟待改善。

Query_Text_en: That aim is regarded nervously by Hong Kong professionals , who fear it will threaten their role as keepers of the gateway to China .
Translation: 香港专业人士对此目标感到不安，他们担心这将威胁其作为中国门户守护者的角色。

Query_Text_en: As local trade in domestic stocks , bonds and the offshore version of the renminbi has grown , so has the appeal of Hong Kong , which offers global banks and investors the quickest and easiest way to bet on China .
Translation: 随着内地股票、债券及离岸人民币交易的规模不断扩大，香港的吸引力与日俱增——这座国际金融中心为全球银行和投资者提供了进入中国市场最便捷的通道。

Query_Text_en: But a fully open and competitive Shanghai would provide a much more direct route for many of the financial flows behind trade and investment .
Translation: 然而，一个全面开放、充分竞争的上海，将为贸易投资背后的诸多资金流动提供更为直接的通道。

Query_Text_en: If it is to avoid falling into the so-called middle income trap , it needs to develop far deeper financial sophistication to power its own growth .
Translation: 要避免陷入所谓的中等收入陷阱，中国必须大幅提升金融体系成熟度，以此驱动内生增长动力。

Query_Text_en: But this is not easy .
Translation: 但这并非易事。

Query_Text_en: For now , mainland China remains a legally turbid and punishingly bureaucratic place for financial professionals .
Translation: 目前，中国大陆对金融从业者而言仍是一个法律环境模糊、行政程序严苛的地区。

Query_Text_en: Investors are unable to transfer funds easily .
Translation: 投资者难以自由划转资金。

Query_Text_en: The onshore and offshore versions of the renminbi are not freely exchangeable .
Translation: 人民币在岸与离岸版本不可自由兑换。

Query_Text_en: Large institutions need to run through a tortuous process of winning qualified investor status before trading there .
Translation: 大型机构需经历获取合格投资者资质的复杂流程，方可参与该市场交易。

Query_Text_en: Many foreign banks have invested a lot without seeing much in return , particularly given relatively lacklustre performances by the stock market and the fall in initial public offerings of big state banks .
Translation: 许多外资银行投入大量资金却收益甚微，尤其考虑到股市表现相对低迷，加之大型国有银行首次公开募股数量减少。

Query_Text_en: Companies and investors will also remain nervous about their long-term involvement in China , and the potential for corruption , until it has established a reliable and more independent legal system .
Translation: 在中国建立起可靠且更具独立性的法律体系之前，企业和投资者对其在华长期参与度及潜在的腐败风险仍将保持谨慎态度。

Query_Text_en: The city-state has historically fared better in wealth management , currencies and commodities .
Translation: 这个城市国家在财富管理、货币和大宗商品领域历来表现更为出色。

Query_Text_en: However , China is , for now , supporting Hong Kong in its global role .
Translation: 然而，中国目前仍在支持香港发挥其国际作用。

Query_Text_en: The most significant initiative is the creation of a special zone in Qianhai , just outside Shenzhen in the province of Guangdong , which borders Hong Kong .
Translation: 最重要的举措是在毗邻香港的广东省深圳市外围设立前海特殊经济区。

Query_Text_en: This will lead to freer movement of renminbi from the outside world and allow Hong Kong banks to lend directly to Chinese companies .
Translation: 这将促进人民币在境外更自由流动，并允许香港银行直接向中国企业提供贷款。

Query_Text_en: In another example of how renminbi will be channelled back into China , Hony Capital , a Chinese private equity firm , says it will use the zone to invest funds raised offshore directly into the mainland .
Translation: 另一项人民币回流机制的范例是：中国私募股权投资公司弘毅投资表示，将利用自贸区将在境外募集的资金直接投资于内地。

Query_Text_en: Ron Arculli , former chairman of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and a director of several companies , says mainland institutions in banking , securities and private equity already have an important presence .
Translation: 香港交易所前主席、多家公司董事罗德麒表示，内地银行、证券及私募股权投资机构已在香港市场占据重要地位。

Query_Text_en: Many leading business figures there do not see Chinese cities as a threat to Hong Kong in the near term .
Translation: 当地许多商界领袖认为，短期内中国内地城市不会对香港构成威胁。

Query_Text_en: As well as acting as an inroad to a great economic hinterland , international financial centres provide a site where banks headquartered elsewhere can mediate transactions between companies and institutions also based externally elsewhere .
Translation: 国际金融中心不仅是通往广阔经济腹地的门户，更为总部设于境外的银行提供了中介平台，使其能够为同样注册于海外的企业与机构促成交易往来。

Query_Text_en: That means having both significant outside investment in local markets and foreign companies listing their securities in those markets .
Translation: 这意味着既要吸引大量外资进入当地市场，也要推动外国企业在当地市场发行证券上市。

Query_Text_en: Hong Kong and Singapore are the only cities in Asia that have this .
Translation: 香港和新加坡是亚洲唯二具备这一特质的城市。

Query_Text_en: Many financial professionals say Shanghai and Shenzhen are a long way from it .
Translation: 许多金融专业人士表示，上海和深圳距离这一目标仍相去甚远。

Query_Text_en: Hong Kong remains the city in Asia that attracts premium initial public offerings .
Translation: 香港依然是亚洲地区吸引优质首次公开募股的城市。

Query_Text_en: Along with a flood of Chinese companies , these names helped to make the city the leading market for selling new shares for the three years from 2009 and 2011 .
Translation: 2009至2011年间，随着大批中国企业涌入，这些企业共同推动香港成为全球领先的新股上市市场。

Query_Text_en: Formula One , the motor racing business , preferred Singapore over Hong Kong for its planned listing , but that was mainly because it runs a race there , bankers say .
Translation: 银行家表示，一级方程式赛车集团在选择新加坡而非香港作为其计划上市地时，主要考量因素是其已在新加坡举办赛事。

Query_Text_en: Big listings have not all been good news for Hong Kong .
Translation: 大型企业上市并非都为香港带来利好。

Query_Text_en: They are threatening to make it easier to prosecute underwriters for lax work in preparing listings .
Translation: 他们正威胁要放宽对承销商在上市准备工作中失职行为的起诉门槛。

Query_Text_en: Singapore could have looked to capitalise on this with a lighter touch regime , but last week it also tightened its listing requirements to ensure only larger , more profitable companies qualify to sell shares .
Translation: 新加坡本可以借机推行更为宽松的上市制度以把握机遇，但上周却收紧了上市标准，规定只有规模更大、盈利能力更强的企业才具备股票发行资格。

Query_Text_en: Talk is increasing that Shanghai could attract international companies to its market .
Translation: 有越来越多的讨论认为，上海有望吸引国际企业进驻其市场。

Query_Text_en: Ken Brown , global head of equity capital markets at Nomura , based in London , says a number of European companies are seriously debating whether to pursue listings in Hong Kong or to wait until Shanghai is ready to accept them .
Translation: 野村证券驻伦敦的全球股票资本市场主管肯·布朗表示，多家欧洲企业正在认真考虑是选择在香港上市，还是等待上海做好准备接纳它们。

Query_Text_en: Bankers in Shanghai and Beijing say much groundwork has been done and local regulators have clear ideas on how it would work .
Translation: 上海和北京的银行业人士表示，相关工作已做好充分准备，当地监管机构对其运作机制已有明确思路。

Query_Text_en: Some say the first listing could come next year .
Translation: 有观点认为，首单发行或于明年落地。

Query_Text_en: HSBC is expected to be among the first groups that would try , given its historical and current links .
Translation: 鉴于汇丰银行的历史渊源与现有联系，预计该集团将成为首批尝试者之一。

Query_Text_en: But one Shanghai-based banker says it is unlikely that any company will list there soon .
Translation: 但上海一位银行家表示，近期不太可能有企业选择在该交易所上市。

Query_Text_en: In banking , China has begun to loosen its hold over the interest rates at which banks can both lend money and pay depositors .
Translation: 在银行业领域，中国已开始逐步放开对银行存贷款利率的管制。

Query_Text_en: Ms Yang , the Mirae Asset economist , says these would lay the ground for further reform .
Translation: 未来资产经济学家杨女士表示，这些举措将为深化改革奠定基础。

Query_Text_en: After that , China could allow its currency to trade freely and remove capital controls , which would open its banking sector to international competition .
Translation: 此后，中国可允许人民币自由兑换并取消资本管制，这将使国内银行业向国际竞争全面开放。

Query_Text_en: Liu Mingkang , the founder chairman of the Chinese banking regulator , who stepped down last year , reckons this and other factors means it could take 20 years before Shanghai and Shenzhen become big centres .
Translation: 中国银监会首任主席刘明康去年卸任。他认为，这些因素意味着上海和深圳可能需要20年才能成为大型金融中心。

Query_Text_en: Mr Liu says international talent is crucial , adding the government must consider lowering personal income tax rates .
Translation: 刘先生表示，国际化人才至关重要，并强调政府必须考虑降低个人所得税税率。

Query_Text_en: In the west , a heavy regulatory crackdown after the financial crisis has left many asking whether lighter touch regimes in Hong Kong and Singapore will attract companies away from New York and London .
Translation: 金融危机后西方监管力度大幅加强，令许多人不禁思考：香港和新加坡相对宽松的监管环境，是否会吸引企业离开纽约和伦敦。

Query_Text_en: But all of Asia still accounts for just 4 per cent of total hedge fund assets and that share is dominated by the Chinese industry , according to Hedge Fund Research .
Translation: 但对冲基金研究公司数据显示，整个亚洲在对冲基金总资产中的占比仅为4%，且其中中国行业占据主导地位。

Query_Text_en: But both cities are tightening stock market rules , while in banking they have no choice but to implement Basel III rules .
Translation: 但两地都在收紧股市监管规则，同时在银行业方面，它们别无选择，只能实施《巴塞尔协议III》的规定。

Query_Text_en: There is some freedom around the fine points of implementation but overall capital requirements and ways of measuring risk are tightly defined .
Translation: 具体实施细则虽有一定灵活空间，但资本金要求与风险计量方法总体上受到严格限定。

Query_Text_en: Financial companies could still find Hong Kong and Singapore attractive because of relations with regulators .
Translation: 由于与监管机构的关系，金融公司仍可能认为香港和新加坡颇具吸引力。

Query_Text_en: Mr Arculli agrees there are more constructive conversations between all parties in Hong Kong .
Translation: 胡应湘爵士认同，香港各界现正进行更具建设性的对话。

Query_Text_en: With no economic hinterland of its own , Singapore is not an obvious candidate to be a leading Asian financial centre .
Translation: 新加坡自身缺乏经济腹地，要成为亚洲主要金融中心看似并不具备天然优势。

Query_Text_en: Yet it has used its British-based legal system , political stability and low-tax incentives to attract a cluster of sectors in financial services that have turned it into a serious contender .
Translation: 然而，香港凭借其源自英国的法律体系、政治稳定性和低税率优势，成功吸引金融服务领域众多行业集聚发展，使其成为极具竞争力的国际金融中心。

Query_Text_en: This week the Monetary Authority of Singapore , delivering its annual report , said assets under management stood at S$ 1.3 tn -LRB- $ 1tn -RRB- , about level with those of Hong Kong .
Translation: 新加坡金融管理局本周发布年度报告称，其管理资产规模达1.3万亿新元（约合1万亿美元），与香港基本持平。

Query_Text_en: More than 70 per cent was from abroad .
Translation: 逾70%来自境外。

Query_Text_en: In the wealth management sector , Singapore is on track to overtake Switzerland , experts say .
Translation: 专家表示，在财富管理领域，新加坡有望超越瑞士。

Query_Text_en: The city-state has established a clear lead over Hong Kong in commodities .
Translation: 这座城邦已在商品领域确立了对香港的明显领先优势。

Query_Text_en: Trading firms handling goods in demand from China , such as crude oil and agricultural produce , have been attracted by tax breaks designed to lure them to locate operations there .
Translation: 为吸引贸易企业落户，当地对原油、农产品等中国需求旺盛的商品提供税收优惠，此举已成功吸引相关企业入驻运营。

Query_Text_en: Trafigura , Glencore , Vitol and others are booking as much business through Singapore as they can .
Translation: 托克、嘉能可、维多等大宗商品贸易商正尽可能通过新加坡开展业务。

Query_Text_en: The number of traders employed in the sector rose last year by 17 per cent to 12,000 , the government says .
Translation: 政府数据显示，该行业从业交易员人数去年增长17%，达到1.2万人。

Query_Text_en: Opportunities are emerging in the business of clearing , a post-trade process that regulators want to be used more in order to help safeguard the financial system against defaults .
Translation: 清算业务正迎来发展机遇。作为交易后环节，监管机构希望扩大清算应用范围，以增强金融体系对违约风险的抵御能力。

Query_Text_en: The Singapore Exchange has launched clearing of US dollar-denominated interest rate swaps , anticipating that US and European banks will want to clear such instruments in Asia .
Translation: 新加坡交易所已推出美元计价利率互换的清算服务，预计欧美银行将有意在亚洲清算此类金融工具。

Query_Text_en: You can see why .
Translation: 原因显而易见。

Query_Text_en: Look at UK fashion company Burberry . Not long ago it was a relatively staid UK brand .
Translation: 看看英国时装品牌巴宝莉。不久前，它还是个相对保守的英国品牌。

Query_Text_en: And the likes of Louis Vuitton , Gucci and Prada regularly report sales up more than 40 per cent in China .
Translation: 路易威登、古驰和普拉达等品牌在中国市场的销售额常年保持40%以上的增速。

Query_Text_en: The boom seems unstoppable .
Translation: 这一繁荣势头似乎势不可挡。

Query_Text_en: Prada has 22 stores in China already and late last year said it intended to open another 50 over the next three years .
Translation: 普拉达在中国已设有22家门店，并于去年底宣布计划未来三年内再开设50家新店。

Query_Text_en: The likes of BMW and Audi have stormed into China and fast reaped the benefits of a high-profit market in which customers want all the extras .
Translation: 宝马和奥迪等品牌大举进军中国市场，迅速从这一高利润市场中获益——中国消费者热衷于选购各类附加配置。

Query_Text_en: Already 60 per cent of the rise in sales at BMW and 74 per cent of the rise in sales at Audi so far this year are accounted for by China .
Translation: 今年迄今，宝马销量增长的60%和奥迪销量增长的74%均由中国市场贡献。

Query_Text_en: And overall China is forecast to make up about 50 per cent of the total sales of Audi , BMW and Mercedes by 2015 .
Translation: 预计到2015年，中国市场将占奥迪、宝马和奔驰全球总销量的约50%。

Query_Text_en: From the booming economy , which is in large part a function of the property market and of construction in general .
Translation: 经济繁荣很大程度上是房地产市场和整体建筑业发展的结果。

Query_Text_en: China has long been printing money to buy dollars and keep its exchange rate pegged .
Translation: 中国长期通过增发货币购买美元以维持汇率挂钩机制。

Query_Text_en: In a normal environment , this would have led to inflation .
Translation: 在正常情况下，这原本会引发通货膨胀。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese went , like the rest of us , for the obvious .
Translation: 与世界各国一样，中国人也选择了这条显而易见的道路。

Query_Text_en: Some used cash to buy flats and others borrowed money short term from unofficial lenders to get their hand on deposits to do so .
Translation: 有人动用现金购置公寓，也有人为凑足首付而向非正规放贷机构短期借款。

Query_Text_en: This focused heavily on encouraging lending to construction , infrastructure and housing .
Translation: 重点在于大力推动对建筑业、基础设施和住房领域的信贷投放。

Query_Text_en: Huge credit growth and some whopping pumping up of the property bubble .
Translation: 信贷规模急剧膨胀，房地产泡沫被大幅吹大。

Query_Text_en: By 2011 residential real estate made up nearly 10 per cent of GDP , 14 per cent of the workforce was in construction and China was using up more cement per capita than even Spain at the peak of its construction bubble .
Translation: 截至2011年，中国住宅房地产占GDP比重已近10%，建筑业吸纳了14%的就业人口，人均水泥消耗量甚至超过了西班牙建筑泡沫顶峰时期的水平。

Query_Text_en: Everyone with any cash or any way of getting any cash owned houses : even on official estimates 18 per cent of households in Beijing owned two or more properties and 40 per cent of flats in the major cities were being bought not for use but for investment .
Translation: 但凡手头有余钱或能筹措资金的人都在买房：官方数据显示，仅北京就有18%的家庭拥有两套及以上房产，而一线城市40%的公寓购房行为并非自住，实为投资。

Query_Text_en: They were often left vacant .
Translation: 这些职位经常处于空缺状态。

Query_Text_en: Overall numbers from Eclectica Asset Management suggest that China has spent twice as much as the US on its property bubble , relative to the size of its economy .
Translation: Eclectica资产管理公司的综合数据显示，相对于经济规模而言，中国在房地产泡沫上的支出是美国的2倍。

Query_Text_en: Not bad , given what has happened in the US since .
Translation: 鉴于美国此后发生的一切，这样的表现已属不错。

Query_Text_en: The boom has infected the entire economy .
Translation: 这股繁荣浪潮已席卷整个经济体系。

Query_Text_en: That makes it pretty much the biggest emerging market property bubble ever .
Translation: 这堪称有史以来规模最大的新兴市场房地产泡沫。

Query_Text_en: But the one thing that is surely clear to all by now must be this : bubbles always pop .
Translation: 但如今所有人都必须认清一个铁的事实：泡沫终将破灭。

Query_Text_en: And so it is with this one .
Translation: 本届政府亦是如此。

Query_Text_en: Transactions were also down 27 per cent year on year in those cities .
Translation: 这些城市的交易量也同比下降了27%。

Query_Text_en: The total floor space of residential units for sale was up 47 per cent .
Translation: 待售住宅总建筑面积同比增长47%。

Query_Text_en: At the same time housing starts are down around 15 per cent year-on-year .
Translation: 与此同时，新屋开工量同比下降约15%。

Query_Text_en: The other thing we have probably learnt is that when housing bubbles pop , economies crumble .
Translation: 我们可能还认识到一点：当房地产泡沫破裂时，经济就会崩溃。

Query_Text_en: There are signs .
Translation: 有迹象表明。

Query_Text_en: There are regular reports of rising capital flight as rich Chinese , seeing more financial danger than opportunity at home , move their money out -LRB- check out house prices in Vancouver -RRB- .
Translation: 常有报道称，随着中国富裕阶层认为国内金融风险大于机遇，资金外流现象日益加剧（温哥华房价便是明证）。

Query_Text_en: In a recent survey from the Bank of China and the Hurun Report 60 per cent of Chinese millionaires said they were considering emigrating , with concern about worsening business conditions being one of their reasons for doing so .
Translation: 中国银行与胡润研究院近期一项调查显示，60%的中国百万富翁正考虑移民，其中对营商环境恶化的担忧是其原因之一。

Query_Text_en: At the same time corporate profits are falling , foreign direct investment is slowing and the trend in even the official GDP growth numbers is very firmly down .
Translation: 与此同时，企业利润下滑，外商直接投资放缓，即便是官方公布的GDP增速数据也呈现明显下行趋势。

Query_Text_en: But today numbers from chemical intelligence agency ICIS show they are now flat .
Translation: 但今日化工情报机构ICIS数据显示，当前价格已趋于平稳。

Query_Text_en: That suggests growth in many areas is also flat .
Translation: 这表明许多领域的增长同样陷入停滞。

Query_Text_en: They have so far .
Translation: 迄今为止，他们尚未采取行动。

Query_Text_en: These people might be right .
Translation: 这些人可能是对的。

Query_Text_en: Just in case .
Translation: 以防万一。

Query_Text_en: Merryn Somerset Webb is editor-in-chief of Money Week
Translation: 梅里恩·萨默塞特·韦伯系《Money Week》周刊主编

Query_Text_en: The revelation is the first evidence Gu Wangjiang undertook property transactions that benefited her sister .
Translation: 这一披露首次证实顾王江曾进行过使其姐妹获益的房产交易。

Query_Text_en: Gu Wangjiang has been listed as a director of private and publicly traded businesses in Hong Kong , China and Panama , and has registered personal shareholdings of $ 79m , according to Bloomberg data .
Translation: 据彭博数据显示，顾王江曾在中国香港、内地及巴拿马多家私营及上市企业担任董事职务，其登记个人持股价值达7900万美元。

Query_Text_en: The FT visited the Hong Kong office address used by Gu Wangjiang in her Hong Kong company filings .
Translation: 英国《金融时报》探访了顾王江在香港公司备案文件中使用的香港办公地址。

Query_Text_en: But employees there declined to co-operate with requests to contact ?
Translation: 但那里的员工拒绝配合联系?的请求。

Query_Text_en: But that property is intricately connected to Gu Kailai through her son Bo Guagua and her former business partner , the French architect Patrick Devillers .
Translation: 但该房产与薄谷开来关系密切，因其子薄瓜瓜及前商业伙伴法国建筑师帕特里克·德维莱尔均牵涉其中。

Query_Text_en: He also stayed in the property intermittently between then and 2010 , during which time he told friends he was working on architectural projects in China and had a Chinese girlfriend with a son living close by .
Translation: 此后至2010年间，他亦曾多次在此处房产短期居住。期间他向友人透露，自己正参与中国的建筑项目，并有一位中国女友，其子就住在附近。

Query_Text_en: Neighbours assumed the Frenchman owned the flat .
Translation: 邻居们都以为这套公寓是那个法国人的。

Query_Text_en: But the FT has seen evidence that Mr Heywood also helped maintain the property , overseeing , for example , the servicing of its boiler .
Translation: 但英国《金融时报》看到的证据显示，何亚迪还协助维护该房产，例如监督锅炉的维修。

Query_Text_en: In June , Mr Devillers was arrested in Cambodia at the behest of the Chinese authorities and later voluntarily travelled to China to assist in the investigation into Ms Gu and her husband who has been accused of violating Communist party discipline .
Translation: 6月，德维利尔应中方要求于柬埔寨被捕，随后自愿前往中国协助调查被指控违反中共党纪的谷女士及其丈夫。

Query_Text_en: After 2010 , Bo Guagua assumed apparent responsibility for the flat .
Translation: 2010年后，薄瓜瓜明确承担了该公寓的管理责任。

Query_Text_en: China and the US are way out in front and scrapping between themselves to end the games on top .
Translation: 中美两国遥遥领先，为争夺最终胜利而激烈角逐。

Query_Text_en: A cascade of gold medals over the weekend has generated waves of national euphoria and goodwill .
Translation: 周末接连斩获的多枚金牌在全国范围内掀起欢庆热潮，凝聚起磅礴正能量。

Query_Text_en: The Olympics has long been regarded by rulers as an outlet for the expression of national pride and virility .
Translation: 长期以来，奥运会一直被各国执政者视为展现民族自豪感与国家活力的重要窗口。

Query_Text_en: This has continued into the 21st century though without the undercurrent of geopolitical tension of games from the Cold War era .
Translation: 这一传统延续至21世纪，但已不再带有冷战时期奥运会暗藏的地缘政治紧张暗流。

Query_Text_en: Fran?ois Hollande goaded David Cameron over which of their countries would win the most gold medals .
Translation: 弗朗索瓦·奥朗德就两国谁能赢得最多金牌一事对戴维·卡梅伦进行激将。

Query_Text_en: Vladimir Putin pointedly declined to attend the opening ceremony but came in an unofficial capacity to watch judo .
Translation: 普京刻意缺席开幕式，但以非官方身份到场观看了柔道比赛。

Query_Text_en: Then there is the case of Ye Shiwen .
Translation: 再来看叶诗文的情况。

Query_Text_en: Because Chinese swimmers have been caught doping in the past , the inclination was to assume , without evidence , that Ye was another culprit .
Translation: 由于中国游泳运动员过去曾有过兴奋剂违规记录，外界在缺乏证据的情况下倾向于认定叶诗文也是违规者。

Query_Text_en: Olympic officials have dismissed the notion , saying there is nothing to support such a suggestion .
Translation: 奥组委官员驳斥了这一说法，称其毫无依据。

Query_Text_en: What is beyond dispute however , is that she is a product of a state-run factory line of athletes created under the juguo training programme , which identifies children with a propensity to sporting excellence and nurtures them into Olympic champions .
Translation: 然而无可争议的是，她是由"举国体制"培养体系打造的国家运动员生产线产物——该体系筛选具有卓越运动潜质的儿童，并将其培养成奥运冠军。

Query_Text_en: Ye was seven when she was chosen .
Translation: 叶光富7岁时被选拔进入航天员培养计划。

Query_Text_en: She and her family will reap the financial benefit of the two gold medals she won at the London games , the fruits of nine years of intense training and obedience to her coaches .
Translation: 她在伦敦奥运会上斩获的两枚金牌，将为她和家人带来丰厚回报。这是九年刻苦训练、听从教练指导的成果。

Query_Text_en: Many others who went through the programme did not succeed and their schooling and upbringing have been disrupted .
Translation: 许多参与该计划的人未能成功，他们的学业和成长也因此受到干扰。

Query_Text_en: But those who rush to condemn such rigour in the pursuit of gold medals should pause for thought .
Translation: 但那些急于谴责这种追求金牌的严苛做法的人应当三思。

Query_Text_en: The jubilation in Britain at its sporting success on Saturday and Sunday show the pressure all national sporting bodies feel to produce winners .
Translation: 英国民众对周末体育赛事捷报的欢欣鼓舞，折射出各国体育机构所面临的夺牌压力。

Query_Text_en: All countries clustered at the top of the medals tables know that finding potential Olympians , training them to go faster involves carefully calculated programmes that use science and technology to better understand the physique of individuals .
Translation: 奖牌榜前列的国家都深谙此道：发掘奥运选手潜力、通过科学训练提升其竞技水平，需要依托精密设计的培养计划，运用科技手段精准解析运动员个体体质特征。

Query_Text_en: The theme tune from the film Chariots of Fire has been one of the recurring sounds of the Olympics .
Translation: 电影《烈火战车》的主题曲已成为奥运会反复奏响的经典旋律之一。

Query_Text_en: It conjures a romantic view of the Olympian whose endeavour , spirit and will to win triumphs in the end .
Translation: 这让人联想到奥林匹克选手的浪漫图景——他们的拼搏、精神与求胜意志终将赢得胜利。

Query_Text_en: The modern sportsman and sportswoman is surrounded by a retinue of psychologists , technicians and dietitians .
Translation: 现代运动员身边围绕着一群心理学家、技术专家和营养师。

Query_Text_en: Their coaches enlist companies to develop equipment to improve training techniques , all to give athletes perhaps a tiny fraction of advantage over their rivals .
Translation: 教练团队会聘请企业研发训练设备以提升训练技术，这一切只为让运动员在竞争中可能获得微弱的优势。

Query_Text_en: China will always have a numerical advantage over other countries because of the size of its population .
Translation: 中国凭借人口规模优势，始终将在数量上领先于其他国家。

Query_Text_en: Its talent pool is going to be big enough to compete strongly in any Olympic sport it chooses .
Translation: 该国的人才储备足以在其选择的任何奥运项目中展开有力竞争。

Query_Text_en: Modern sport is serious business .
Translation: 现代体育是一项严肃的事业。

Query_Text_en: Those with the resources will seek to maximise their medal-winning chances .
Translation: 资源雄厚的国家将竭力提升夺牌胜算。

Query_Text_en: Sometimes , the loser just has to shake the hands of the victor and offer congratulations .
Translation: 有时，败者只需与胜者握手致意，道一声恭喜。
